1.zh: 不从恶人的计谋，不站罪人的道路，不坐亵慢人的座位，
1.en: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or stand in the way of sinners or sit in the seat of mockers.

1.zh: 惟喜爱耶和华的律法，昼夜思想，这人便为有福！
1.en: But his delight is in the law of the Lord, and on his law he meditates day and night.

1.zh: 他要像一棵树栽在溪水旁，按时候结果子，叶子也不枯干。凡他所做的尽都顺利。
1.en: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither. Whatever he does prospers.

1.zh: 恶人并不是这样，乃像糠秕被风吹散。
1.en: Not so the wicked! They are like chaff that the wind blows away.

1.zh: 因此，当审判的时候恶人必站立不住；罪人在义人的会中也是如此。
1.en: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.

1.zh: 因为耶和华知道义人的道路；恶人的道路却必灭亡。
1.en: For the Lord watches over the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.

2.zh: 外邦为甚么争闹？万民为甚么谋算虚妄的事？
2.en: Why do the nations conspire and the peoples plot in vain?

2.zh: 世上的君王一齐起来，臣宰一同商议，要敌挡耶和华并他的受膏者，
2.en: The kings of the earth take their stand and the rulers gather together against the Lord and against his Anointed One.

2.zh: 说：我们要挣开他们的捆绑，脱去他们的绳索。
2.en: "Let us break their chains," they say, "and throw off their fetters."

2.zh: 那坐在天上的必发笑；主必嗤笑他们。
2.en: The One enthroned in heaven laughs; the Lord scoffs at them.

2.zh: 那时，他要在怒中责备他们，在烈怒中惊吓他们，
2.en: Then he rebukes them in his anger and terrifies them in his wrath, saying,

2.zh: 说：我已经立我的君在锡安─我的圣山上了。
2.en: "I have installed my King on Zion, my holy hill."

2.zh: 受膏者说：我要传圣旨。耶和华曾对我说：你是我的儿子，我今日生你。
2.en: I will proclaim the decree of the Lord : He said to me, "You are my Son ; today I have become your Father.

2.zh: 你求我，我就将列国赐你为基业，将地极赐你为田产。
2.en: Ask of me, and I will make the nations your inheritance, the ends of the earth your possession.

2.zh: 你必用铁杖打破他们；你必将他们如同窑匠的瓦器摔碎。
2.en: You will rule them with an iron scepter ; you will dash them to pieces like pottery."

2.zh: 现在，你们君王应当省悟！你们世上的审判官该受管教！
2.en: Therefore, you kings, be wise; be warned, you rulers of the earth.

2.zh: 当存畏惧事奉耶和华，又当存战兢而快乐。
2.en: Serve the Lord with fear and rejoice with trembling.

2.zh: 当以嘴亲子，恐怕他发怒，你们便在道中灭亡，因为他的怒气快要发作。凡投靠他的，都是有福的。
2.en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry and you be destroyed in your way, for his wrath can flare up in a moment. Blessed are all who take refuge in him.

3.zh: （大卫逃避他儿子押沙龙的时候作的诗。）耶和华啊，我的敌人何其加增；有许多人起来攻击我。
3.en: O Lord , how many are my foes! How many rise up against me!

3.zh: 有许多人议论我说：他得不著神的帮助。（细拉）
3.en: Many are saying of me, "God will not deliver him." Selah

3.zh: 但你─耶和华是我四围的盾牌，是我的荣耀，又是叫我抬起头来的。
3.en: But you are a shield around me, O Lord ; you bestow glory on me and lift up my head.

3.zh: 我用我的声音求告耶和华，他就从他的圣山上应允我。（细拉）
3.en: To the Lord I cry aloud, and he answers me from his holy hill. Selah

3.zh: 我躺下睡觉，我醒著，耶和华都保佑我。
3.en: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.

3.zh: 虽有成万的百姓来周围攻击我，我也不怕。
3.en: I will not fear the tens of thousands drawn up against me on every side.

3.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来！我的神啊，求你救我！因为你打了我一切仇敌的腮骨，敲碎了恶人的牙齿。
3.en: Arise, O Lord ! Deliver me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.

3.zh: 救恩属乎耶和华；愿你赐福给你的百姓。（细拉）
3.en: From the Lord comes deliverance. May your blessing be on your people. Selah

4.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）显我为义的神啊，我呼吁的时候，求你应允我！我在困苦中，你曾使我宽广；现在求你怜恤我，听我的祷告！
4.en: Answer me when I call to you, O my righteous God. Give me relief from my distress; be merciful to me and hear my prayer.

4.zh: 你们这上流人哪，你们将我的尊荣变为羞辱要到几时呢？你们喜爱虚妄，寻找虚假，要到几时呢？（细拉）
4.en: How long, O men, will you turn my glory into shame ? How long will you love delusions and seek false gods ? Selah

4.zh: 你们要知道，耶和华已经分别虔诚人归他自己；我求告耶和华，他必听我。
4.en: Know that the Lord has set apart the godly for himself; the Lord will hear when I call to him.

4.zh: 你们应当畏惧，不可犯罪；在床上的时候，要心里思想，并要肃静。（细拉）
4.en: In your anger do not sin; when you are on your beds, search your hearts and be silent. Selah

4.zh: 当献上公义的祭，又当倚靠耶和华。
4.en: Offer right sacrifices and trust in the Lord .

4.zh: 有许多人说：谁能指示我们甚么好处？耶和华啊，求你仰起脸来，光照我们。
4.en: Many are asking, "Who can show us any good?" Let the light of your face shine upon us, O Lord .

4.zh: 你使我心里快乐，胜过那丰收五谷新酒的人。
4.en: You have filled my heart with greater joy than when their grain and new wine abound.

4.zh: 我必安然躺下睡觉，因为独有你─耶和华使我安然居住。
4.en: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for you alone, O Lord , make me dwell in safety.

5.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用吹的乐器。）耶和华啊，求你留心听我的言语，顾念我的心思！
5.en: Give ear to my words, O Lord , consider my sighing.

5.zh: 我的王我的神啊，求你垂听我呼求的声音！因为我向你祈祷。
5.en: Listen to my cry for help, my King and my God, for to you I pray.

5.zh: 耶和华啊，早晨你必听我的声音；早晨我必向你陈明我的心意，并要警醒！
5.en: In the morning, O Lord , you hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before you and wait in expectation.

5.zh: 因为你不是喜悦恶事的神，恶人不能与你同居。
5.en: You are not a God who takes pleasure in evil; with you the wicked cannot dwell.

5.zh: 狂傲人不能站在你眼前；凡作孽的，都是你所恨恶的。
5.en: The arrogant cannot stand in your presence; you hate all who do wrong.

5.zh: 说谎言的，你必灭绝；好流人血弄诡诈的，都为耶和华所憎恶。
5.en: You destroy those who tell lies; bloodthirsty and deceitful men the Lord abhors.

5.zh: 至于我，我必凭你丰盛的慈爱进入你的居所；我必存敬畏你的心向你的圣殿下拜。
5.en: But I, by your great mercy, will come into your house; in reverence will I bow down toward your holy temple.

5.zh: 耶和华啊，求你因我的仇敌，凭你的公义引领我，使你的道路在我面前正直。
5.en: Lead me, O Lord , in your righteousness because of my enemies- make straight your way before me.

5.zh: 因为，他们的口中没有诚实；他们的心里满有邪恶；他们的喉咙是敞开的坟墓；他们用舌头谄媚人。
5.en: Not a word from their mouth can be trusted; their heart is filled with destruction. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongue they speak deceit.

5.zh: 神啊，求你定他们的罪！愿他们因自己的计谋跌倒；愿你在他们许多的过犯中把他们逐出，因为他们背叛了你。
5.en: Declare them guilty, O God! Let their intrigues be their downfall. Banish them for their many sins, for they have rebelled against you.

5.zh: 凡投靠你的，愿他们喜乐，时常欢呼，因为你护庇他们；又愿那爱你名的人都靠你欢欣。
5.en: But let all who take refuge in you be glad; let them ever sing for joy. Spread your protection over them, that those who love your name may rejoice in you.

5.zh: 因为你必赐福与义人；耶和华啊，你必用恩惠如同盾牌四面护卫他。
5.en: For surely, O Lord , you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

6.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器，调用第八。）耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我，也不要在烈怒中惩罚我！
6.en: O Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

6.zh: 耶和华啊，求你可怜我，因为我软弱。耶和华啊，求你医治我，因为我的骨头发战。
6.en: Be merciful to me, Lord , for I am faint; O Lord , heal me, for my bones are in agony.

6.zh: 我心也大大地惊惶。耶和华啊，你要到几时才救我呢？
6.en: My soul is in anguish. How long, O Lord , how long?

6.zh: 耶和华啊，求你转回搭救我！因你的慈爱拯救我。
6.en: Turn, O Lord , and deliver me; save me because of your unfailing love.

6.zh: 因为，在死地无人记念你，在阴间有谁称谢你？
6.en: No one remembers you when he is dead. Who praises you from the grave 1 ?

6.zh: 我因唉哼而困乏；我每夜流泪，把床榻漂起，把褥子湿透。
6.en: I am worn out from groaning; all night long I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.

6.zh: 我因忧愁眼睛干瘪，又因我一切的敌人眼睛昏花。
6.en: My eyes grow weak with sorrow; they fail because of all my foes.

6.zh: 你们一切作孽的人，离开我罢！因为耶和华听了我哀哭的声音。
6.en: Away from me, all you who do evil, for the Lord has heard my weeping.

6.zh: 耶和华听了我的恳求；耶和华必收纳我的祷告。
6.en: The Lord has heard my cry for mercy; the Lord accepts my prayer.

6.zh: 我的一切仇敌都必羞愧，大大惊惶；他们必要退后，忽然羞愧。
6.en: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.

7.zh: （大卫指著便雅悯人古实的话，向耶和华唱的流离歌。）耶和华─我的神啊，我投靠你！求你救我脱离一切追赶我的人，将我救拔出来！
7.en: O Lord my God, I take refuge in you; save and deliver me from all who pursue me,

7.zh: 恐怕他们像狮子撕裂我，甚至撕碎，无人搭救。
7.en: or they will tear me like a lion and rip me to pieces with no one to rescue me.

7.zh: 耶和华─我的神啊，我若行了这事，若有罪孽在我手里，
7.en: O Lord my God, if I have done this and there is guilt on my hands-

7.zh: 我若以恶报那与我交好的人─连那无故与我为敌的，我也救了他，
7.en: if I have done evil to him who is at peace with me or without cause have robbed my foe-

7.zh: 就任凭仇敌追赶我，直到追上，将我的性命踏在地下，使我的荣耀归于灰尘。（细拉）
7.en: then let my enemy pursue and overtake me; let him trample my life to the ground and make me sleep in the dust. Selah

7.zh: 耶和华啊，求你在怒中起来，挺身而立，抵挡我敌人的暴怒！求你为我兴起！你已经命定施行审判！
7.en: Arise, O Lord , in your anger; rise up against the rage of my enemies. Awake, my God; decree justice.

7.zh: 愿众民的会环绕你！愿你从其上归于高位！
7.en: Let the assembled peoples gather around you. Rule over them from on high;

7.zh: 耶和华向众民施行审判；耶和华啊，求你按我的公义和我心中的纯正判断我。
7.en: let the Lord judge the peoples. Judge me, O Lord , according to my righteousness, according to my integrity, O Most High.

7.zh: 愿恶人的恶断绝！愿你坚立义人！因为公义的神察验人的心肠肺腑。
7.en: O righteous God, who searches minds and hearts, bring to an end the violence of the wicked and make the righteous secure.

7.zh: 神是我的盾牌；他拯救心里正直的人。
7.en: My shield is God Most High, who saves the upright in heart.

7.zh: 神是公义的审判者，又是天天向恶人发怒的神。
7.en: God is a righteous judge, a God who expresses his wrath every day.

7.zh: 若有人不回头，他的刀必磨快，弓必上弦，预备妥当了。
7.en: If he does not relent, he will sharpen his sword; he will bend and string his bow.

7.zh: 他也预备了杀人的器械；他所射的是火箭。
7.en: He has prepared his deadly weapons; he makes ready his flaming arrows.

7.zh: 试看恶人因奸恶而劬劳，所怀的是毒害，所生的是虚假。
7.en: He who is pregnant with evil and conceives trouble gives birth to disillusionment.

7.zh: 他掘了坑，又挖深了，竟掉在自己所挖的阱里。
7.en: He who digs a hole and scoops it out falls into the pit he has made.

7.zh: 他的毒害必临到他自己的头上；他的强暴必落到他自己的脑袋上。
7.en: The trouble he causes recoils on himself; his violence comes down on his own head.

7.zh: 我要照著耶和华的公义称谢他，歌颂耶和华至高者的名。
7.en: I will give thanks to the Lord because of his righteousness and will sing praise to the name of the Lord Most High.

8.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。）耶和华─我们的主啊，你的名在全地何其美！你将你的荣耀彰显于天。
8.en: O Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens.

8.zh: 你因敌人的缘故，从婴孩和吃奶的口中，建立了能力，使仇敌和报仇的闭口无言。
8.en: From the lips of children and infants you have ordained praise because of your enemies, to silence the foe and the avenger.

8.zh: 我观看你指头所造的天，并你所陈设的月亮星宿，
8.en: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have set in place,

8.zh: 便说：人算甚么，你竟顾念他？世人算甚么，你竟眷顾他？
8.en: what is man that you are mindful of him, the son of man that you care for him?

8.zh: 你叫他比天使（或译：神）微小一点，并赐他荣耀尊贵为冠冕。
8.en: You made him a little lower than the heavenly beings and crowned him with glory and honor.

8.zh: 你派他管理你手所造的，使万物，就是一切的牛羊、田野的兽、空中的鸟、海里的鱼，凡经行海道的，都服在他的脚下。
8.en: You made him ruler over the works of your hands; you put everything under his feet:
all flocks and herds, and the beasts of the field,
the birds of the air, and the fish of the sea, all that swim the paths of the seas.

8.zh: 耶和华─我们的主啊，你的名在全地何其美！
8.en: O Lord , our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

9.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用慕拉便。）我要一心称谢耶和华；我要传扬你一切奇妙的作为。
9.en: I will praise you, O Lord , with all my heart; I will tell of all your wonders.

9.zh: 我要因你欢喜快乐；至高者啊，我要歌颂你的名！
9.en: I will be glad and rejoice in you; I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

9.zh: 我的仇敌转身退去的时候，他们一见你的面就跌倒灭亡。
9.en: My enemies turn back; they stumble and perish before you.

9.zh: 因你已经为我伸冤，为我辨屈；你坐在宝座上，按公义审判。
9.en: For you have upheld my right and my cause; you have sat on your throne, judging righteously.

9.zh: 你曾斥责外邦，你曾灭绝恶人；你曾涂抹他们的名，直到永永远远。
9.en: You have rebuked the nations and destroyed the wicked; you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

9.zh: 仇敌到了尽头；他们被毁坏，直到永远。你拆毁他们的城邑，连他们的名号都归于无有。
9.en: Endless ruin has overtaken the enemy, you have uprooted their cities; even the memory of them has perished.

9.zh: 惟耶和华坐著为王，直到永远；他已经为审判设摆他的宝座。
9.en: The Lord reigns forever; he has established his throne for judgment.

9.zh: 他要按公义审判世界，按正直判断万民。
9.en: He will judge the world in righteousness; he will govern the peoples with justice.

9.zh: 耶和华又要给受欺压的人作高台，在患难的时候作高台。
9.en: The Lord is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，认识你名的人要倚靠你，因你没有离弃寻求你的人。
9.en: Those who know your name will trust in you, for you, Lord , have never forsaken those who seek you.

9.zh: 应当歌颂居锡安的耶和华，将他所行的传扬在众民中。
9.en: Sing praises to the Lord , enthroned in Zion; proclaim among the nations what he has done.

9.zh: 因为那追讨流人血之罪的─他记念受屈的人，不忘记困苦人的哀求。
9.en: For he who avenges blood remembers; he does not ignore the cry of the afflicted.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，你是从死门把我提拔起来的；求你怜恤我，看那恨我的人所加给我的苦难，
9.en: O Lord , see how my enemies persecute me! Have mercy and lift me up from the gates of death,

9.zh: 好叫我述说你一切的美德；我必在锡安城（原文是女子）的门因你的救恩欢乐。
9.en: that I may declare your praises in the gates of the Daughter of Zion and there rejoice in your salvation.

9.zh: 外邦人陷在自己所掘的坑中；他们的脚在自己暗设的网罗里缠住了。
9.en: The nations have fallen into the pit they have dug; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.

9.zh: 耶和华已将自己显明了，他已施行审判；恶人被自己手所做的缠住了（或译：他叫恶人被自己手所做的累住了）。（细拉）
9.en: The Lord is known by his justice; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion. Selah

9.zh: 恶人，就是忘记神的外邦人，都必归到阴间。
9.en: The wicked return to the grave, all the nations that forget God.

9.zh: 穷乏人必不永久被忘；困苦人的指望必不永远落空。
9.en: But the needy will not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the afflicted ever perish.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来，不容人得胜！愿外邦人在你面前受审判！
9.en: Arise, O Lord , let not man triumph; let the nations be judged in your presence.

9.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使外邦人恐惧；愿他们知道自己不过是人。（细拉）
9.en: Strike them with terror, O Lord ; let the nations know they are but men. Selah

10.zh: 耶和华啊，你为甚么站在远处？在患难的时候为甚么隐藏？
10.en: Why, O Lord , do you stand far off? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

10.zh: 恶人在骄横中把困苦人追得火急；愿他们陷在自己所设的计谋里。
10.en: In his arrogance the wicked man hunts down the weak, who are caught in the schemes he devises.

10.zh: 因为恶人以心愿自夸；贪财的背弃耶和华，并且轻慢他（或译：他祝福贪财的，却轻慢耶和华）。
10.en: He boasts of the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the Lord .

10.zh: 恶人面带骄傲，说：耶和华必不追究；他一切所想的都以为没有神。
10.en: In his pride the wicked does not seek him; in all his thoughts there is no room for God.

10.zh: 凡他所做的，时常稳固；你的审判超过他的眼界。至于他一切的敌人，他都向他们喷气。
10.en: His ways are always prosperous; he is haughty and your laws are far from him; he sneers at all his enemies.

10.zh: 他心里说：我必不动摇，世世代代不遭灾难。
10.en: He says to himself, "Nothing will shake me; I'll always be happy and never have trouble."

10.zh: 他满口是咒骂、诡诈、欺压，舌底是毒害、奸恶。
10.en: His mouth is full of curses and lies and threats; trouble and evil are under his tongue.

10.zh: 他在村庄埋伏等候；他在隐密处杀害无辜的人。他的眼睛窥探无倚无靠的人；
10.en: He lies in wait near the villages; from ambush he murders the innocent, watching in secret for his victims.

10.zh: 他埋伏在暗地，如狮子蹲在洞中。他埋伏，要掳去困苦人；他拉网，就把困苦人掳去。
10.en: He lies in wait like a lion in cover; he lies in wait to catch the helpless; he catches the helpless and drags them off in his net.

10.zh: 他屈身蹲伏，无倚无靠的人就倒在他爪牙（爪牙：或译强暴人）之下。
10.en: His victims are crushed, they collapse; they fall under his strength.

10.zh: 他心里说：神竟忘记了；他掩面永不观看。
10.en: He says to himself, "God has forgotten; he covers his face and never sees."

10.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来！神啊，求你举手，不要忘记困苦人！
10.en: Arise, Lord ! Lift up your hand, O God. Do not forget the helpless.

10.zh: 恶人为何轻慢神，心里说：你必不追究？
10.en: Why does the wicked man revile God? Why does he say to himself, "He won't call me to account"?

10.zh: 其实你已经观看；因为奸恶毒害，你都看见了，为要以手施行报应。无倚无靠的人把自己交托你；你向来是帮助孤儿的。
10.en: But you, O God, do see trouble and grief; you consider it to take it in hand. The victim commits himself to you; you are the helper of the fatherless.

10.zh: 愿你打断恶人的膀臂；至于坏人，愿你追究他的恶，直到净尽。
10.en: Break the arm of the wicked and evil man; call him to account for his wickedness that would not be found out.

10.zh: 耶和华永永远远为王；外邦人从他的地已经灭绝了。
10.en: The Lord is King for ever and ever; the nations will perish from his land.

10.zh: 耶和华啊，谦卑人的心愿，你早已知道（原文是听见）。你必预备他们的心，也必侧耳听他们的祈求，
10.en: You hear, O Lord , the desire of the afflicted; you encourage them, and you listen to their cry,

10.zh: 为要给孤儿和受欺压的人伸冤，使强横的人不再威吓他们。
10.en: defending the fatherless and the oppressed, in order that man, who is of the earth, may terrify no more.

11.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）我是投靠耶和华；你们怎么对我说：你当像鸟飞往你的山去。
11.en: In the Lord I take refuge. How then can you say to me: "Flee like a bird to your mountain.

11.zh: 看哪，恶人弯弓，把箭搭在弦上，要在暗中射那心里正直的人。
11.en: For look, the wicked bend their bows; they set their arrows against the strings to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.

11.zh: 根基若毁坏，义人还能做甚么呢？
11.en: When the foundations are being destroyed, what can the righteous do ?"

11.zh: 耶和华在他的圣殿里；耶和华的宝座在天上；他的慧眼察看世人。
11.en: The Lord is in his holy temple; the Lord is on his heavenly throne. He observes the sons of men; his eyes examine them.

11.zh: 耶和华试验义人；惟有恶人和喜爱强暴的人，他心里恨恶。
11.en: The Lord examines the righteous, but the wicked and those who love violence his soul hates.

11.zh: 他要向恶人密布网罗；有烈火、硫磺、热风，作他们杯中的分。
11.en: On the wicked he will rain fiery coals and burning sulfur; a scorching wind will be their lot.

11.zh: 因为耶和华是公义的，他喜爱公义；正直人必得见他的面。
11.en: For the Lord is righteous, he loves justice; upright men will see his face.

12.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用第八。）耶和华啊，求你帮助，因虔诚人断绝了；世人中间的忠信人没有了。
12.en: Help, Lord , for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.

12.zh: 人人向邻舍说谎；他们说话，是嘴唇油滑，心口不一。
12.en: Everyone lies to his neighbor; their flattering lips speak with deception.

12.zh: 凡油滑的嘴唇和夸大的舌头，耶和华必要剪除。
12.en: May the Lord cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue

12.zh: 他们曾说：我们必能以舌头得胜；我们的嘴唇是我们自己的，谁能作我们的主呢？
12.en: that says, "We will triumph with our tongues; we own our lips -who is our master?"

12.zh: 耶和华说：因为困苦人的冤屈和贫穷人的叹息，我现在要起来，把他安置在他所切慕的稳妥之地。
12.en: "Because of the oppression of the weak and the groaning of the needy, I will now arise," says the Lord . "I will protect them from those who malign them."

12.zh: 耶和华的言语是纯净的言语，如同银子在泥炉中炼过七次。
12.en: And the words of the Lord are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace of clay, purified seven times.

12.zh: 耶和华啊，你必保护他们；你必保佑他们永远脱离这世代的人。
12.en: O Lord , you will keep us safe and protect us from such people forever.

12.zh: 下流人在世人中升高，就有恶人到处游行。
12.en: The wicked freely strut about when what is vile is honored among men.

13.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，你忘记我要到几时呢？要到永远么？你掩面不顾我要到几时呢？
13.en: How long, O Lord ? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

13.zh: 我心里筹算，终日愁苦，要到几时呢？我的仇敌升高压制我，要到几时呢？
13.en: How long must I wrestle with my thoughts and every day have sorrow in my heart? How long will my enemy triumph over me?

13.zh: 耶和华─我的神啊，求你看顾我，应允我！使我眼目光明，免得我沉睡至死；
13.en: Look on me and answer, O Lord my God. Give light to my eyes, or I will sleep in death;

13.zh: 免得我的仇敌说：我胜了他；免得我的敌人在我摇动的时候喜乐。
13.en: my enemy will say, "I have overcome him," and my foes will rejoice when I fall.

13.zh: 但我倚靠你的慈爱；我的心因你的救恩快乐。
13.en: But I trust in your unfailing love; my heart rejoices in your salvation.

13.zh: 我要向耶和华歌唱，因他用厚恩待我。
13.en: I will sing to the Lord , for he has been good to me.

14.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）愚顽人心里说：没有神。他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的事；没有一个人行善。
14.en: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, their deeds are vile; there is no one who does good.

14.zh: 耶和华从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有，有寻求神的没有。
14.en: The Lord looks down from heaven on the sons of men to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

14.zh: 他们都偏离正路，一同变为污秽；并没有行善的，连一个也没有。
14.en: All have turned aside, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

14.zh: 作孽的都没有知识么？他们吞吃我的百姓，如同吃饭一样，并不求告耶和华。
14.en: Will evildoers never learn- those who devour my people as men eat bread and who do not call on the Lord ?

14.zh: 他们在那里大大地害怕，因为神在义人的族类中。
14.en: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is present in the company of the righteous.

14.zh: 你们叫困苦人的谋算变为羞辱；然而耶和华是他的避难所。
14.en: You evildoers frustrate the plans of the poor, but the Lord is their refuge.

14.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。耶和华救回他被掳的子民那时，雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
14.en: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When the Lord restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

15.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，谁能寄居你的帐幕？谁能住在你的圣山？
15.en: Lord , who may dwell in your sanctuary? Who may live on your holy hill?

15.zh: 就是行为正直、做事公义、心里说实话的人。
15.en: He whose walk is blameless and who does what is righteous, who speaks the truth from his heart

15.zh: 他不以舌头谗谤人，不恶待朋友，也不随伙毁谤邻里。
15.en: and has no slander on his tongue, who does his neighbor no wrong and casts no slur on his fellowman,

15.zh: 他眼中藐视匪类，却尊重那敬畏耶和华的人。他发了誓，虽然自己吃亏也不更改。
15.en: who despises a vile man but honors those who fear the Lord , who keeps his oath even when it hurts,

15.zh: 他不放债取利，不受贿赂以害无辜。行这些事的人必永不动摇。
15.en: who lends his money without usury and does not accept a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.

16.zh: （大卫的金诗。）神啊，求你保佑我，因为我投靠你。
16.en: Keep me safe, O God, for in you I take refuge.

16.zh: 我的心哪，你曾对耶和华说：你是我的主；我的好处不在你以外。
16.en: I said to the Lord , "You are my Lord; apart from you I have no good thing."

16.zh: 论到世上的圣民，他们又美又善，是我最喜悦的。
16.en: As for the saints who are in the land, they are the glorious ones in whom is all my delight.

16.zh: 以别神代替耶和华的（或译：送礼物给别　神的），他们的愁苦必加增；他们所浇奠的血我不献上；我嘴唇也不提别　神的名号。
16.en: The sorrows of those will increase who run after other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood or take up their names on my lips.

16.zh: 耶和华是我的产业，是我杯中的分；我所得的，你为我持守。
16.en: Lord , you have assigned me my portion and my cup; you have made my lot secure.

16.zh: 用绳量给我的地界，坐落在佳美之处；我的产业实在美好。
16.en: The boundary lines have fallen for me in pleasant places; surely I have a delightful inheritance.

16.zh: 我必称颂那指教我的耶和华；我的心肠在夜间也警戒我。
16.en: I will praise the Lord , who counsels me; even at night my heart instructs me.

16.zh: 我将耶和华常摆在我面前，因他在我右边，我便不致摇动。
16.en: I have set the Lord always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

16.zh: 因此，我的心欢喜，我的灵（原文是荣耀）快乐；我的肉身也要安然居住。
16.en: Therefore my heart is glad and my tongue rejoices; my body also will rest secure,

16.zh: 因为你必不将我的灵魂撇在阴间，也不叫你的圣者见朽坏。
16.en: because you will not abandon me to the grave, nor will you let your Holy One see decay.

16.zh: 你必将生命的道路指示我。在你面前有满足的喜乐；在你右手中有永远的福乐。
16.en: You have made known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

17.zh: （大卫的祈祷。）耶和华啊，求你听闻公义，侧耳听我的呼吁！求你留心听我这不出于诡诈嘴唇的祈祷！
17.en: Hear, O Lord , my righteous plea; listen to my cry. Give ear to my prayer- it does not rise from deceitful lips.

17.zh: 愿我的判语从你面前发出；愿你的眼睛观看公正。
17.en: May my vindication come from you; may your eyes see what is right.

17.zh: 你已经试验我的心；你在夜间鉴察我；你熬炼我，却找不著甚么；我立志叫我口中没有过失。
17.en: Though you probe my heart and examine me at night, though you test me, you will find nothing; I have resolved that my mouth will not sin.

17.zh: 论到人的行为，我藉著你嘴唇的言语自己谨守，不行强暴人的道路。
17.en: As for the deeds of men- by the word of your lips I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

17.zh: 我的脚踏定了你的路径；我的两脚未曾滑跌。
17.en: My steps have held to your paths; my feet have not slipped.

17.zh: 神啊，我曾求告你，因为你必应允我；求你向我侧耳，听我的言语。
17.en: I call on you, O God, for you will answer me; give ear to me and hear my prayer.

17.zh: 求你显出你奇妙的慈爱来；你是那用右手拯救投靠你的脱离起来攻击他们的人。
17.en: Show the wonder of your great love, you who save by your right hand those who take refuge in you from their foes.

17.zh: 求你保护我，如同保护眼中的瞳人；将我隐藏在你翅膀的荫下，
17.en: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings

17.zh: 使我脱离那欺压我的恶人，就是围困我要害我命的仇敌。
17.en: from the wicked who assail me, from my mortal enemies who surround me.

17.zh: 他们的心被脂油包裹；他们用口说骄傲的话。
17.en: They close up their callous hearts, and their mouths speak with arrogance.

17.zh: 他们围困了我们的脚步；他们瞪著眼，要把我们推倒在地。
17.en: They have tracked me down, they now surround me, with eyes alert, to throw me to the ground.

17.zh: 他像狮子急要抓食，又像少壮狮子蹲伏在暗处。
17.en: They are like a lion hungry for prey, like a great lion crouching in cover.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，求你起来，前去迎敌，将他打倒！用你的刀救护我命脱离恶人。
17.en: Rise up, O Lord , confront them, bring them down; rescue me from the wicked by your sword.

17.zh: 耶和华啊，求你用手救我脱离世人，脱离那只在今生有福分的世人！你把你的财宝充满他们的肚腹；他们因有儿女就心满意足，将其余的财物留给他们的婴孩。
17.en: O Lord , by your hand save me from such men, from men of this world whose reward is in this life. You still the hunger of those you cherish; their sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

17.zh: 至于我，我必在义中见你的面；我醒了的时候，得见（或译：著）你的形像就心满意足了。
17.en: And I-in righteousness I will see your face; when I awake, I will be satisfied with seeing your likeness.

18.zh: （耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。当耶和华救他脱离一切仇敌和扫罗之手的日子，他向耶和华念这诗的话。说：）耶和华，我的力量啊，我爱你！
18.en: I love you, O Lord , my strength.

18.zh: 耶和华是我的岩石，我的山寨，我的救主，我的神，我的磐石，我所投靠的。他是我的盾牌，是拯救我的角，是我的高台。
18.en: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge. He is my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

18.zh: 我要求告当赞美的耶和华；这样我必从仇敌手中被救出来。
18.en: I call to the Lord , who is worthy of praise, and I am saved from my enemies.

18.zh: 曾有死亡的绳索缠绕我，匪类的急流使我惊惧，
18.en: The cords of death entangled me; the torrents of destruction overwhelmed me.

18.zh: 阴间的绳索缠绕我，死亡的网罗临到我。
18.en: The cords of the grave coiled around me; the snares of death confronted me.

18.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，向我的神呼求。他从殿中听了我的声音；我在他面前的呼求入了他的耳中。
18.en: In my distress I called to the Lord ; I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice; my cry came before him, into his ears.

18.zh: 那时，因他发怒，地就摇撼战抖；山的根基也震动摇撼。
18.en: The earth trembled and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains shook; they trembled because he was angry.

18.zh: 从他鼻孔冒烟上腾；从他口中发火焚烧，连炭也著了。
18.en: Smoke rose from his nostrils; consuming fire came from his mouth, burning coals blazed out of it.

18.zh: 他又使天下垂，亲自降临，有黑云在他脚下。
18.en: He parted the heavens and came down; dark clouds were under his feet.

18.zh: 他坐著基路伯飞行；他藉著风的翅膀快飞。
18.en: He mounted the cherubim and flew; he soared on the wings of the wind.

18.zh: 他以黑暗为藏身之处，以水的黑暗、天空的厚云为他四围的行宫。
18.en: He made darkness his covering, his canopy around him- the dark rain clouds of the sky.

18.zh: 因他面前的光辉，他的厚云行过便有冰雹火炭。
18.en: Out of the brightness of his presence clouds advanced, with hailstones and bolts of lightning.

18.zh: 耶和华也在天上打雷；至高者发出声音便有冰雹火炭。
18.en: The Lord thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded.

18.zh: 他射出箭来，使仇敌四散；多多发出闪电，使他们扰乱。
18.en: He shot his arrows and scattered the enemies , great bolts of lightning and routed them.

18.zh: 耶和华啊，你的斥责一发，你鼻孔的气一出，海底就出现，大地的根基也显露。
18.en: The valleys of the sea were exposed and the foundations of the earth laid bare at your rebuke, O Lord , at the blast of breath from your nostrils.

18.zh: 他从高天伸手抓住我，把我从大水中拉上来。
18.en: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; he drew me out of deep waters.

18.zh: 他救我脱离我的劲敌和那些恨我的人，因为他们比我强盛。
18.en: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

18.zh: 我遭遇灾难的日子，他们来攻击我；但耶和华是我的倚靠。
18.en: They confronted me in the day of my disaster, but the Lord was my support.

18.zh: 他又领我到宽阔之处；他救拔我，因他喜悦我。
18.en: He brought me out into a spacious place; he rescued me because he delighted in me.

18.zh: 耶和华按著我的公义报答我，按著我手中的清洁赏赐我。
18.en: The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

18.zh: 因为我遵守了耶和华的道，未曾作恶离开我的神。
18.en: For I have kept the ways of the Lord ; I have not done evil by turning from my God.

18.zh: 他的一切典章常在我面前；他的律例我也未曾丢弃。
18.en: All his laws are before me; I have not turned away from his decrees.

18.zh: 我在他面前作了完全人；我也保守自己远离我的罪孽。
18.en: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

18.zh: 所以，耶和华按我的公义，按我在他眼前手中的清洁偿还我。
18.en: The Lord has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

18.zh: 慈爱的人，你以慈爱待他；完全的人，你以完全待他。
18.en: To the faithful you show yourself faithful, to the blameless you show yourself blameless,

18.zh: 清洁的人，你以清洁待他；乖僻的人，你以弯曲待他。
18.en: to the pure you show yourself pure, but to the crooked you show yourself shrewd.

18.zh: 困苦的百姓，你必拯救；高傲的眼目，你必使他降卑。
18.en: You save the humble but bring low those whose eyes are haughty.

18.zh: 你必点著我的灯；耶和华─我的神必照明我的黑暗。
18.en: You, O Lord , keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

18.zh: 我藉著你冲入敌军，藉著我的神跳过墙垣。
18.en: With your help I can advance against a troop ; with my God I can scale a wall.

18.zh: 至于神，他的道是完全的；耶和华的话是炼净的。凡投靠他的，他便作他们的盾牌。
18.en: As for God, his way is perfect; the word of the Lord is flawless. He is a shield for all who take refuge in him.

18.zh: 除了耶和华，谁是神呢？除了我们的　神，谁是磐石呢？
18.en: For who is God besides the Lord ? And who is the Rock except our God?

18.zh: 惟有那以力量束我的腰、使我行为完全的，他是神。
18.en: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way perfect.

18.zh: 他使我的脚快如母鹿的蹄，又使我在高处安稳。
18.en: He makes my feet like the feet of a deer; he enables me to stand on the heights.

18.zh: 他教导我的手能以争战，甚至我的膀臂能开铜弓。
18.en: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.

18.zh: 你把你的救恩给我作盾牌；你的右手扶持我；你的温和使我为大。
18.en: You give me your shield of victory, and your right hand sustains me; you stoop down to make me great.

18.zh: 你使我脚下的地步宽阔；我的脚未曾滑跌。
18.en: You broaden the path beneath me, so that my ankles do not turn.

18.zh: 我要追赶我的仇敌，并要追上他们；不将他们灭绝，我总不归回。
18.en: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back till they were destroyed.

18.zh: 我要打伤他们，使他们不能起来；他们必倒在我的脚下。
18.en: I crushed them so that they could not rise; they fell beneath my feet.

18.zh: 因为你曾以力量束我的腰，使我能争战；你也使那起来攻击我的都服在我以下。
18.en: You armed me with strength for battle; you made my adversaries bow at my feet.

18.zh: 你又使我的仇敌在我面前转背逃跑，叫我能以剪除那恨我的人。
18.en: You made my enemies turn their backs in flight, and I destroyed my foes.

18.zh: 他们呼求，却无人拯救；就是呼求耶和华，他也不应允。
18.en: They cried for help, but there was no one to save them- to the Lord , but he did not answer.

18.zh: 我捣碎他们，如同风前的灰尘，倒出他们，如同街上的泥土。
18.en: I beat them as fine as dust borne on the wind; I poured them out like mud in the streets.

18.zh: 你救我脱离百姓的争竞，立我作列国的元首；我素不认识的民必事奉我。
18.en: You have delivered me from the attacks of the people; you have made me the head of nations; people I did not know are subject to me.

18.zh: 他们一听见我的名声就必顺从我；外邦人要投降我。
18.en: As soon as they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cringe before me.

18.zh: 外邦人要衰残，战战兢兢地出他们的营寨。
18.en: They all lose heart; they come trembling from their strongholds.

18.zh: 耶和华是活神。愿我的磐石被人称颂；愿救我的神被人尊崇。
18.en: The Lord lives! Praise be to my Rock! Exalted be God my Savior!

18.zh: 这位神，就是那为我伸冤、使众民服在我以下的。
18.en: He is the God who avenges me, who subdues nations under me,

18.zh: 你救我脱离仇敌，又把我举起，高过那些起来攻击我的；你救我脱离强暴的人。
18.en: who saves me from my enemies. You exalted me above my foes; from violent men you rescued me.

18.zh: 耶和华啊，因此我要在外邦中称谢你，歌颂你的名。
18.en: Therefore I will praise you among the nations, O Lord ; I will sing praises to your name.

18.zh: 耶和华赐极大的救恩给他所立的王，施慈爱给他的受膏者，就是给大卫和他的后裔，直到永远。
18.en: He gives his king great victories; he shows unfailing kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants forever.

19.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）诸天述说神的荣耀；穹苍传扬他的手段。
19.en: The heavens declare the glory of God; the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

19.zh: 这日到那日发出言语；这夜到那夜传出知识。
19.en: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they display knowledge.

19.zh: 无言无语，也无声音可听。
19.en: There is no speech or language where their voice is not heard.

19.zh: 他的量带通遍天下，他的言语传到地极。神在其间为太阳安设帐幕；
19.en: Their voice goes out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens he has pitched a tent for the sun,

19.zh: 太阳如同新郎出洞房，又如勇士欢然奔路。
19.en: which is like a bridegroom coming forth from his pavilion, like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

19.zh: 他从天这边出来，绕到天那边，没有一物被隐藏不得他的热气。
19.en: It rises at one end of the heavens and makes its circuit to the other; nothing is hidden from its heat.

19.zh: 耶和华的律法全备，能苏醒人心；耶和华的法度确定，能使愚人有智慧。
19.en: The law of the Lord is perfect, reviving the soul. The statutes of the Lord are trustworthy, making wise the simple.

19.zh: 耶和华的训词正直，能快活人的心；耶和华的命令清洁，能明亮人的眼目。
19.en: The precepts of the Lord are right, giving joy to the heart. The commands of the Lord are radiant, giving light to the eyes.

19.zh: 耶和华的道理洁净，存到永远；耶和华的典章真实，全然公义─
19.en: The fear of the Lord is pure, enduring forever. The ordinances of the Lord are sure and altogether righteous.

19.zh: 都比金子可羡慕，且比极多的精金可羡慕；比蜜甘甜，且比蜂房下滴的蜜甘甜。
19.en: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.

19.zh: 况且你的仆人因此受警戒，守著这些便有大赏。
19.en: By them is your servant warned; in keeping them there is great reward.

19.zh: 谁能知道自己的错失呢？愿你赦免我隐而未现的过错。
19.en: Who can discern his errors? Forgive my hidden faults.

19.zh: 求你拦阻仆人不犯任意妄为的罪，不容这罪辖制我，我便完全，免犯大罪。
19.en: Keep your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then will I be blameless, innocent of great transgression.

19.zh: 耶和华─我的磐石，我的救赎主啊，愿我口中的言语、心里的意念在你面前蒙悦纳。
19.en: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in your sight, O Lord , my Rock and my Redeemer.

20.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）愿耶和华在你遭难的日子应允你；愿名为雅各神的高举你。
20.en: May the Lord answer you when you are in distress; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

20.zh: 愿他从圣所救助你，从锡安坚固你，
20.en: May he send you help from the sanctuary and grant you support from Zion.

20.zh: 记念你的一切供献，悦纳你的燔祭，（细拉）
20.en: May he remember all your sacrifices and accept your burnt offerings. Selah

20.zh: 将你心所愿的赐给你，成就你的一切筹算。
20.en: May he give you the desire of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

20.zh: 我们要因你的救恩夸胜，要奉我们神的名竖立旌旗。愿耶和华成就你一切所求的！
20.en: We will shout for joy when you are victorious and will lift up our banners in the name of our God. May the Lord grant all your requests.

20.zh: 现在我知道耶和华救护他的受膏者，必从他的圣天上应允他，用右手的能力救护他。
20.en: Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed; he answers him from his holy heaven with the saving power of his right hand.

20.zh: 有人靠车，有人靠马，但我们要提到耶和华─我们神的名。
20.en: Some trust in chariots and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the Lord our God.

20.zh: 他们都屈身仆倒，我们却起来，立得正直。
20.en: They are brought to their knees and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.

20.zh: 求耶和华施行拯救；我们呼求的时候，愿王应允我们！
20.en: O Lord , save the king! Answer us when we call!

21.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，王必因你的能力欢喜；因你的救恩，他的快乐何其大！
21.en: O Lord , the king rejoices in your strength. How great is his joy in the victories you give!

21.zh: 他心里所愿的，你已经赐给他；他嘴唇所求的，你未尝不应允。（细拉）
21.en: You have granted him the desire of his heart and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah

21.zh: 你以美福迎接他，把精金的冠冕戴在他头上。
21.en: You welcomed him with rich blessings and placed a crown of pure gold on his head.

21.zh: 他向你求寿，你便赐给他，就是日子长久，直到永远。
21.en: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him- length of days, for ever and ever.

21.zh: 他因你的救恩大有荣耀；你又将尊荣威严加在他身上。
21.en: Through the victories you gave, his glory is great; you have bestowed on him splendor and majesty.

21.zh: 你使他有洪福，直到永远，又使他在你面前欢喜快乐。
21.en: Surely you have granted him eternal blessings and made him glad with the joy of your presence.

21.zh: 王倚靠耶和华，因至高者的慈爱必不摇动。
21.en: For the king trusts in the Lord ; through the unfailing love of the Most High he will not be shaken.

21.zh: 你的手要搜出你的一切仇敌；你的右手要搜出那些恨你的人。
21.en: Your hand will lay hold on all your enemies; your right hand will seize your foes.

21.zh: 你发怒的时候，要使他们如在炎热的火炉中。耶和华要在他的震怒中吞灭他们；那火要把他们烧尽了。
21.en: At the time of your appearing you will make them like a fiery furnace. In his wrath the Lord will swallow them up, and his fire will consume them.

21.zh: 你必从世上灭绝他们的子孙（原文是果子），从人间灭绝他们的后裔。
21.en: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from mankind.

21.zh: 因为他们有意加害于你；他们想出计谋，却不能做成。
21.en: Though they plot evil against you and devise wicked schemes, they cannot succeed;

21.zh: 你必使他们转背逃跑，向他们的脸搭箭在弦。
21.en: for you will make them turn their backs when you aim at them with drawn bow.

21.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你因自己的能力显为至高！这样，我们就唱诗，歌颂你的大能。
21.en: Be exalted, O Lord , in your strength; we will sing and praise your might.

22.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用朝鹿。）我的神，我的神！为甚么离弃我？为甚么远离不救我？不听我唉哼的言语？
22.en: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from saving me, so far from the words of my groaning?

22.zh: 我的神啊，我白日呼求，你不应允，夜间呼求，并不住声。
22.en: O my God, I cry out by day, but you do not answer, by night, and am not silent.

22.zh: 但你是圣洁的，是用以色列的赞美为宝座（或译：居所）的。
22.en: Yet you are enthroned as the Holy One; you are the praise of Israel.

22.zh: 我们的祖宗倚靠你；他们倚靠你，你便解救他们。
22.en: In you our fathers put their trust; they trusted and you delivered them.

22.zh: 他们哀求你，便蒙解救；他们倚靠你，就不羞愧。
22.en: They cried to you and were saved; in you they trusted and were not disappointed.

22.zh: 但我是虫，不是人，被众人羞辱，被百姓藐视。
22.en: But I am a worm and not a man, scorned by men and despised by the people.

22.zh: 凡看见我的都嗤笑我；他们撇嘴摇头，说：
22.en: All who see me mock me; they hurl insults, shaking their heads:

22.zh: 他把自己交托耶和华，耶和华可以救他罢！耶和华既喜悦他，可以搭救他罢！
22.en: "He trusts in the Lord ; let the Lord rescue him. Let him deliver him, since he delights in him."

22.zh: 但你是叫我出母腹的；我在母怀里，你就使我有倚靠的心。
22.en: Yet you brought me out of the womb; you made me trust in you even at my mother's breast.

22.zh: 我自出母胎就被交在你手里；从我母亲生我，你就是我的神。
22.en: From birth I was cast upon you; from my mother's womb you have been my God.

22.zh: 求你不要远离我！因为急难临近了，没有人帮助我。
22.en: Do not be far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.

22.zh: 有许多公牛围绕我，巴珊大力的公牛四面困住我。
22.en: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.

22.zh: 他们向我张口，好像抓撕吼叫的狮子。
22.en: Roaring lions tearing their prey open their mouths wide against me.

22.zh: 我如水被倒出来；我的骨头都脱了节；我心在我里面如蜡镕化。
22.en: I am poured out like water, and all my bones are out of joint. My heart has turned to wax; it has melted away within me.

22.zh: 我的精力枯干，如同瓦片；我的舌头贴在我牙床上。你将我安置在死地的尘土中。
22.en: My strength is dried up like a potsherd, and my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth; you lay me in the dust of death.

22.zh: 犬类围著我，恶党环绕我；他们扎了我的手，我的脚。
22.en: Dogs have surrounded me; a band of evil men has encircled me, they have pierced my hands and my feet.

22.zh: 我的骨头，我都能数过；他们瞪著眼看我。
22.en: I can count all my bones; people stare and gloat over me.

22.zh: 他们分我的外衣，为我的里衣拈阄。
22.en: They divide my garments among them and cast lots for my clothing.

22.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要远离我！我的救主啊，求你快来帮助我！
22.en: But you, O Lord , be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.

22.zh: 求你救我的灵魂脱离刀剑，救我的生命（生命：原文是独一者）脱离犬类，
22.en: Deliver my life from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dogs.

22.zh: 救我脱离狮子的口；你已经应允我，使我脱离野牛的角。
22.en: Rescue me from the mouth of the lions; save me from the horns of the wild oxen.

22.zh: 我要将你的名传与我的弟兄，在会中我要赞美你。
22.en: I will declare your name to my brothers; in the congregation I will praise you.

22.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的人要赞美他！雅各的后裔都要荣耀他！以色列的后裔都要惧怕他！
22.en: You who fear the Lord , praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, honor him! Revere him, all you descendants of Israel!

22.zh: 因为他没有藐视憎恶受苦的人，也没有向他掩面；那受苦之人呼吁的时候，他就垂听。
22.en: For he has not despised or disdained the suffering of the afflicted one; he has not hidden his face from him but has listened to his cry for help.

22.zh: 我在大会中赞美你的话是从你而来的；我要在敬畏耶和华的人面前还我的愿。
22.en: From you comes the theme of my praise in the great assembly; before those who fear you will I fulfill my vows.

22.zh: 谦卑的人必吃得饱足；寻求耶和华的人必赞美他。愿你们的心永远活著！
22.en: The poor will eat and be satisfied; they who seek the Lord will praise him- may your hearts live forever!

22.zh: 地的四极都要想念耶和华，并且归顺他；列国的万族都要在你面前敬拜。
22.en: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the Lord , and all the families of the nations will bow down before him,

22.zh: 因为国权是耶和华的；他是管理万国的。
22.en: for dominion belongs to the Lord and he rules over the nations.

22.zh: 地上一切丰肥的人必吃喝而敬拜；凡下到尘土中─不能存活自己性命的人─都要在他面前下拜。
22.en: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before him- those who cannot keep themselves alive.

22.zh: 他必有后裔事奉他；主所行的事必传与后代。
22.en: Posterity will serve him; future generations will be told about the Lord.

22.zh: 他们必来把他的公义传给将要生的民，言明这事是他所行的。
22.en: They will proclaim his righteousness to a people yet unborn- for he has done it.

23.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华是我的牧者，我必不致缺乏。
23.en: The Lord is my shepherd, I shall not be in want.

23.zh: 他使我躺卧在青草地上，领我在可安歇的水边。
23.en: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters,

23.zh: 他使我的灵魂苏醒，为自己的名引导我走义路。
23.en: he restores my soul. He guides me in paths of righteousness for his name's sake.

23.zh: 我虽然行过死荫的幽谷，也不怕遭害，因为你与我同在；你的杖，你的竿，都安慰我。
23.en: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

23.zh: 在我敌人面前，你为我摆设筵席；你用油膏了我的头，使我的福杯满溢。
23.en: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

23.zh: 我一生一世必有恩惠慈爱随著我；我且要住在耶和华的殿中，直到永远。
23.en: Surely goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

24.zh: （大卫的诗。）地和其中所充满的，世界和住在其间的，都属耶和华。
24.en: The earth is the Lord 's, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it;

24.zh: 他把地建立在海上，安定在大水之上。
24.en: for he founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

24.zh: 谁能登耶和华的山？谁能站在他的圣所？
24.en: Who may ascend the hill of the Lord ? Who may stand in his holy place?

24.zh: 就是手洁心清、不向虚妄、起誓不怀诡诈的人。
24.en: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear by what is false.

24.zh: 他必蒙耶和华赐福，又蒙救他的神使他成义。
24.en: He will receive blessing from the Lord and vindication from God his Savior.

24.zh: 这是寻求耶和华的族类，是寻求你面的雅各。（细拉）
24.en: Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek your face, O God of Jacob. Selah

24.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！永久的门户，你们要被举起！那荣耀的王将要进来！
24.en: Lift up your heads, O you gates; be lifted up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

24.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？就是有力有能的耶和华，在战场上有能的耶和华！
24.en: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

24.zh: 众城门哪，你们要抬起头来！永久的门户，你们要把头抬起！那荣耀的王将要进来！
24.en: Lift up your heads, O you gates; lift them up, you ancient doors, that the King of glory may come in.

24.zh: 荣耀的王是谁呢？万军之耶和华，他是荣耀的王！（细拉）
24.en: Who is he, this King of glory? The Lord Almighty- he is the King of glory. Selah

25.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，我的心仰望你。
25.en: To you, O Lord , I lift up my soul;

25.zh: 我的神啊，我素来倚靠你；求你不要叫我羞愧，不要叫我的仇敌向我夸胜。
25.en: in you I trust, O my God. Do not let me be put to shame, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

25.zh: 凡等候你的必不羞愧；惟有那无故行奸诈的必要羞愧。
25.en: No one whose hope is in you will ever be put to shame, but they will be put to shame who are treacherous without excuse.

25.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指示我，将你的路教训我！
25.en: Show me your ways, O Lord , teach me your paths;

25.zh: 求你以你的真理引导我，教训我，因为你是救我的神。我终日等候你。
25.en: guide me in your truth and teach me, for you are God my Savior, and my hope is in you all day long.

25.zh: 耶和华啊，求你记念你的怜悯和慈爱，因为这是亘古以来所常有的。
25.en: Remember, O Lord , your great mercy and love, for they are from of old.

25.zh: 求你不要记念我幼年的罪愆和我的过犯；耶和华啊，求你因你的恩惠，按你的慈爱记念我。
25.en: Remember not the sins of my youth and my rebellious ways; according to your love remember me, for you are good, O Lord .

25.zh: 耶和华是良善正直的，所以他必指示罪人走正路。
25.en: Good and upright is the Lord ; therefore he instructs sinners in his ways.

25.zh: 他必按公平引领谦卑人，将他的道教训他们。
25.en: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them his way.

25.zh: 凡遵守他的约和他法度的人，耶和华都以慈爱诚实待他。
25.en: All the ways of the Lord are loving and faithful for those who keep the demands of his covenant.

25.zh: 耶和华啊，求你因你的名赦免我的罪，因为我的罪重大。
25.en: For the sake of your name, O Lord , forgive my iniquity, though it is great.

25.zh: 谁敬畏耶和华，耶和华必指示他当选择的道路。
25.en: Who, then, is the man that fears the Lord ? He will instruct him in the way chosen for him.

25.zh: 他必安然居住；他的后裔必承受地土。
25.en: He will spend his days in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

25.zh: 耶和华与敬畏他的人亲密；他必将自己的约指示他们。
25.en: The Lord confides in those who fear him; he makes his covenant known to them.

25.zh: 我的眼目时常仰望耶和华，因为他必将我的脚从网里拉出来。
25.en: My eyes are ever on the Lord , for only he will release my feet from the snare.

25.zh: 求你转向我，怜恤我，因为我是孤独困苦。
25.en: Turn to me and be gracious to me, for I am lonely and afflicted.

25.zh: 我心里的愁苦甚多，求你救我脱离我的祸患。
25.en: The troubles of my heart have multiplied; free me from my anguish.

25.zh: 求你看顾我的困苦，我的艰难，赦免我一切的罪。
25.en: Look upon my affliction and my distress and take away all my sins.

25.zh: 求你察看我的仇敌，因为他们人多，并且痛痛地恨我。
25.en: See how my enemies have increased and how fiercely they hate me!

25.zh: 求你保护我的性命，搭救我，使我不致羞愧，因为我投靠你。
25.en: Guard my life and rescue me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in you.

25.zh: 愿纯全、正直保守我，因为我等候你。
25.en: May integrity and uprightness protect me, because my hope is in you.

25.zh: 神啊，求你救赎以色列脱离他一切的愁苦。
25.en: Redeem Israel, O God, from all their troubles!

26.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，求你为我伸冤，因我向来行事纯全；我又倚靠耶和华，并不摇动。
26.en: Vindicate me, O Lord , for I have led a blameless life; I have trusted in the Lord without wavering.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，求你察看我，试验我，熬炼我的肺腑心肠。
26.en: Test me, O Lord , and try me, examine my heart and my mind;

26.zh: 因为你的慈爱常在我眼前，我也按你的真理而行。
26.en: for your love is ever before me, and I walk continually in your truth.

26.zh: 我没有和虚谎人同坐，也不与瞒哄人的同群。
26.en: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor do I consort with hypocrites;

26.zh: 我恨恶恶人的会，必不与恶人同坐。
26.en: I abhor the assembly of evildoers and refuse to sit with the wicked.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，我要洗手表明无辜，才环绕你的祭坛；
26.en: I wash my hands in innocence, and go about your altar, O Lord ,

26.zh: 我好发称谢的声音，也要述说你一切奇妙的作为。
26.en: proclaiming aloud your praise and telling of all your wonderful deeds.

26.zh: 耶和华啊，我喜爱你所住的殿和你显荣耀的居所。
26.en: I love the house where you live, O Lord , the place where your glory dwells.

26.zh: 不要把我的灵魂和罪人一同除掉；不要把我的性命和流人血的一同除掉。
26.en: Do not take away my soul along with sinners, my life with bloodthirsty men,

26.zh: 他们的手中有奸恶，右手满有贿赂。
26.en: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.

26.zh: 至于我，却要行事纯全；求你救赎我，怜恤我！
26.en: But I lead a blameless life; redeem me and be merciful to me.

26.zh: 我的脚站在平坦地方；在众会中我要称颂耶和华！
26.en: My feet stand on level ground; in the great assembly I will praise the Lord .

27.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华是我的亮光，是我的拯救，我还怕谁呢？耶和华是我性命的保障（或译：力量），我还惧谁呢？
27.en: The Lord is my light and my salvation- whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life- of whom shall I be afraid?

27.zh: 那作恶的就是我的仇敌，前来吃我肉的时候就绊跌仆倒。
27.en: When evil men advance against me to devour my flesh, when my enemies and my foes attack me, they will stumble and fall.

27.zh: 虽有军兵安营攻击我，我的心也不害怕；虽然兴起刀兵攻击我，我必仍旧安稳。
27.en: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then will I be confident.

27.zh: 有一件事，我曾求耶和华，我仍要寻求：就是一生一世住在耶和华的殿中，瞻仰他的荣美，在他的殿里求问。
27.en: One thing I ask of the Lord , this is what I seek: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to gaze upon the beauty of the Lord and to seek him in his temple.

27.zh: 因为我遭遇患难，他必暗暗地保守我；在他亭子里，把我藏在他帐幕的隐密处，将我高举在磐石上。
27.en: For in the day of trouble he will keep me safe in his dwelling; he will hide me in the shelter of his tabernacle and set me high upon a rock.

27.zh: 现在我得以昂首，高过四面的仇敌。我要在他的帐幕里欢然献祭；我要唱诗歌颂耶和华。
27.en: Then my head will be exalted above the enemies who surround me; at his tabernacle will I sacrifice with shouts of joy; I will sing and make music to the Lord .

27.zh: 耶和华啊，我用声音呼吁的时候，求你垂听；并求你怜恤我，应允我。
27.en: Hear my voice when I call, O Lord ; be merciful to me and answer me.

27.zh: 你说：你们当寻求我的面。那时我心向你说：耶和华啊，你的面我正要寻求。
27.en: My heart says of you, "Seek his face!" Your face, Lord , I will seek.

27.zh: 不要向我掩面。不要发怒赶逐仆人，你向来是帮助我的。救我的神啊，不要丢掉我，也不要离弃我。
27.en: Do not hide your face from me, do not turn your servant away in anger; you have been my helper. Do not reject me or forsake me, O God my Savior.

27.zh: 我父母离弃我，耶和华必收留我。
27.en: Though my father and mother forsake me, the Lord will receive me.

27.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我，因我仇敌的缘故引导我走平坦的路。
27.en: Teach me your way, O Lord ; lead me in a straight path because of my oppressors.

27.zh: 求你不要把我交给敌人，遂其所愿；因为妄作见证的和口吐凶言的，起来攻击我。
27.en: Do not turn me over to the desire of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.

27.zh: 我若不信在活人之地得见耶和华的恩惠，就早已丧胆了。
27.en: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

27.zh: 要等候耶和华！当壮胆，坚固你的心！我再说，要等候耶和华！
27.en: Wait for the Lord ; be strong and take heart and wait for the Lord .

28.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，我要求告你！我的磐石啊，不要向我缄默！倘若你向我闭口，我就如将死的人一样。
28.en: To you I call, O Lord my Rock; do not turn a deaf ear to me. For if you remain silent, I will be like those who have gone down to the pit.

28.zh: 我呼求你，向你至圣所举手的时候，求你垂听我恳求的声音！
28.en: Hear my cry for mercy as I call to you for help, as I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

28.zh: 不要把我和恶人并作孽的一同除掉；他们与邻舍说和平话，心里却是奸恶。
28.en: Do not drag me away with the wicked, with those who do evil, who speak cordially with their neighbors but harbor malice in their hearts.

28.zh: 愿你按著他们所做的，并他们所行的恶事待他们。愿你照著他们手所做的待他们，将他们所应得的报应加给他们。
28.en: Repay them for their deeds and for their evil work; repay them for what their hands have done and bring back upon them what they deserve.

28.zh: 他们既然不留心耶和华所行的和他手所做的，他就必毁坏他们，不建立他们。
28.en: Since they show no regard for the works of the Lord and what his hands have done, he will tear them down and never build them up again.

28.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他听了我恳求的声音。
28.en: Praise be to the Lord , for he has heard my cry for mercy.

28.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的盾牌；我心里倚靠他就得帮助。所以我心中欢乐，我必用诗歌颂赞他。
28.en: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and I am helped. My heart leaps for joy and I will give thanks to him in song.

28.zh: 耶和华是他百姓的力量，又是他受膏者得救的保障。
28.en: The Lord is the strength of his people, a fortress of salvation for his anointed one.

28.zh: 求你拯救你的百姓，赐福给你的产业，牧养他们，扶持他们，直到永远。
28.en: Save your people and bless your inheritance; be their shepherd and carry them forever.

29.zh: （大卫的诗。）神的众子啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华，归给耶和华！
29.en: Ascribe to the Lord , O mighty ones, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

29.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他，以圣洁的（的：或译为）妆饰敬拜耶和华。
29.en: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音发在水上；荣耀的神打雷，耶和华打雷在大水之上。
29.en: The voice of the Lord is over the waters; the God of glory thunders, the Lord thunders over the mighty waters.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音大有能力；耶和华的声音满有威严。
29.en: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is majestic.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音震破香柏树；耶和华震碎利巴嫩的香柏树。
29.en: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedars; the Lord breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

29.zh: 他也使之跳跃如牛犊，使利巴嫩和西连跳跃如野牛犊。
29.en: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, Sirion like a young wild ox.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音使火焰分岔。
29.en: The voice of the Lord strikes with flashes of lightning.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音震动旷野；耶和华震动加低斯的旷野。
29.en: The voice of the Lord shakes the desert; the Lord shakes the Desert of Kadesh.

29.zh: 耶和华的声音惊动母鹿落胎，树木也脱落净光。凡在他殿中的，都称说他的荣耀。
29.en: The voice of the Lord twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in his temple all cry, "Glory!"

29.zh: 洪水泛滥之时，耶和华坐著为王；耶和华坐著为王，直到永远。
29.en: The Lord sits enthroned over the flood; the Lord is enthroned as King forever.

29.zh: 耶和华必赐力量给他的百姓；耶和华必赐平安的福给他的百姓。
29.en: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

30.zh: （大卫在献殿的时候，作这诗歌。）耶和华啊，我要尊崇你，因为你曾提拔我，不叫仇敌向我夸耀。
30.en: I will exalt you, O Lord , for you lifted me out of the depths and did not let my enemies gloat over me.

30.zh: 耶和华─我的神啊，我曾呼求你，你医治了我。
30.en: O Lord my God, I called to you for help and you healed me.

30.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾把我的灵魂从阴间救上来，使我存活，不至于下坑。
30.en: O Lord , you brought me up from the grave ; you spared me from going down into the pit.

30.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们要歌颂他，称赞他可记念的圣名。
30.en: Sing to the Lord , you saints of his; praise his holy name.

30.zh: 因为，他的怒气不过是转眼之间；他的恩典乃是一生之久。一宿虽然有哭泣，早晨便必欢呼。
30.en: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may remain for a night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

30.zh: 至于我，我凡事平顺便说：我永不动摇。
30.en: When I felt secure, I said, "I will never be shaken."

30.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾施恩，叫我的江山稳固；你掩了面，我就惊惶。
30.en: O Lord , when you favored me, you made my mountain stand firm; but when you hid your face, I was dismayed.

30.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾求告你；我向耶和华恳求，说：
30.en: To you, O Lord , I called; to the Lord I cried for mercy:

30.zh: 我被害流血，下到坑中，有甚么益处呢？尘土岂能称赞你，传说你的诚实么？
30.en: "What gain is there in my destruction, in my going down into the pit? Will the dust praise you? Will it proclaim your faithfulness?

30.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我，怜恤我！耶和华啊，求你帮助我！
30.en: Hear, O Lord , and be merciful to me; O Lord , be my help."

30.zh: 你已将我的哀哭变为跳舞，将我的麻衣脱去，给我披上喜乐，
30.en: You turned my wailing into dancing; you removed my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,

30.zh: 好叫我的灵（原文是荣耀）歌颂你，并不住声。耶和华─我的神啊，我要称谢你，直到永远！
30.en: that my heart may sing to you and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give you thanks forever.

31.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，我投靠你；求你使我永不羞愧；凭你的公义搭救我！
31.en: In you, O Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; deliver me in your righteousness.

31.zh: 求你侧耳而听，快快救我！作我坚固的磐石，拯救我的保障！
31.en: Turn your ear to me, come quickly to my rescue; be my rock of refuge, a strong fortress to save me.

31.zh: 因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨；所以，求你为你名的缘故引导我，指点我。
31.en: Since you are my rock and my fortress, for the sake of your name lead and guide me.

31.zh: 求你救我脱离人为我暗设的网罗，因为你是我的保障。
31.en: Free me from the trap that is set for me, for you are my refuge.

31.zh: 我将我的灵魂交在你手里；耶和华诚实的神啊，你救赎了我。
31.en: Into your hands I commit my spirit; redeem me, O Lord , the God of truth.

31.zh: 我恨恶那信奉虚无之神的人；我却倚靠耶和华。
31.en: I hate those who cling to worthless idols; I trust in the Lord .

31.zh: 我要为你的慈爱高兴欢喜；因为你见过我的困苦，知道我心中的艰难。
31.en: I will be glad and rejoice in your love, for you saw my affliction and knew the anguish of my soul.

31.zh: 你未曾把我交在仇敌手里；你使我的脚站在宽阔之处。
31.en: You have not handed me over to the enemy but have set my feet in a spacious place.

31.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，因为我在急难之中；我的眼睛因忧愁而干瘪，连我的身心也不安舒。
31.en: Be merciful to me, O Lord , for I am in distress; my eyes grow weak with sorrow, my soul and my body with grief.

31.zh: 我的生命为愁苦所消耗；我的年岁为叹息所旷废。我的力量因我的罪孽衰败；我的骨头也枯干。
31.en: My life is consumed by anguish and my years by groaning; my strength fails because of my affliction, and my bones grow weak.

31.zh: 我因一切敌人成了羞辱，在我的邻舍跟前更甚；那认识我的都惧怕我，在外头看见我的都躲避我。
31.en: Because of all my enemies, I am the utter contempt of my neighbors; I am a dread to my friends- those who see me on the street flee from me.

31.zh: 我被人忘记，如同死人，无人记念；我好像破碎的器皿。
31.en: I am forgotten by them as though I were dead; I have become like broken pottery.

31.zh: 我听见了许多人的谗谤，四围都是惊吓；他们一同商议攻击我的时候，就图谋要害我的性命。
31.en: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side; they conspire against me and plot to take my life.

31.zh: 耶和华啊，我仍旧倚靠你；我说：你是我的神。
31.en: But I trust in you, O Lord ; I say, "You are my God."

31.zh: 我终身的事在你手中；求你救我脱离仇敌的手和那些逼迫我的人。
31.en: My times are in your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.

31.zh: 求你使你的脸光照仆人，凭你的慈爱拯救我。
31.en: Let your face shine on your servant; save me in your unfailing love.

31.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我不致羞愧，因为我曾呼吁你；求你使恶人羞愧，使他们在阴间缄默无声。
31.en: Let me not be put to shame, O Lord , for I have cried out to you; but let the wicked be put to shame and lie silent in the grave.

31.zh: 那撒谎的人逞骄傲轻慢，出狂妄的话攻击义人；愿他的嘴哑而无言。
31.en: Let their lying lips be silenced, for with pride and contempt they speak arrogantly against the righteous.

31.zh: 敬畏你、投靠你的人，你为他们所积存的，在世人面前所施行的恩惠是何等大呢！
31.en: How great is your goodness, which you have stored up for those who fear you, which you bestow in the sight of men on those who take refuge in you.

31.zh: 你必把他们藏在你面前的隐密处，免得遇见人的计谋；你必暗暗地保守他们在亭子里，免受口舌的争闹。
31.en: In the shelter of your presence you hide them from the intrigues of men; in your dwelling you keep them safe from accusing tongues.

31.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，因为他在坚固城里向我施展奇妙的慈爱。
31.en: Praise be to the Lord , for he showed his wonderful love to me when I was in a besieged city.

31.zh: 至于我，我曾急促地说：我从你眼前被隔绝。然而，我呼求你的时候，你仍听我恳求的声音。
31.en: In my alarm I said, "I am cut off from your sight!" Yet you heard my cry for mercy when I called to you for help.

31.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们都要爱他！耶和华保护诚实人，足足报应行事骄傲的人。
31.en: Love the Lord , all his saints! The Lord preserves the faithful, but the proud he pays back in full.

31.zh: 凡仰望耶和华的人，你们都要壮胆，坚固你们的心！
31.en: Be strong and take heart, all you who hope in the Lord .

32.zh: （大卫的训诲诗。）得赦免其过、遮盖其罪的，这人是有福的！
32.en: Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

32.zh: 凡心里没有诡诈、耶和华不算为有罪的，这人是有福的！
32.en: Blessed is the man whose sin the Lord does not count against him and in whose spirit is no deceit.

32.zh: 我闭口不认罪的时候，因终日唉哼而骨头枯干。
32.en: When I kept silent, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

32.zh: 黑夜白日，你的手在我身上沉重；我的精液耗尽，如同夏天的干旱。（细拉）
32.en: For day and night your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer. Selah

32.zh: 我向你陈明我的罪，不隐瞒我的恶。我说：我要向耶和华承认我的过犯，你就赦免我的罪恶。（细拉）
32.en: Then I acknowledged my sin to you and did not cover up my iniquity. I said, "I will confess my transgressions to the Lord "- and you forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah

32.zh: 为此，凡虔诚人都当趁你可寻找的时候祷告你；大水泛溢的时候，必不能到他那里。
32.en: Therefore let everyone who is godly pray to you while you may be found; surely when the mighty waters rise, they will not reach him.

32.zh: 你是我藏身之处；你必保佑我脱离苦难，以得救的乐歌四面环绕我。（细拉）
32.en: You are my hiding place; you will protect me from trouble and surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah

32.zh: 我要教导你，指示你当行的路；我要定睛在你身上劝戒你。
32.en: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you and watch over you.

32.zh: 你不可像那无知的骡马，必用嚼环辔头勒住他；不然，就不能驯服。
32.en: Do not be like the horse or the mule, which have no understanding but must be controlled by bit and bridle or they will not come to you.

32.zh: 恶人必多受苦楚；惟独倚靠耶和华的必有慈爱四面环绕他。
32.en: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord 's unfailing love surrounds the man who trusts in him.

32.zh: 你们义人应当靠耶和华欢喜快乐；你们心里正直的人都当欢呼。
32.en: Rejoice in the Lord and be glad, you righteous; sing, all you who are upright in heart!

33.zh: 义人哪，你们应当靠耶和华欢乐；正直人的赞美是合宜的。
33.en: Sing joyfully to the Lord , you righteous; it is fitting for the upright to praise him.

33.zh: 你们应当弹琴称谢耶和华，用十弦瑟歌颂他。
33.en: Praise the Lord with the harp; make music to him on the ten-stringed lyre.

33.zh: 应当向他唱新歌，弹得巧妙，声音洪亮。
33.en: Sing to him a new song; play skillfully, and shout for joy.

33.zh: 因为耶和华的言语正直；凡他所做的尽都诚实。
33.en: For the word of the Lord is right and true; he is faithful in all he does.

33.zh: 他喜爱仁义公平；遍地满了耶和华的慈爱。
33.en: The Lord loves righteousness and justice; the earth is full of his unfailing love.

33.zh: 诸天藉耶和华的命而造；万象藉他口中的气而成。
33.en: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made, their starry host by the breath of his mouth.

33.zh: 他聚集海水如垒，收藏深洋在库房。
33.en: He gathers the waters of the sea into jars ; he puts the deep into storehouses.

33.zh: 愿全地都敬畏耶和华！愿世上的居民都惧怕他！
33.en: Let all the earth fear the Lord ; let all the people of the world revere him.

33.zh: 因为他说有，就有，命立，就立。
33.en: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.

33.zh: 耶和华使列国的筹算归于无有，使众民的思念无有功效。
33.en: The Lord foils the plans of the nations; he thwarts the purposes of the peoples.

33.zh: 耶和华的筹算永远立定；他心中的思念万代常存。
33.en: But the plans of the Lord stand firm forever, the purposes of his heart through all generations.

33.zh: 以耶和华为神的，那国是有福的！他所拣选为自己产业的，那民是有福的！
33.en: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord , the people he chose for his inheritance.

33.zh: 耶和华从天上观看；他看见一切的世人。
33.en: From heaven the Lord looks down and sees all mankind;

33.zh: 从他的居所往外察看地上一切的居民。
33.en: from his dwelling place he watches all who live on earth-

33.zh: 他是那造成他们众人心的，留意他们一切作为的。
33.en: he who forms the hearts of all, who considers everything they do.

33.zh: 君王不能因兵多得胜；勇士不能因力大得救。
33.en: No king is saved by the size of his army; no warrior escapes by his great strength.

33.zh: 靠马得救是枉然的；马也不能因力大救人。
33.en: A horse is a vain hope for deliverance; despite all its great strength it cannot save.

33.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾敬畏他的人和仰望他慈爱的人，
33.en: But the eyes of the Lord are on those who fear him, on those whose hope is in his unfailing love,

33.zh: 要救他们的命脱离死亡，并使他们在饥荒中存活。
33.en: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.

33.zh: 我们的心向来等候耶和华；他是我们的帮助，我们的盾牌。
33.en: We wait in hope for the Lord ; he is our help and our shield.

33.zh: 我们的心必靠他欢喜，因为我们向来倚靠他的圣名。
33.en: In him our hearts rejoice, for we trust in his holy name.

33.zh: 耶和华啊，求你照著我们所仰望你的，向我们施行慈爱！
33.en: May your unfailing love rest upon us, O Lord , even as we put our hope in you.

34.zh: （大卫在亚比米勒面前装疯，被他赶出去，就作这诗。）我要时时称颂耶和华；赞美他的话必常在我口中。
34.en: I will extol the Lord at all times; his praise will always be on my lips.

34.zh: 我的心必因耶和华夸耀；谦卑人听见就要喜乐。
34.en: My soul will boast in the Lord ; let the afflicted hear and rejoice.

34.zh: 你们和我当称耶和华为大，一同高举他的名。
34.en: Glorify the Lord with me; let us exalt his name together.

34.zh: 我曾寻求耶和华，他就应允我，救我脱离了一切的恐惧。
34.en: I sought the Lord , and he answered me; he delivered me from all my fears.

34.zh: 凡仰望他的，便有光荣；他们的脸必不蒙羞。
34.en: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

34.zh: 我这困苦人呼求，耶和华便垂听，救我脱离一切患难。
34.en: This poor man called, and the Lord heard him; he saved him out of all his troubles.

34.zh: 耶和华的使者在敬畏他的人四围安营，搭救他们。
34.en: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.

34.zh: 你们要尝尝主恩的滋味，便知道他是美善；投靠他的人有福了！
34.en: Taste and see that the Lord is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

34.zh: 耶和华的圣民哪，你们当敬畏他，因敬畏他的一无所缺。
34.en: Fear the Lord , you his saints, for those who fear him lack nothing.

34.zh: 少壮狮子还缺食忍饿，但寻求耶和华的甚么好处都不缺。
34.en: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

34.zh: 众弟子啊，你们当来听我的话！我要将敬畏耶和华的道教训你们。
34.en: Come, my children, listen to me; I will teach you the fear of the Lord .

34.zh: 有何人喜好存活，爱慕长寿，得享美福，
34.en: Whoever of you loves life and desires to see many good days,

34.zh: 就要禁止舌头不出恶言，嘴唇不说诡诈的话。
34.en: keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking lies.

34.zh: 要离恶行善，寻求和睦，一心追赶。
34.en: Turn from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.

34.zh: 耶和华的眼目看顾义人；他的耳朵听他们的呼求。
34.en: The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and his ears are attentive to their cry;

34.zh: 耶和华向行恶的人变脸，要从世上除灭他们的名号。
34.en: the face of the Lord is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

34.zh: 义人呼求，耶和华听见了，便救他们脱离一切患难。
34.en: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them; he delivers them from all their troubles.

34.zh: 耶和华靠近伤心的人，拯救灵性痛悔的人。
34.en: The Lord is close to the brokenhearted and saves those who are crushed in spirit.

34.zh: 义人多有苦难，但耶和华救他脱离这一切，
34.en: A righteous man may have many troubles, but the Lord delivers him from them all;

34.zh: 又保全他一身的骨头，连一根也不折断。
34.en: he protects all his bones, not one of them will be broken.

34.zh: 恶必害死恶人；恨恶义人的，必被定罪。
34.en: Evil will slay the wicked; the foes of the righteous will be condemned.

34.zh: 耶和华救赎他仆人的灵魂；凡投靠他的，必不致定罪。
34.en: The Lord redeems his servants; no one will be condemned who takes refuge in him.

35.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，与我相争的，求你与他们相争！与我相战的，求你与他们相战！
35.en: Contend, O Lord , with those who contend with me; fight against those who fight against me.

35.zh: 拿著大小的盾牌，起来帮助我。
35.en: Take up shield and buckler; arise and come to my aid.

35.zh: 抽出枪来，挡住那追赶我的；求你对我的灵魂说：我是拯救你的。
35.en: Brandish spear and javelin against those who pursue me. Say to my soul, "I am your salvation."

35.zh: 愿那寻索我命的，蒙羞受辱！愿那谋害我的，退后羞愧！
35.en: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plot my ruin be turned back in dismay.

35.zh: 愿他们像风前的糠，有耶和华的使者赶逐他们。
35.en: May they be like chaff before the wind, with the angel of the Lord driving them away;

35.zh: 愿他们的道路又暗又滑，有耶和华的使者追赶他们。
35.en: may their path be dark and slippery, with the angel of the Lord pursuing them.

35.zh: 因他们无故地为我暗设网罗，无故地挖坑，要害我的性命。
35.en: Since they hid their net for me without cause and without cause dug a pit for me,

35.zh: 愿灾祸忽然临到他身上！愿他暗设的网缠住自己！愿他落在其中遭灾祸！
35.en: may ruin overtake them by surprise- may the net they hid entangle them, may they fall into the pit, to their ruin.

35.zh: 我的心必靠耶和华快乐，靠他的救恩高兴。
35.en: Then my soul will rejoice in the Lord and delight in his salvation.

35.zh: 我的骨头都要说：耶和华啊，谁能像你救护困苦人脱离那比他强壮的，救护困苦穷乏人脱离那抢夺他的？
35.en: My whole being will exclaim, "Who is like you, O Lord ? You rescue the poor from those too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them."

35.zh: 凶恶的见证人起来，盘问我所不知道的事。
35.en: Ruthless witnesses come forward; they question me on things I know nothing about.

35.zh: 他们向我以恶报善，使我的灵魂孤苦。
35.en: They repay me evil for good and leave my soul forlorn.

35.zh: 至于我，当他们有病的时候，我便穿麻衣，禁食，刻苦己心；我所求的都归到自己的怀中。
35.en: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth and humbled myself with fasting. When my prayers returned to me unanswered,

35.zh: 我这样行，好像他是我的朋友，我的弟兄；我屈身悲哀，如同人为母亲哀痛。
35.en: I went about mourning as though for my friend or brother. I bowed my head in grief as though weeping for my mother.

35.zh: 我在患难中，他们却欢喜，大家聚集。我所不认识的那些下流人聚集攻击我；他们不住地把我撕裂。
35.en: But when I stumbled, they gathered in glee; attackers gathered against me when I was unaware. They slandered me without ceasing.

35.zh: 他们如同席上好嬉笑的狂妄人向我咬牙。
35.en: Like the ungodly they maliciously mocked ; they gnashed their teeth at me.

35.zh: 主啊，你看著不理要到几时呢？求你救我的灵魂脱离他们的残害！救我的生命（生命：原文是独一者）脱离少壮狮子！
35.en: O Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my life from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.

35.zh: 我在大会中要称谢你，在众民中要赞美你。
35.en: I will give you thanks in the great assembly; among throngs of people I will praise you.

35.zh: 求你不容那无理与我为仇的向我夸耀！不容那无故恨我的向我挤眼！
35.en: Let not those gloat over me who are my enemies without cause; let not those who hate me without reason maliciously wink the eye.

35.zh: 因为他们不说和平话，倒想出诡诈的言语害地上的安静人。
35.en: They do not speak peaceably, but devise false accusations against those who live quietly in the land.

35.zh: 他们大大张口攻击我，说：阿哈，阿哈，我们的眼已经看见了！
35.en: They gape at me and say, "Aha! Aha! With our own eyes we have seen it."

35.zh: 耶和华啊，你已经看见了，求你不要闭口！主啊，求你不要远离我！
35.en: O Lord , you have seen this; be not silent. Do not be far from me, O Lord.

35.zh: 我的神我的主啊，求你奋兴醒起，判清我的事，伸明我的冤！
35.en: Awake, and rise to my defense! Contend for me, my God and Lord.

35.zh: 耶和华─我的神啊，求你按你的公义判断我，不容他们向我夸耀！
35.en: Vindicate me in your righteousness, O Lord my God; do not let them gloat over me.

35.zh: 不容他们心里说：阿哈，遂我们的心愿了！不容他们说：我们已经把他吞了！
35.en: Do not let them think, "Aha, just what we wanted!" or say, "We have swallowed him up."

35.zh: 愿那喜欢我遭难的一同抱愧蒙羞！愿那向我妄自尊大的披惭愧，蒙羞辱！
35.en: May all who gloat over my distress be put to shame and confusion; may all who exalt themselves over me be clothed with shame and disgrace.

35.zh: 愿那喜悦我冤屈得伸的（冤屈得伸：原文是公义）欢呼快乐；愿他们常说：当尊耶和华为大！耶和华喜悦他的仆人平安。
35.en: May those who delight in my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, "The Lord be exalted, who delights in the well-being of his servant."

35.zh: 我的舌头要终日论说你的公义，时常赞美你。
35.en: My tongue will speak of your righteousness and of your praises all day long.

36.zh: （耶和华的仆人大卫的诗，交与伶长。）恶人的罪过在他心里说：我眼中不怕神！
36.en: An oracle is within my heart concerning the sinfulness of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

36.zh: 他自夸自媚，以为他的罪孽终不显露，不被恨恶。
36.en: For in his own eyes he flatters himself too much to detect or hate his sin.

36.zh: 他口中的言语尽是罪孽诡诈；他与智慧善行已经断绝。
36.en: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and to do good.

36.zh: 他在床上图谋罪孽，定意行不善的道，不憎恶恶事。
36.en: Even on his bed he plots evil; he commits himself to a sinful course and does not reject what is wrong.

36.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱上及诸天；你的信实达到穹苍。
36.en: Your love, O Lord , reaches to the heavens, your faithfulness to the skies.

36.zh: 你的公义好像高山；你的判断如同深渊。耶和华啊，人民、牲畜，你都救护。
36.en: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains, your justice like the great deep. O Lord , you preserve both man and beast.

36.zh: 神啊，你的慈爱何其宝贵！世人投靠在你翅膀的荫下。
36.en: How priceless is your unfailing love! Both high and low among men find refuge in the shadow of your wings.

36.zh: 他们必因你殿里的肥甘得以饱足；你也必叫他们喝你乐河的水。
36.en: They feast on the abundance of your house; you give them drink from your river of delights.

36.zh: 因为，在你那里有生命的源头；在你的光中，我们必得见光。
36.en: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.

36.zh: 愿你常施慈爱给认识你的人，常以公义待心里正直的人。
36.en: Continue your love to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

36.zh: 不容骄傲人的脚践踏我；不容凶恶人的手赶逐我。
36.en: May the foot of the proud not come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.

36.zh: 在那里，作孽的人已经仆倒；他们被推倒，不能再起来。
36.en: See how the evildoers lie fallen- thrown down, not able to rise!

37.zh: （大卫的诗。）不要为作恶的心怀不平，也不要向那行不义的生出嫉妒。
37.en: Do not fret because of evil men or be envious of those who do wrong;

37.zh: 因为他们如草快被割下，又如青菜快要枯干。
37.en: for like the grass they will soon wither, like green plants they will soon die away.

37.zh: 你当倚靠耶和华而行善，住在地上，以他的信实为粮；
37.en: Trust in the Lord and do good; dwell in the land and enjoy safe pasture.

37.zh: 又要以耶和华为乐，他就将你心里所求的赐给你。
37.en: Delight yourself in the Lord and he will give you the desires of your heart.

37.zh: 当将你的事交托耶和华，并倚靠他，他就必成全。
37.en: Commit your way to the Lord ; trust in him and he will do this:

37.zh: 他要使你的公义如光发出，使你的公平明如正午。
37.en: He will make your righteousness shine like the dawn, the justice of your cause like the noonday sun.

37.zh: 你当默然倚靠耶和华，耐性等候他；不要因那道路通达的和那恶谋成就的心怀不平。
37.en: Be still before the Lord and wait patiently for him; do not fret when men succeed in their ways, when they carry out their wicked schemes.

37.zh: 当止住怒气，离弃忿怒；不要心怀不平，以致作恶。
37.en: Refrain from anger and turn from wrath; do not fret-it leads only to evil.

37.zh: 因为作恶的必被剪除；惟有等候耶和华的必承受地土。
37.en: For evil men will be cut off, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.

37.zh: 还有片时，恶人要归于无有；你就是细察他的住处也要归于无有。
37.en: A little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.

37.zh: 但谦卑人必承受地土，以丰盛的平安为乐。
37.en: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy great peace.

37.zh: 恶人设谋害义人，又向他咬牙。
37.en: The wicked plot against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them;

37.zh: 主要笑他，因见他受罚的日子将要来到。
37.en: but the Lord laughs at the wicked, for he knows their day is coming.

37.zh: 恶人已经弓上弦，刀出鞘，要打倒困苦穷乏的人，要杀害行动正直的人。
37.en: The wicked draw the sword and bend the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.

37.zh: 他们的刀必刺入自己的心；他们的弓必被折断。
37.en: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.

37.zh: 一个义人所有的虽少，强过许多恶人的富余。
37.en: Better the little that the righteous have than the wealth of many wicked;

37.zh: 因为恶人的膀臂必被折断；但耶和华是扶持义人。
37.en: for the power of the wicked will be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.

37.zh: 耶和华知道完全人的日子；他们的产业要存到永远。
37.en: The days of the blameless are known to the Lord , and their inheritance will endure forever.

37.zh: 他们在急难的时候不致羞愧，在饥荒的日子必得饱足。
37.en: In times of disaster they will not wither; in days of famine they will enjoy plenty.

37.zh: 恶人却要灭亡。耶和华的仇敌要像羊羔的脂油（或译：像草地的华美）；他们要消灭，要如烟消灭。
37.en: But the wicked will perish: The Lord 's enemies will be like the beauty of the fields, they will vanish-vanish like smoke.

37.zh: 恶人借贷而不偿还；义人却恩待人，并且施舍。
37.en: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous give generously;

37.zh: 蒙耶和华赐福的必承受地土；被他咒诅的必被剪除。
37.en: those the Lord blesses will inherit the land, but those he curses will be cut off.

37.zh: 义人的脚步被耶和华立定；他的道路，耶和华也喜爱。
37.en: If the Lord delights in a man's way, he makes his steps firm;

37.zh: 他虽失脚也不至全身仆倒，因为耶和华用手搀扶他（或译：搀扶他的手）。
37.en: though he stumble, he will not fall, for the Lord upholds him with his hand.

37.zh: 我从前年幼，现在年老，却未见过义人被弃，也未见过他的后裔讨饭。
37.en: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

37.zh: 他终日恩待人，借给人；他的后裔也蒙福！
37.en: They are always generous and lend freely; their children will be blessed.

37.zh: 你当离恶行善，就可永远安居。
37.en: Turn from evil and do good; then you will dwell in the land forever.

37.zh: 因为，耶和华喜爱公平，不撇弃他的圣民；他们永蒙保佑，但恶人的后裔必被剪除。
37.en: For the Lord loves the just and will not forsake his faithful ones. They will be protected forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off;

37.zh: 义人必承受地土，永居其上。
37.en: the righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.

37.zh: 义人的口谈论智慧；他的舌头讲说公平。
37.en: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks what is just.

37.zh: 神的律法在他心里；他的脚总不滑跌。
37.en: The law of his God is in his heart; his feet do not slip.

37.zh: 恶人窥探义人，想要杀他。
37.en: The wicked lie in wait for the righteous, seeking their very lives;

37.zh: 耶和华必不撇他在恶人手中；当审判的时候，也不定他的罪。
37.en: but the Lord will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned when brought to trial.

37.zh: 你当等候耶和华，遵守他的道，他就抬举你，使你承受地土；恶人被剪除的时候，你必看见。
37.en: Wait for the Lord and keep his way. He will exalt you to inherit the land; when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

37.zh: 我见过恶人大有势力，好像一根青翠树在本土生发。
37.en: I have seen a wicked and ruthless man flourishing like a green tree in its native soil,

37.zh: 有人从那里经过，不料，他没有了；我也寻找他，却寻不著。
37.en: but he soon passed away and was no more; though I looked for him, he could not be found.

37.zh: 你要细察那完全人，观看那正直人，因为和平人有好结局。
37.en: Consider the blameless, observe the upright; there is a future for the man of peace.

37.zh: 至于犯法的人，必一同灭绝；恶人终必剪除。
37.en: But all sinners will be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.

37.zh: 但义人得救是由于耶和华；他在患难时作他们的营寨。
37.en: The salvation of the righteous comes from the Lord ; he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

37.zh: 耶和华帮助他们，解救他们；他解救他们脱离恶人，把他们救出来，因为他们投靠他。
37.en: The Lord helps them and delivers them; he delivers them from the wicked and saves them, because they take refuge in him.

38.zh: （大卫的记念诗。）耶和华啊，求你不要在怒中责备我，不要在烈怒中惩罚我！
38.en: O Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger or discipline me in your wrath.

38.zh: 因为，你的箭射入我身；你的手压住我。
38.en: For your arrows have pierced me, and your hand has come down upon me.

38.zh: 因你的恼怒，我的肉无一完全；因我的罪过，我的骨头也不安宁。
38.en: Because of your wrath there is no health in my body; my bones have no soundness because of my sin.

38.zh: 我的罪孽高过我的头，如同重担叫我担当不起。
38.en: My guilt has overwhelmed me like a burden too heavy to bear.

38.zh: 因我的愚昧，我的伤发臭流脓。
38.en: My wounds fester and are loathsome because of my sinful folly.

38.zh: 我疼痛，大大拳曲，终日哀痛。
38.en: I am bowed down and brought very low; all day long I go about mourning.

38.zh: 我满腰是火；我的肉无一完全。
38.en: My back is filled with searing pain; there is no health in my body.

38.zh: 我被压伤，身体疲倦；因心里不安，我就唉哼。
38.en: I am feeble and utterly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.

38.zh: 主啊，我的心愿都在你面前；我的叹息不向你隐瞒。
38.en: All my longings lie open before you, O Lord; my sighing is not hidden from you.

38.zh: 我心跳动，我力衰微，连我眼中的光也没有了。
38.en: My heart pounds, my strength fails me; even the light has gone from my eyes.

38.zh: 我的良朋密友因我的灾病都躲在旁边站著；我的亲戚本家也远远地站立。
38.en: My friends and companions avoid me because of my wounds; my neighbors stay far away.

38.zh: 那寻索我命的设下网罗；那想要害我的口出恶言，终日思想诡计。
38.en: Those who seek my life set their traps, those who would harm me talk of my ruin; all day long they plot deception.

38.zh: 但我如聋子不听，像哑巴不开口。
38.en: I am like a deaf man, who cannot hear, like a mute, who cannot open his mouth;

38.zh: 我如不听见的人，口中没有回话。
38.en: I have become like a man who does not hear, whose mouth can offer no reply.

38.zh: 耶和华啊，我仰望你！主─我的神啊，你必应允我！
38.en: I wait for you, O Lord ; you will answer, O Lord my God.

38.zh: 我曾说：恐怕他们向我夸耀；我失脚的时候，他们向我夸大。
38.en: For I said, "Do not let them gloat or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."

38.zh: 我几乎跌倒；我的痛苦常在我面前。
38.en: For I am about to fall, and my pain is ever with me.

38.zh: 我要承认我的罪孽；我要因我的罪忧愁。
38.en: I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.

38.zh: 但我的仇敌又活泼又强壮，无理恨我的增多了。
38.en: Many are those who are my vigorous enemies; those who hate me without reason are numerous.

38.zh: 以恶报善的与我作对，因我是追求良善。
38.en: Those who repay my good with evil slander me when I pursue what is good.

38.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要撇弃我！我的神啊，求你不要远离我！
38.en: O Lord , do not forsake me; be not far from me, O my God.

38.zh: 拯救我的主啊，求你快快帮助我！
38.en: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.

39.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长耶杜顿。）我曾说：我要谨慎我的言行，免得我舌头犯罪；恶人在我面前的时候，我要用嚼环勒住我的口。
39.en: I said, "I will watch my ways and keep my tongue from sin; I will put a muzzle on my mouth as long as the wicked are in my presence."

39.zh: 我默然无声，连好话也不出口；我的愁苦就发动了，
39.en: But when I was silent and still, not even saying anything good, my anguish increased.

39.zh: 我的心在我里面发热。我默想的时候，火就烧起，我便用舌头说话。
39.en: My heart grew hot within me, and as I meditated, the fire burned; then I spoke with my tongue:

39.zh: 耶和华啊，求你叫我晓得我身之终！我的寿数几何？叫我知道我的生命不长！
39.en: "Show me, O Lord , my life's end and the number of my days; let me know how fleeting is my life.

39.zh: 你使我的年日窄如手掌；我一生的年数，在你面前如同无有。各人最稳妥的时候，真是全然虚幻。（细拉）
39.en: You have made my days a mere handbreadth; the span of my years is as nothing before you. Each man's life is but a breath. Selah

39.zh: 世人行动实系幻影。他们忙乱，真是枉然；积蓄财宝，不知将来有谁收取。
39.en: Man is a mere phantom as he goes to and fro: He bustles about, but only in vain; he heaps up wealth, not knowing who will get it.

39.zh: 主啊，如今我等甚么呢？我的指望在乎你！
39.en: "But now, Lord, what do I look for? My hope is in you.

39.zh: 求你救我脱离一切的过犯，不要使我受愚顽人的羞辱。
39.en: Save me from all my transgressions; do not make me the scorn of fools.

39.zh: 因我所遭遇的是出于你，我就默然不语。
39.en: I was silent; I would not open my mouth, for you are the one who has done this.

39.zh: 求你把你的责罚从我身上免去；因你手的责打，我便消灭。
39.en: Remove your scourge from me; I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

39.zh: 你因人的罪恶惩罚他的时候，叫他的笑容（的笑容：或译所喜爱的）消灭，如衣被虫所咬。世人真是虚幻！（细拉）
39.en: You rebuke and discipline men for their sin; you consume their wealth like a moth- each man is but a breath. Selah

39.zh: 耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，留心听我的呼求！我流泪，求你不要静默无声！因为我在你面前是客旅，是寄居的，像我列祖一般。
39.en: "Hear my prayer, O Lord , listen to my cry for help; be not deaf to my weeping. For I dwell with you as an alien, a stranger, as all my fathers were.

39.zh: 求你宽容我，使我在去而不返之先可以力量复原。
39.en: Look away from me, that I may rejoice again before I depart and am no more."

40.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）我曾耐性等候耶和华；他垂听我的呼求。
40.en: I waited patiently for the Lord ; he turned to me and heard my cry.

40.zh: 他从祸坑里，从淤泥中，把我拉上来，使我的脚立在磐石上，使我脚步稳当。
40.en: He lifted me out of the slimy pit, out of the mud and mire; he set my feet on a rock and gave me a firm place to stand.

40.zh: 他使我口唱新歌，就是赞美我们神的话。许多人必看见而惧怕，并要倚靠耶和华。
40.en: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the Lord .

40.zh: 那倚靠耶和华、不理会狂傲和偏向虚假之辈的，这人便为有福！
40.en: Blessed is the man who makes the Lord his trust, who does not look to the proud, to those who turn aside to false gods.

40.zh: 耶和华─我的神啊，你所行的奇事，并你向我们所怀的意念甚多，不能向你陈明。若要陈明，其事不可胜数。
40.en: Many, O Lord my God, are the wonders you have done. The things you planned for us no one can recount to you; were I to speak and tell of them, they would be too many to declare.

40.zh: 祭物和礼物，你不喜悦；你已经开通我的耳朵。燔祭和赎罪祭非你所要。
40.en: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but my ears you have pierced , ; burnt offerings and sin offerings you did not require.

40.zh: 那时我说：看哪，我来了！我的事在经卷上已经记载了。
40.en: Then I said, "Here I am, I have come- it is written about me in the scroll.

40.zh: 我的神啊，我乐意照你的旨意行；你的律法在我心里。
40.en: I desire to do your will, O my God; your law is within my heart."

40.zh: 我在大会中宣传公义的佳音；我必不止住我的嘴唇。耶和华啊，这是你所知道的。
40.en: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; I do not seal my lips, as you know, O Lord .

40.zh: 我未曾把你的公义藏在心里；我已陈明你的信实和你的救恩；我在大会中未曾隐瞒你的慈爱和诚实。
40.en: I do not hide your righteousness in my heart; I speak of your faithfulness and salvation. I do not conceal your love and your truth from the great assembly.

40.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要向我止住你的慈悲！愿你的慈爱和诚实常常保佑我！
40.en: Do not withhold your mercy from me, O Lord ; may your love and your truth always protect me.

40.zh: 因有无数的祸患围困我，我的罪孽追上了我，使我不能昂首；这罪孽比我的头发还多，我就心寒胆战。
40.en: For troubles without number surround me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see. They are more than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails within me.

40.zh: 耶和华啊，求你开恩搭救我！耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！
40.en: Be pleased, O Lord , to save me; O Lord , come quickly to help me.

40.zh: 愿那些寻找我、要灭我命的，一同抱愧蒙羞！愿那些喜悦我受害的，退后受辱！
40.en: May all who seek to take my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

40.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧而败亡！
40.en: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" be appalled at their own shame.

40.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜！愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊耶和华为大！
