40.en: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, "The Lord be exalted!"

40.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的，主仍顾念我；你是帮助我的，搭救我的。神啊，求你不要耽延！
40.en: Yet I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my help and my deliverer; O my God, do not delay.

41.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）眷顾贫穷的有福了！他遭难的日子，耶和华必搭救他。
41.en: Blessed is he who has regard for the weak; the Lord delivers him in times of trouble.

41.zh: 耶和华必保全他，使他存活；他必在地上享福。求你不要把他交给仇敌，遂其所愿。
41.en: The Lord will protect him and preserve his life; he will bless him in the land and not surrender him to the desire of his foes.

41.zh: 他病重在榻，耶和华必扶持他；他在病中，你必给他铺床。
41.en: The Lord will sustain him on his sickbed and restore him from his bed of illness.

41.zh: 我曾说：耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，医治我！因为我得罪了你。
41.en: I said, "O Lord , have mercy on me; heal me, for I have sinned against you."

41.zh: 我的仇敌用恶言议论我说：他几时死，他的名才灭亡呢？
41.en: My enemies say of me in malice, "When will he die and his name perish?"

41.zh: 他来看我就说假话；他心存奸恶，走到外边才说出来。
41.en: Whenever one comes to see me, he speaks falsely, while his heart gathers slander; then he goes out and spreads it abroad.

41.zh: 一切恨我的，都交头接耳地议论我；他们设计要害我。
41.en: All my enemies whisper together against me; they imagine the worst for me, saying,

41.zh: 他们说：有怪病贴在他身上；他已躺卧，必不能再起来。
41.en: "A vile disease has beset him; he will never get up from the place where he lies."

41.zh: 连我知己的朋友，我所倚靠、吃过我饭的也用脚踢我。
41.en: Even my close friend, whom I trusted, he who shared my bread, has lifted up his heel against me.

41.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜恤我，使我起来，好报复他们！
41.en: But you, O Lord , have mercy on me; raise me up, that I may repay them.

41.zh: 因我的仇敌不得向我夸胜，我从此便知道你喜爱我。
41.en: I know that you are pleased with me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.

41.zh: 你因我纯正就扶持我，使我永远站在你的面前。
41.en: In my integrity you uphold me and set me in your presence forever.

41.zh: 耶和华─以色列的神是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。阿们！阿们！
41.en: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.

42.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。）神啊，我的心切慕你，如鹿切慕溪水。
42.en: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, O God.

42.zh: 我的心渴想神，就是永生神；我几时得朝见　神呢？
42.en: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When can I go and meet with God?

42.zh: 我昼夜以眼泪当饮食；人不住地对我说：你的神在哪里呢？
42.en: My tears have been my food day and night, while men say to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

42.zh: 我从前与众人同往，用欢呼称赞的声音领他们到神的殿里，大家守节。我追想这些事，我的心极其悲伤。
42.en: These things I remember as I pour out my soul: how I used to go with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God, with shouts of joy and thanksgiving among the festive throng.

42.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神，因他笑脸帮助我；我还要称赞他。
42.en: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and

42.zh: 我的神啊，我的心在我里面忧闷，所以我从约但地，从黑门岭，从米萨山记念你。
42.en: my God. My soul is downcast within me; therefore I will remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon-from Mount Mizar.

42.zh: 你的瀑布发声，深渊就与深渊响应；你的波浪洪涛漫过我身。
42.en: Deep calls to deep in the roar of your waterfalls; all your waves and breakers have swept over me.

42.zh: 白昼，耶和华必向我施慈爱；黑夜，我要歌颂祷告赐我生命的神。
42.en: By day the Lord directs his love, at night his song is with me- a prayer to the God of my life.

42.zh: 我要对神─我的磐石说：你为何忘记我呢？我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？
42.en: I say to God my Rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?"

42.zh: 我的敌人辱骂我，好像打碎我的骨头，不住地对我说：你的神在哪里呢？
42.en: My bones suffer mortal agony as my foes taunt me, saying to me all day long, "Where is your God?"

42.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神，因我还要称赞他。他是我脸上的光荣（原文是帮助），是我的　神。
42.en: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

43.zh: 神啊，求你伸我的冤，向不虔诚的国为我辨屈；求你救我脱离诡诈不义的人。
43.en: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation; rescue me from deceitful and wicked men.

43.zh: 因为你是赐我力量的神，为何丢弃我呢？我为何因仇敌的欺压时常哀痛呢？
43.en: You are God my stronghold. Why have you rejected me? Why must I go about mourning, oppressed by the enemy?

43.zh: 求你发出你的亮光和真实，好引导我，带我到你的圣山，到你的居所！
43.en: Send forth your light and your truth, let them guide me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

43.zh: 我就走到神的祭坛，到我最喜乐的神那里。神啊，我的　神，我要弹琴称赞你！
43.en: Then will I go to the altar of God, to God, my joy and my delight. I will praise you with the harp, O God, my God.

43.zh: 我的心哪，你为何忧闷？为何在我里面烦躁？应当仰望神，因我还要称赞他。他是我脸上的光荣（原文是帮助），是我的　神。
43.en: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why so disturbed within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise him, my Savior and my God.

44.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，交与伶长。）神啊，你在古时，我们列祖的日子所行的事，我们亲耳听见了；我们的列祖也给我们述说过。
44.en: We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us what you did in their days, in days long ago.

44.zh: 你曾用手赶出外邦人，却栽培了我们列祖；你苦待列邦，却叫我们列祖发达。
44.en: With your hand you drove out the nations and planted our fathers; you crushed the peoples and made our fathers flourish.

44.zh: 因为他们不是靠自己的刀剑得地土，也不是靠自己的膀臂得胜，乃是靠你的右手、你的膀臂，和你脸上的亮光，因为你喜悦他们。
44.en: It was not by their sword that they won the land, nor did their arm bring them victory; it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, for you loved them.

44.zh: 神啊，你是我的王；求你出令使雅各得胜。
44.en: You are my King and my God, who decrees victories for Jacob.

44.zh: 我们靠你要推倒我们的敌人，靠你的名要践踏那起来攻击我们的人。
44.en: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

44.zh: 因为，我必不靠我的弓；我的刀也不能使我得胜。
44.en: I do not trust in my bow, my sword does not bring me victory;

44.zh: 惟你救了我们脱离敌人，使恨我们的人羞愧。
44.en: but you give us victory over our enemies, you put our adversaries to shame.

44.zh: 我们终日因神夸耀，还要永远称谢你的名。（细拉）
44.en: In God we make our boast all day long, and we will praise your name forever. Selah

44.zh: 但如今你丢弃了我们，使我们受辱，不和我们的军兵同去。
44.en: But now you have rejected and humbled us; you no longer go out with our armies.

44.zh: 你使我们向敌人转身退后；那恨我们的人任意抢夺。
44.en: You made us retreat before the enemy, and our adversaries have plundered us.

44.zh: 你使我们当作快要被吃的羊，把我们分散在列邦中。
44.en: You gave us up to be devoured like sheep and have scattered us among the nations.

44.zh: 你卖了你的子民也不赚利，所得的价值并不加添你的资财。
44.en: You sold your people for a pittance, gaining nothing from their sale.

44.zh: 你使我们受邻国的羞辱，被四围的人嗤笑讥刺。
44.en: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, the scorn and derision of those around us.

44.zh: 你使我们在列邦中作了笑谈，使众民向我们摇头。
44.en: You have made us a byword among the nations; the peoples shake their heads at us.

44.zh: 我的凌辱终日在我面前，我脸上的羞愧将我遮蔽，
44.en: My disgrace is before me all day long, and my face is covered with shame

44.zh: 都因那辱骂毁谤人的声音，又因仇敌和报仇人的缘故。
44.en: at the taunts of those who reproach and revile me, because of the enemy, who is bent on revenge.

44.zh: 这都临到我们身上，我们却没有忘记你，也没有违背你的约。
44.en: All this happened to us, though we had not forgotten you or been false to your covenant.

44.zh: 我们的心没有退后；我们的脚也没有偏离你的路。
44.en: Our hearts had not turned back; our feet had not strayed from your path.

44.zh: 你在野狗之处压伤我们，用死荫遮蔽我们。
44.en: But you crushed us and made us a haunt for jackals and covered us over with deep darkness.

44.zh: 倘若我们忘了神的名，或向别神举手，
44.en: If we had forgotten the name of our God or spread out our hands to a foreign god,

44.zh: 神岂不鉴察这事么？因为他晓得人心里的隐秘。
44.en: would not God have discovered it, since he knows the secrets of the heart?

44.zh: 我们为你的缘故终日被杀；人看我们如将宰的羊。
44.en: Yet for your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.

44.zh: 主啊，求你睡醒，为何尽睡呢？求你兴起，不要永远丢弃我们！
44.en: Awake, O Lord! Why do you sleep? Rouse yourself! Do not reject us forever.

44.zh: 你为何掩面，不顾我们所遭的苦难和所受的欺压？
44.en: Why do you hide your face and forget our misery and oppression?

44.zh: 我们的性命伏于尘土；我们的肚腹紧贴地面。
44.en: We are brought down to the dust; our bodies cling to the ground.

44.zh: 求你起来帮助我们！凭你的慈爱救赎我们！
44.en: Rise up and help us; redeem us because of your unfailing love.

45.zh: （可拉后裔的训诲诗，又是爱慕歌，交与伶长。调用百合花。）我心里涌出美辞；我论到我为王做的事，我的舌头是快手笔。
45.en: My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses for the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.

45.zh: 你比世人更美；在你嘴里满有恩惠；所以神赐福给你，直到永远。
45.en: You are the most excellent of men and your lips have been anointed with grace, since God has blessed you forever.

45.zh: 大能者啊，愿你腰间佩刀，大有荣耀和威严！
45.en: Gird your sword upon your side, O mighty one; clothe yourself with splendor and majesty.

45.zh: 为真理、谦卑、公义赫然坐车前往，无不得胜；你的右手必显明可畏的事。
45.en: In your majesty ride forth victoriously in behalf of truth, humility and righteousness; let your right hand display awesome deeds.

45.zh: 你的箭锋快，射中王敌之心；万民仆倒在你以下。
45.en: Let your sharp arrows pierce the hearts of the king's enemies; let the nations fall beneath your feet.

45.zh: 神啊，你的宝座是永永远远的；你的国权是正直的。
45.en: Your throne, O God, will last for ever and ever; a scepter of justice will be the scepter of your kingdom.

45.zh: 你喜爱公义，恨恶罪恶；所以神─就是你的　神─用喜乐油膏你，胜过膏你的同伴。
45.en: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; therefore God, your God, has set you above your companions by anointing you with the oil of joy.

45.zh: 你的衣服都有没药、沉香、肉桂的香气；象牙宫中有丝弦乐器的声音使你欢喜。
45.en: All your robes are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces adorned with ivory the music of the strings makes you glad.

45.zh: 有君王的女儿在你尊贵妇女之中；王后佩戴俄斐金饰站在你右边。
45.en: Daughters of kings are among your honored women; at your right hand is the royal bride in gold of Ophir.

45.zh: 女子啊，你要听，要想，要侧耳而听！不要记念你的民和你的父家，
45.en: Listen, O daughter, consider and give ear: Forget your people and your father's house.

45.zh: 王就羡慕你的美貌；因为他是你的主，你当敬拜他。
45.en: The king is enthralled by your beauty; honor him, for he is your lord.

45.zh: 推罗的民（原文是女子）必来送礼；民中的富足人也必向你求恩。
45.en: The Daughter of Tyre will come with a gift, men of wealth will seek your favor.

45.zh: 王女在宫里极其荣华；他的衣服是用金线绣的。
45.en: All glorious is the princess within her chamber ; her gown is interwoven with gold.

45.zh: 他要穿锦绣的衣服，被引到王前；随从他的陪伴童女也要被带到你面前。
45.en: In embroidered garments she is led to the king; her virgin companions follow her and are brought to you.

45.zh: 他们要欢喜快乐被引导；他们要进入王宫。
45.en: They are led in with joy and gladness; they enter the palace of the king.

45.zh: 你的子孙要接续你的列祖；你要立他们在全地作王。
45.en: Your sons will take the place of your fathers; you will make them princes throughout the land.

45.zh: 我必叫你的名被万代记念，所以万民要永永远远称谢你。
45.en: I will perpetuate your memory through all generations; therefore the nations will praise you for ever and ever.

46.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌，交与伶长。调用女音。）神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。
46.en: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

46.zh: 所以，地虽改变，山虽摇动到海心，
46.en: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea,

46.zh: 其中的水虽匉訇翻腾，山虽因海涨而战抖，我们也不害怕。（细拉）
46.en: though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging. Selah

46.zh: 有一道河，这河的分使　神的城欢喜；这城就是至高者居住的圣所。
46.en: There is a river whose streams make glad the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.

46.zh: 神在其中，城必不动摇；到天一亮，神必帮助这城。
46.en: God is within her, she will not fall; God will help her at break of day.

46.zh: 外邦喧嚷，列国动摇；神发声，地便镕化。
46.en: Nations are in uproar, kingdoms fall; he lifts his voice, the earth melts.

46.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在；雅各的神是我们的避难所！（细拉）
46.en: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

46.zh: 你们来看耶和华的作为，看他使地怎样荒凉。
46.en: Come and see the works of the Lord , the desolations he has brought on the earth.

46.zh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓、断枪，把战车焚烧在火中。
46.en: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear, he burns the shields with fire.

46.zh: 你们要休息，要知道我是神！我必在外邦中被尊崇，在遍地上也被尊崇。
46.en: "Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth."

46.zh: 万军之耶和华与我们同在；雅各的神是我们的避难所！
46.en: The Lord Almighty is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah

47.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。）万民哪，你们都要拍掌！要用夸胜的声音向神呼喊！
47.en: Clap your hands, all you nations; shout to God with cries of joy.

47.zh: 因为耶和华至高者是可畏的；他是治理全地的大君王。
47.en: How awesome is the Lord Most High, the great King over all the earth!

47.zh: 他叫万民服在我们以下，又叫列邦服在我们脚下。
47.en: He subdued nations under us, peoples under our feet.

47.zh: 他为我们选择产业，就是他所爱之雅各的荣耀。（细拉）
47.en: He chose our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom he loved. Selah

47.zh: 神上升，有喊声相送；耶和华上升，有角声相送。
47.en: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the Lord amid the sounding of trumpets.

47.zh: 你们要向神歌颂，歌颂！向我们王歌颂，歌颂！
47.en: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises.

47.zh: 因为神是全地的王；你们要用悟性歌颂。
47.en: For God is the King of all the earth; sing to him a psalm of praise.

47.zh: 神作王治理万国；神坐在他的圣宝座上。
47.en: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on his holy throne.

47.zh: 列邦的君王聚集要作亚伯拉罕之神的民。因为世界的盾牌是属　神的；他为至高！
47.en: The nobles of the nations assemble as the people of the God of Abraham, for the kings of the earth belong to God; he is greatly exalted.

48.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌。）耶和华本为大！在我们神的城中，在他的圣山上，该受大赞美。
48.en: Great is the Lord , and most worthy of praise, in the city of our God, his holy mountain.

48.zh: 锡安山─大君王的城，在北面居高华美，为全地所喜悦。
48.en: It is beautiful in its loftiness, the joy of the whole earth. Like the utmost heights of Zaphon is Mount Zion, the city of the Great King.

48.zh: 神在其宫中，自显为避难所。
48.en: God is in her citadels; he has shown himself to be her fortress.

48.zh: 看哪，众王会合，一同经过。
48.en: When the kings joined forces, when they advanced together,

48.zh: 他们见了这城就惊奇丧胆，急忙逃跑。
48.en: they saw her and were astounded; they fled in terror.

48.zh: 他们在那里被战兢疼痛抓住，好像产难的妇人一样。
48.en: Trembling seized them there, pain like that of a woman in labor.

48.zh: 神啊，你用东风打破他施的船只。
48.en: You destroyed them like ships of Tarshish shattered by an east wind.

48.zh: 我们在万军之耶和华的城中─就是我们神的城中─所看见的，正如我们所听见的。　神必坚立这城，直到永远。（细拉）
48.en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the Lord Almighty, in the city of our God: God makes her secure forever. Selah

48.zh: 神啊，我们在你的殿中想念你的慈爱。
48.en: Within your temple, O God, we meditate on your unfailing love.

48.zh: 神啊，你受的赞美正与你的名相称，直到地极！你的右手满了公义。
48.en: Like your name, O God, your praise reaches to the ends of the earth; your right hand is filled with righteousness.

48.zh: 因你的判断，锡安山应当欢喜，犹大的城邑（原文是女子）应当快乐。
48.en: Mount Zion rejoices, the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments.

48.zh: 你们当周游锡安，四围旋绕，数点城楼，
48.en: Walk about Zion, go around her, count her towers,

48.zh: 细看他的外郭，察看他的宫殿，为要传说到后代。
48.en: consider well her ramparts, view her citadels, that you may tell of them to the next generation.

48.zh: 因为这神永永远远为我们的　神；他必作我们引路的，直到死时。
48.en: For this God is our God for ever and ever; he will be our guide even to the end.

49.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。）万民哪，你们都当听这话！世上一切的居民，
49.en: Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all who live in this world,

49.zh: 无论上流下流，富足贫穷，都当留心听！
49.en: both low and high, rich and poor alike:

49.zh: 我口要说智慧的言语；我心要想通达的道理。
49.en: My mouth will speak words of wisdom; the utterance from my heart will give understanding.

49.zh: 我要侧耳听比喻，用琴解谜语。
49.en: I will turn my ear to a proverb; with the harp I will expound my riddle:

49.zh: 在患难的日子，奸恶随我脚跟，四面环绕我，我何必惧怕？
49.en: Why should I fear when evil days come, when wicked deceivers surround me-

49.zh: 那些倚仗财货自夸钱财多的人，
49.en: those who trust in their wealth and boast of their great riches?

49.zh: 一个也无法赎自己的弟兄，也不能替他将赎价给神，
49.en: No man can redeem the life of another or give to God a ransom for him-

49.zh: 叫他长远活著，不见朽坏；因为赎他生命的价值极贵，只可永远罢休。
49.en: the ransom for a life is costly, no payment is ever enough-

49.zh: a
49.en: that he should live on forever and not see decay.

49.zh: 他必见智慧人死，又见愚顽人和畜类人一同灭亡，将他们的财货留给别人。
49.en: For all can see that wise men die; the foolish and the senseless alike perish and leave their wealth to others.

49.zh: 他们心里思想：他们的家室必永存，住宅必留到万代；他们以自己的名称自己的地。
49.en: Their tombs will remain their houses forever, their dwellings for endless generations, though they had named lands after themselves.

49.zh: 但人居尊贵中不能长久，如同死亡的畜类一样。
49.en: But man, despite his riches, does not endure; he is like the beasts that perish.

49.zh: 他们行的这道本为自己的愚昧；但他们以后的人还佩服他们的话语。（细拉）
49.en: This is the fate of those who trust in themselves, and of their followers, who approve their sayings. Selah

49.zh: 他们如同羊群派定下阴间；死亡必作他们的牧者。到了早晨，正直人必管辖他们；他们的美容必被阴间所灭，以致无处可存。
49.en: Like sheep they are destined for the grave, and death will feed on them. The upright will rule over them in the morning; their forms will decay in the grave, far from their princely mansions.

49.zh: 只是神必救赎我的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄，因他必收纳我。（细拉）
49.en: But God will redeem my life from the grave; he will surely take me to himself. Selah

49.zh: 见人发财、家室增荣的时候，你不要惧怕；
49.en: Do not be overawed when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases;

49.zh: 因为，他死的时候甚么也不能带去；他的荣耀不能随他下去。
49.en: for he will take nothing with him when he dies, his splendor will not descend with him.

49.zh: 他活著的时候，虽然自夸为有福（你若利己，人必夸奖你）；
49.en: Though while he lived he counted himself blessed- and men praise you when you prosper-

49.zh: 他仍必归到他历代的祖宗那里，永不见光。
49.en: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of life .

49.zh: 人在尊贵中而不醒悟，就如死亡的畜类一样。
49.en: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.

50.zh: （亚萨的诗。）大能者神─耶和华已经发言招呼天下，从日出之地到日落之处。
50.en: The Mighty One, God, the Lord , speaks and summons the earth from the rising of the sun to the place where it sets.

50.zh: 从全美的锡安中，神已经发光了。
50.en: From Zion, perfect in beauty, God shines forth.

50.zh: 我们的神要来，决不闭口。有烈火在他面前吞灭；有暴风在他四围大刮。
50.en: Our God comes and will not be silent; a fire devours before him, and around him a tempest rages.

50.zh: 他招呼上天下地，为要审判他的民，
50.en: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that he may judge his people:

50.zh: 说：招聚我的圣民到我这里来，就是那些用祭物与我立约的人。
50.en: "Gather to me my consecrated ones, who made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

50.zh: 诸天必表明他的公义，因为神是施行审判的。（细拉）
50.en: And the heavens proclaim his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah

50.zh: 我的民哪，你们当听我的话！以色列啊，我要劝戒你；我是神，是你的　神！
50.en: "Hear, O my people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.

50.zh: 我并不因你的祭物责备你；你的燔祭常在我面前。
50.en: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices or your burnt offerings, which are ever before me.

50.zh: 我不从你家中取公牛，也不从你圈内取山羊；
50.en: I have no need of a bull from your stall or of goats from your pens,

50.zh: 因为，树林中的百兽是我的，千山上的牲畜也是我的。
50.en: for every animal of the forest is mine, and the cattle on a thousand hills.

50.zh: 山中的飞鸟，我都知道；野地的走兽也都属我。
50.en: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are mine.

50.zh: 我若是饥饿，我不用告诉你，因为世界和其中所充满的都是我的。
50.en: If I were hungry I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

50.zh: 我岂吃公牛的肉呢？我岂喝山羊的血呢？
50.en: Do I eat the flesh of bulls or drink the blood of goats?

50.zh: 你们要以感谢为祭献与神，又要向至高者还你的愿，
50.en: Sacrifice thank offerings to God, fulfill your vows to the Most High,

50.zh: 并要在患难之日求告我；我必搭救你，你也要荣耀我。
50.en: and call upon me in the day of trouble; I will deliver you, and you will honor me."

50.zh: 但神对恶人说：你怎敢传说我的律例，口中提到我的约呢？
50.en: But to the wicked, God says: "What right have you to recite my laws or take my covenant on your lips?

50.zh: 其实你恨恶管教，将我的言语丢在背后。
50.en: You hate my instruction and cast my words behind you.

50.zh: 你见了盗贼就乐意与他同伙，又与行奸淫的人一同有分。
50.en: When you see a thief, you join with him; you throw in your lot with adulterers.

50.zh: 你口任说恶言；你舌编造诡诈。
50.en: You use your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.

50.zh: 你坐著毁谤你的兄弟，谗毁你亲母的儿子。
50.en: You speak continually against your brother and slander your own mother's son.

50.zh: 你行了这些事，我还闭口不言，你想我恰和你一样；其实我要责备你，将这些事摆在你眼前。
50.en: These things you have done and I kept silent; you thought I was altogether like you. But I will rebuke you and accuse you to your face.

50.zh: 你们忘记神的，要思想这事，免得我把你们撕碎，无人搭救。
50.en: "Consider this, you who forget God, or I will tear you to pieces, with none to rescue:

50.zh: 凡以感谢献上为祭的便是荣耀我；那按正路而行的，我必使他得著我的救恩。
50.en: He who sacrifices thank offerings honors me, and he prepares the way so that I may show him the salvation of God."

51.zh: （大卫与拔示巴同室以后，先知拿单来见他；他作这诗，交与伶长。）神啊，求你按你的慈爱怜恤我！按你丰盛的慈悲涂抹我的过犯！
51.en: Have mercy on me, O God, according to your unfailing love; according to your great compassion blot out my transgressions.

51.zh: 求你将我的罪孽洗除净尽，并洁除我的罪！
51.en: Wash away all my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.

51.zh: 因为，我知道我的过犯；我的罪常在我面前。
51.en: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.

51.zh: 我向你犯罪，惟独得罪了你；在你眼前行了这恶，以致你责备我的时候显为公义，判断我的时候显为清正。
51.en: Against you, you only, have I sinned and done what is evil in your sight, so that you are proved right when you speak and justified when you judge.

51.zh: 我是在罪孽里生的，在我母亲怀胎的时候就有了罪。
51.en: Surely I was sinful at birth, sinful from the time my mother conceived me.

51.zh: 你所喜爱的是内里诚实；你在我隐密处，必使我得智慧。
51.en: Surely you desire truth in the inner parts ; you teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

51.zh: 求你用牛膝草洁净我，我就干净；求你洗涤我，我就比雪更白。
51.en: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

51.zh: 求你使我得听欢喜快乐的声音，使你所压伤的骨头可以踊跃。
51.en: Let me hear joy and gladness; let the bones you have crushed rejoice.

51.zh: 求你掩面不看我的罪，涂抹我一切的罪孽。
51.en: Hide your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquity.

51.zh: 神啊，求你为我造清洁的心，使我里面重新有正直（或译：坚定）的灵。
51.en: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

51.zh: 不要丢弃我，使我离开你的面；不要从我收回你的圣灵。
51.en: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

51.zh: 求你使我仍得救恩之乐，赐我乐意的灵扶持我，
51.en: Restore to me the joy of your salvation and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

51.zh: 我就把你的道指教有过犯的人，罪人必归顺你。
51.en: Then I will teach transgressors your ways, and sinners will turn back to you.

51.zh: 神啊，你是拯救我的神；求你救我脱离流人血的罪！我的舌头就高声歌唱你的公义。
51.en: Save me from bloodguilt, O God, the God who saves me, and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.

51.zh: 主啊，求你使我嘴唇张开，我的口便传扬赞美你的话！
51.en: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare your praise.

51.zh: 你本不喜爱祭物，若喜爱，我就献上；燔祭，你也不喜悦。
51.en: You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

51.zh: 神所要的祭就是忧伤的灵；神啊，忧伤痛悔的心，你必不轻看。
51.en: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

51.zh: 求你随你的美意善待锡安，建造耶路撒冷的城墙。
51.en: In your good pleasure make Zion prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.

51.zh: 那时，你必喜爱公义的祭和燔祭并全牲的燔祭；那时，人必将公牛献在你坛上。
51.en: Then there will be righteous sacrifices, whole burnt offerings to delight you; then bulls will be offered on your altar.

52.zh: （以东人多益来告诉扫罗说：大卫到了亚希米勒家。那时，大卫作这训诲诗，交与伶长。）勇士啊，你为何以作恶自夸？神的慈爱是常存的。
52.en: Why do you boast of evil, you mighty man? Why do you boast all day long, you who are a disgrace in the eyes of God?

52.zh: 你的舌头邪恶诡诈，好像剃头刀，快利伤人。
52.en: Your tongue plots destruction; it is like a sharpened razor, you who practice deceit.

52.zh: 你爱恶胜似爱善，又爱说谎，不爱说公义。（细拉）
52.en: You love evil rather than good, falsehood rather than speaking the truth. Selah

52.zh: 诡诈的舌头啊，你爱说一切毁灭的话！
52.en: You love every harmful word, O you deceitful tongue!

52.zh: 神也要毁灭你，直到永远；他要把你拿去，从你的帐棚中抽出，从活人之地将你拔出。（细拉）
52.en: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin: He will snatch you up and tear you from your tent; he will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

52.zh: 义人要看见而惧怕，并要笑他，
52.en: The righteous will see and fear; they will laugh at him, saying,

52.zh: 说：看哪，这就是那不以神为他力量的人，只倚仗他丰富的财物，在邪恶上坚立自己。
52.en: "Here now is the man who did not make God his stronghold but trusted in his great wealth and grew strong by destroying others!"

52.zh: 至于我，就像神殿中的青橄榄树；我永永远远倚靠　神的慈爱。
52.en: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in God's unfailing love for ever and ever.

52.zh: 我要称谢你，直到永远，因为你行了这事。我也要在你圣民面前仰望你的名；这名本为美好。
52.en: I will praise you forever for what you have done; in your name I will hope, for your name is good. I will praise you in the presence of your saints.

53.zh: （大卫的训诲诗，交与伶长。调用麻哈拉。）愚顽人心里说：没有神。他们都是邪恶，行了可憎恶的罪孽；没有一个人行善。
53.en: The fool says in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and their ways are vile; there is no one who does good.

53.zh: 神从天上垂看世人，要看有明白的没有？有寻求他的没有？
53.en: God looks down from heaven on the sons of men to see if there are any who understand, any who seek God.

53.zh: 他们各人都退后，一同变为污秽；并没有行善的，连一个也没有。
53.en: Everyone has turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.

53.zh: 作孽的没有知识么？他们吞吃我的百姓如同吃饭一样，并不求告神。
53.en: Will the evildoers never learn- those who devour my people as men eat bread and who do not call on God?

53.zh: 他们在无可惧怕之处就大大害怕，因为神把那安营攻击你之人的骨头散开了。你使他们蒙羞，因为　神弃绝了他们。
53.en: There they were, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to dread. God scattered the bones of those who attacked you; you put them to shame, for God despised them.

53.zh: 但愿以色列的救恩从锡安而出。神救回他被掳的子民那时，雅各要快乐，以色列要欢喜。
53.en: Oh, that salvation for Israel would come out of Zion! When God restores the fortunes of his people, let Jacob rejoice and Israel be glad!

54.zh: （西弗人来对扫罗说：大卫岂不是在我们那里藏身么？那时，大卫作这训诲诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）神啊，求你以你的名救我，凭你的大能为我伸冤。
54.en: Save me, O God, by your name; vindicate me by your might.

54.zh: 神啊，求你听我的祷告，留心听我口中的言语。
54.en: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

54.zh: 因为，外人起来攻击我，强暴人寻索我的命；他们眼中没有神。（细拉）
54.en: Strangers are attacking me; ruthless men seek my life- men without regard for God. Selah

54.zh: 神是帮助我的，是扶持我命的。
54.en: Surely God is my help; the Lord is the one who sustains me.

54.zh: 他要报应我仇敌所行的恶；求你凭你的诚实灭绝他们。
54.en: Let evil recoil on those who slander me; in your faithfulness destroy them.

54.zh: 我要把甘心祭献给你。耶和华啊，我要称赞你的名；这名本为美好。
54.en: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you; I will praise your name, O Lord , for it is good.

54.zh: 他从一切的急难中把我救出来；我的眼睛也看见了我仇敌遭报。
54.en: For he has delivered me from all my troubles, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

55.zh: （大卫的训诲诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）神啊，求你留心听我的祷告，不要隐藏不听我的恳求！
55.en: Listen to my prayer, O God, do not ignore my plea;

55.zh: 求你侧耳听我，应允我。我哀叹不安，发声唉哼，
55.en: hear me and answer me. My thoughts trouble me and I am distraught

55.zh: 都因仇敌的声音，恶人的欺压；因为他们将罪孽加在我身上，发怒气逼迫我。
55.en: at the voice of the enemy, at the stares of the wicked; for they bring down suffering upon me and revile me in their anger.

55.zh: 我心在我里面甚是疼痛；死的惊惶临到我身。
55.en: My heart is in anguish within me; the terrors of death assail me.

55.zh: 恐惧战兢归到我身；惊恐漫过了我。
55.en: Fear and trembling have beset me; horror has overwhelmed me.

55.zh: 我说：但愿我有翅膀像鸽子，我就飞去，得享安息。
55.en: I said, "Oh, that I had the wings of a dove! I would fly away and be at rest-

55.zh: 我必远游，宿在旷野。（细拉）
55.en: I would flee far away and stay in the desert; Selah

55.zh: 我必速速逃到避所，脱离狂风暴雨。
55.en: I would hurry to my place of shelter, far from the tempest and storm."

55.zh: 主啊，求你吞灭他们，变乱他们的舌头！因为我在城中见了强暴争竞的事。
55.en: Confuse the wicked, O Lord, confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.

55.zh: 他们在城墙上昼夜绕行；在城内也有罪孽和奸恶。
55.en: Day and night they prowl about on its walls; malice and abuse are within it.

55.zh: 邪恶在其中；欺压和诡诈不离街市。
55.en: Destructive forces are at work in the city; threats and lies never leave its streets.

55.zh: 原来不是仇敌辱骂我，若是仇敌，还可忍耐；也不是恨我的人向我狂大，若是恨我的人就必躲避他。
55.en: If an enemy were insulting me, I could endure it; if a foe were raising himself against me, I could hide from him.

55.zh: 不料是你；你原与我平等，是我的同伴，是我知己的朋友！
55.en: But it is you, a man like myself, my companion, my close friend,

55.zh: 我们素常彼此谈论，以为甘甜；我们与群众在神的殿中同行。
55.en: with whom I once enjoyed sweet fellowship as we walked with the throng at the house of God.

55.zh: 愿死亡忽然临到他们！愿他们活活地下入阴间！因为他们的住处，他们的心中，都是邪恶。
55.en: Let death take my enemies by surprise; let them go down alive to the grave, for evil finds lodging among them.

55.zh: 至于我，我要求告神；耶和华必拯救我。
55.en: But I call to God, and the Lord saves me.

55.zh: 我要晚上、早晨、晌午哀声悲叹；他也必听我的声音。
55.en: Evening, morning and noon I cry out in distress, and he hears my voice.

55.zh: 他救赎我命脱离攻击我的人，使我得享平安，因为与我相争的人甚多。
55.en: He ransoms me unharmed from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.

55.zh: 那没有更变、不敬畏神的人，从太古常存的　神必听见而苦待他。
55.en: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear them and afflict them- Selah men who never change their ways and have no fear of God.

55.zh: 他背了约，伸手攻击与他和好的人。
55.en: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.

55.zh: 他的口如奶油光滑，他的心却怀著争战；他的话比油柔和，其实是拔出来的刀。
55.en: His speech is smooth as butter, yet war is in his heart; his words are more soothing than oil, yet they are drawn swords.

55.zh: 你要把你的重担卸给耶和华，他必抚养你；他永不叫义人动摇。
55.en: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you; he will never let the righteous fall.

55.zh: 神啊，你必使恶人下入灭亡的坑；流人血、行诡诈的人必活不到半世，但我要倚靠你。
55.en: But you, O God, will bring down the wicked into the pit of corruption; bloodthirsty and deceitful men will not live out half their days. But as for me, I trust in you.

56.zh: （非利士人在迦特拿住大卫。那时，他作这金诗，交与伶长。调用远方无声鸽。）神啊，求你怜悯我，因为人要把我吞了，终日攻击欺压我。
56.en: Be merciful to me, O God, for men hotly pursue me; all day long they press their attack.

56.zh: 我的仇敌终日要把我吞了，因逞骄傲攻击我的人甚多。
56.en: My slanderers pursue me all day long; many are attacking me in their pride.

56.zh: 我惧怕的时候要倚靠你。
56.en: When I am afraid, I will trust in you.

56.zh: 我倚靠神，我要赞美他的话；我倚靠　神，必不惧怕。血气之辈能把我怎么样呢？
56.en: In God, whose word I praise, in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can mortal man do to me?

56.zh: 他们终日颠倒我的话；他们一切的心思都是要害我。
56.en: All day long they twist my words; they are always plotting to harm me.

56.zh: 他们聚集，埋伏窥探我的脚踪，等候要害我的命。
56.en: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps, eager to take my life.

56.zh: 他们岂能因罪孽逃脱么？神啊，求你在怒中使众民堕落！
56.en: On no account let them escape; in your anger, O God, bring down the nations.

56.zh: 我几次流离，你都记数；求你把我眼泪装在你的皮袋里。这不都记在你册子上么？
56.en: Record my lament; list my tears on your scroll - are they not in your record?

56.zh: 我呼求的日子，我的仇敌都要转身退后。神帮助我，这是我所知道的。
56.en: Then my enemies will turn back when I call for help. By this I will know that God is for me.

56.zh: 我倚靠神，我要赞美他的话我倚靠耶和华，我要赞美他的话。
56.en: In God, whose word I praise, in the Lord , whose word I praise-

56.zh: 我倚靠神，必不惧怕。人能把我怎么样呢？
56.en: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

56.zh: 神啊，我向你所许的愿在我身上；我要将感谢祭献给你。
56.en: I am under vows to you, O God; I will present my thank offerings to you.

56.zh: 因为你救我的命脱离死亡。你岂不是救护我的脚不跌倒、使我在生命光中行在神面前么？
56.en: For you have delivered me from death and my feet from stumbling, that I may walk before God in the light of life.

57.zh: （大卫逃避扫罗，藏在洞里。那时，他作这金诗，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。）神啊，求你怜悯我，怜悯我！因为我的心投靠你。我要投靠在你翅膀的荫下，等到灾害过去。
57.en: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me, for in you my soul takes refuge. I will take refuge in the shadow of your wings until the disaster has passed.

57.zh: 我要求告至高的神，就是为我成全诸事的　神。
57.en: I cry out to God Most High, to God, who fulfills [his purpose] for me.

57.zh: 那要吞我的人辱骂我的时候，神从天上必施恩救我，也必向我发出慈爱和诚实。
57.en: He sends from heaven and saves me, rebuking those who hotly pursue me; Selah God sends his love and his faithfulness.

57.zh: 我的性命在狮子中间；我躺卧在性如烈火的世人当中。他们的牙齿是枪、箭；他们的舌头是快刀。
57.en: I am in the midst of lions; I lie among ravenous beasts- men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.

57.zh: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！愿你的荣耀高过全地！
57.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

57.zh: 他们为我的脚设下网罗，压制我的心；他们在我面前挖了坑，自己反掉在其中。（细拉）
57.en: They spread a net for my feet- I was bowed down in distress. They dug a pit in my path- but they have fallen into it themselves. Selah

57.zh: 神啊，我心坚定，我心坚定；我要唱诗，我要歌颂！
57.en: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast; I will sing and make music.

57.zh: 我的灵（原文是荣耀）啊，你当醒起！琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！我自己要极早醒起！
57.en: Awake, my soul! Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

57.zh: 主啊，我要在万民中称谢你，在列邦中歌颂你！
57.en: I will praise you, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

57.zh: 因为，你的慈爱高及诸天；你的诚实达到穹苍。
57.en: For great is your love, reaching to the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

57.zh: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！愿你的荣耀高过全地！
57.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; let your glory be over all the earth.

58.zh: （大卫的金诗，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。）世人哪，你们默然不语，真合公义么？施行审判，岂按正直么？
58.en: Do you rulers indeed speak justly? Do you judge uprightly among men?

58.zh: 不然！你们是心中作恶；你们在地上秤出你们手所行的强暴。
58.en: No, in your heart you devise injustice, and your hands mete out violence on the earth.

58.zh: 恶人一出母胎就与神疏远，一离母腹便走错路，说谎话。
58.en: Even from birth the wicked go astray; from the womb they are wayward and speak lies.

58.zh: 他们的毒气好像蛇的毒气；他们好像塞耳的聋虺，
58.en: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like that of a cobra that has stopped its ears,

58.zh: 不听行法术的声音，虽用极灵的咒语也是不听。
58.en: that will not heed the tune of the charmer, however skillful the enchanter may be.

58.zh: 神啊，求你敲碎他们口中的牙；耶和华啊，求你敲掉少壮狮子的大牙！
58.en: Break the teeth in their mouths, O God; tear out, O Lord , the fangs of the lions!

58.zh: 愿他们消灭，如急流的水一般；他们瞅准射箭的时候，愿箭头彷佛砍断。
58.en: Let them vanish like water that flows away; when they draw the bow, let their arrows be blunted.

58.zh: 愿他们像蜗牛消化过去，又像妇人坠落未见天日的胎。
58.en: Like a slug melting away as it moves along, like a stillborn child, may they not see the sun.

58.zh: 你们用荆棘烧火，锅还未热，他要用旋风把青的和烧著的一齐刮去。
58.en: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns- whether they be green or dry-the wicked will be swept away.

58.zh: 义人见仇敌遭报就欢喜，要在恶人的血中洗脚。
58.en: The righteous will be glad when they are avenged, when they bathe their feet in the blood of the wicked.

58.zh: 因此，人必说：义人诚然有善报；在地上果有施行判断的神！
58.en: Then men will say, "Surely the righteous still are rewarded; surely there is a God who judges the earth."

59.zh: （扫罗打发人窥探大卫的房屋，要杀他。那时，大卫用这金诗，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。）我的神啊，求你救我脱离仇敌，把我安置在高处，得脱那些起来攻击我的人。
59.en: Deliver me from my enemies, O God; protect me from those who rise up against me.

59.zh: 求你救我脱离作孽的人和喜爱流人血的人！
59.en: Deliver me from evildoers and save me from bloodthirsty men.

59.zh: 因为，他们埋伏要害我的命；有能力的人聚集来攻击我。耶和华啊，这不是为我的过犯，也不是为我的罪愆。
59.en: See how they lie in wait for me! Fierce men conspire against me for no offense or sin of mine, O Lord .

59.zh: 我虽然无过，他们预备整齐，跑来攻击我。求你兴起鉴察，帮助我！
59.en: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Arise to help me; look on my plight!

59.zh: 万军之神─耶和华以色列的　神啊！求你兴起，惩治万邦！不要怜悯行诡诈的恶人！（细拉）
59.en: O Lord God Almighty, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to wicked traitors. Selah

59.zh: 他们晚上转回，叫号如狗，围城绕行。
59.en: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

59.zh: 他们口中喷吐恶言，嘴里有刀；他们说：有谁听见？
59.en: See what they spew from their mouths- they spew out swords from their lips, and they say, "Who can hear us?"

59.zh: 但你─耶和华必笑话他们；你要嗤笑万邦。
59.en: But you, O Lord , laugh at them; you scoff at all those nations.

59.zh: 我的力量啊，我必仰望你，因为神是我的高台。
59.en: O my Strength, I watch for you; you, O God, are my fortress,

59.zh: 我的神要以慈爱迎接我；　神要叫我看见我仇敌遭报。
59.en: my loving God. God will go before me and will let me gloat over those who slander me.

59.zh: 不要杀他们，恐怕我的民忘记。主啊，你是我们的盾牌；求你用你的能力使他们四散，且降为卑。
59.en: But do not kill them, O Lord our shield, or my people will forget. In your might make them wander about, and bring them down.

59.zh: 他们口中的罪和嘴里的言语，并咒骂虚谎的话，愿他们在骄傲之中被缠住了。
59.en: For the sins of their mouths, for the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride. For the curses and lies they utter,

59.zh: 求你发怒，使他们消灭，以致归于无有，叫他们知道神在雅各中间掌权，直到地极。（细拉）
59.en: consume them in wrath, consume them till they are no more. Then it will be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah

59.zh: 到了晚上，任凭他们转回；任凭他们叫号如狗，围城绕行。
59.en: They return at evening, snarling like dogs, and prowl about the city.

59.zh: 他们必走来走去，寻找食物，若不得饱就终夜在外。
59.en: They wander about for food and howl if not satisfied.

59.zh: 但我要歌颂你的力量，早晨要高唱你的慈爱；因为你作过我的高台，在我急难的日子作过我的避难所。
59.en: But I will sing of your strength, in the morning I will sing of your love; for you are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.

59.zh: 我的力量啊，我要歌颂你；因为神是我的高台，是赐恩与我的　神。
59.en: O my Strength, I sing praise to you; you, O God, are my fortress, my loving God.

60.zh: （大卫与两河间的亚兰并琐巴的亚兰争战的时候，约押转回，在盐谷攻击以东，杀了一万二千人。那时，大卫作这金诗叫人学习，交与伶长。调用为证的百合花。）神啊，你丢弃了我们，使我们破败；你向我们发怒，求你使我们复兴！
60.en: You have rejected us, O God, and burst forth upon us; you have been angry-now restore us!

60.zh: 你使地震动，而且崩裂；求你将裂口医好，因为地摇动。
60.en: You have shaken the land and torn it open; mend its fractures, for it is quaking.

60.zh: 你叫你的民遇见艰难；你叫我们喝那使人东倒西歪的酒。
60.en: You have shown your people desperate times; you have given us wine that makes us stagger.

60.zh: 你把旌旗赐给敬畏你的人，可以为真理扬起来。（细拉）
60.en: But for those who fear you, you have raised a banner to be unfurled against the bow. Selah

60.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们，好叫你所亲爱的人得救。
60.en: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

60.zh: 神已经指著他的圣洁说（说：或译应许我）：我要欢乐；我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。
60.en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.

60.zh: 基列是我的，玛拿西也是我的。以法莲是护卫我头的；犹大是我的杖。
60.en: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.

60.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆；我要向以东抛鞋。非利士啊，你还能因我欢呼么？
60.en: Moab is my washbasin, upon Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

60.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城？谁能引我到以东地？
60.en: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

60.zh: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们么？神啊，你不和我们的军兵同去么？
60.en: Is it not you, O God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

60.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人，因为人的帮助是枉然的。
60.en: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

60.zh: 我们倚靠神才得施展大能，因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。
60.en: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

61.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）神啊，求你听我的呼求，侧耳听我的祷告！
61.en: Hear my cry, O God; listen to my prayer.

61.zh: 我心里发昏的时候，我要从地极求告你。求你领我到那比我更高的磐石！
61.en: From the ends of the earth I call to you, I call as my heart grows faint; lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

61.zh: 因为你作过我的避难所，作过我的坚固台，脱离仇敌。
61.en: For you have been my refuge, a strong tower against the foe.

61.zh: 我要永远住在你的帐幕里！我要投靠在你翅膀下的隐密处！（细拉）
61.en: I long to dwell in your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah

61.zh: 神啊，你原是听了我所许的愿；你将产业赐给敬畏你名的人。
61.en: For you have heard my vows, O God; you have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

61.zh: 你要加添王的寿数；他的年岁必存到世世。
61.en: Increase the days of the king's life, his years for many generations.

61.zh: 他必永远坐在神面前；愿你预备慈爱和诚实保佑他！
61.en: May he be enthroned in God's presence forever; appoint your love and faithfulness to protect him.

61.zh: 这样，我要歌颂你的名，直到永远，好天天还我所许的愿。
61.en: Then will I ever sing praise to your name and fulfill my vows day after day.

62.zh: （大卫的诗，照耶杜顿的作法，交与伶长。）我的心默默无声，专等候神；我的救恩是从他而来。
62.en: My soul finds rest in God alone; my salvation comes from him.

62.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高台，我必不很动摇。
62.en: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will never be shaken.

62.zh: 你们大家攻击一人，把他毁坏，如同毁坏歪斜的墙、将倒的壁，要到几时呢？
62.en: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down- this leaning wall, this tottering fence?

62.zh: 他们彼此商议，专要从他的尊位上把他推下；他们喜爱谎话，口虽祝福，心却咒诅。（细拉）
62.en: They fully intend to topple him from his lofty place; they take delight in lies. With their mouths they bless, but in their hearts they curse. Selah

62.zh: 我的心哪，你当默默无声，专等候神，因为我的盼望是从他而来。
62.en: Find rest, O my soul, in God alone; my hope comes from him.

62.zh: 惟独他是我的磐石，我的拯救；他是我的高台，我必不动摇。
62.en: He alone is my rock and my salvation; he is my fortress, I will not be shaken.

62.zh: 我的拯救、我的荣耀都在乎神；我力量的磐石、我的避难所都在乎　神。
62.en: My salvation and my honor depend on God ; he is my mighty rock, my refuge.

62.zh: 你们众民当时时倚靠他，在他面前倾心吐意；神是我们的避难所。（细拉）
62.en: Trust in him at all times, O people; pour out your hearts to him, for God is our refuge. Selah

62.zh: 下流人真是虚空；上流人也是虚假；放在天平里就必浮起；他们一共比空气还轻。
62.en: Lowborn men are but a breath, the highborn are but a lie; if weighed on a balance, they are nothing; together they are only a breath.

62.zh: 不要仗势欺人，也不要因抢夺而骄傲；若财宝加增，不要放在心上。
62.en: Do not trust in extortion or take pride in stolen goods; though your riches increase, do not set your heart on them.

62.zh: 神说了一次、两次，我都听见：就是能力都属乎神。
62.en: One thing God has spoken, two things have I heard: that you, O God, are strong,

62.zh: 主啊，慈爱也是属乎你，因为你照著各人所行的报应他。
62.en: and that you, O Lord, are loving. Surely you will reward each person according to what he has done.

63.zh: （大卫在犹大旷野的时候，作了这诗。）神啊，你是我的神，我要切切地寻求你，在干旱疲乏无水之地，我渴想你；我的心切慕你。
63.en: O God, you are my God, earnestly I seek you; my soul thirsts for you, my body longs for you, in a dry and weary land where there is no water.

63.zh: 我在圣所中曾如此瞻仰你，为要见你的能力和你的荣耀。
63.en: I have seen you in the sanctuary and beheld your power and your glory.

63.zh: 因你的慈爱比生命更好，我的嘴唇要颂赞你。
63.en: Because your love is better than life, my lips will glorify you.

63.zh: 我还活的时候要这样称颂你；我要奉你的名举手。
63.en: I will praise you as long as I live, and in your name I will lift up my hands.

63.zh: 我在床上记念你，在夜更的时候思想你；我的心就像饱足了骨髓肥油，我也要以欢乐的嘴唇赞美你。
63.en: My soul will be satisfied as with the richest of foods; with singing lips my mouth will praise you.
On my bed I remember you; I think of you through the watches of the night.

63.zh: 因为你曾帮助我，我就在你翅膀的荫下欢呼。
63.en: Because you are my help, I sing in the shadow of your wings.

63.zh: 我心紧紧地跟随你；你的右手扶持我。
63.en: My soul clings to you; your right hand upholds me.

63.zh: 但那些寻索要灭我命的人必往地底下去；
63.en: They who seek my life will be destroyed; they will go down to the depths of the earth.

63.zh: 他们必被刀剑所杀，被野狗所吃。
63.en: They will be given over to the sword and become food for jackals.

63.zh: 但是王必因神欢喜。凡指著他发誓的必要夸口，因为说谎之人的口必被塞住。
63.en: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by God's name will praise him, while the mouths of liars will be silenced.

64.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）神啊，我哀叹的时候，求你听我的声音！求你保护我的性命，不受仇敌的惊恐！
64.en: Hear me, O God, as I voice my complaint; protect my life from the threat of the enemy.

64.zh: 求你把我隐藏，使我脱离作恶之人的暗谋和作孽之人的扰乱。
64.en: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from that noisy crowd of evildoers.

64.zh: 他们磨舌如刀，发出苦毒的言语，好像比准了的箭，
64.en: They sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their words like deadly arrows.

64.zh: 要在暗地射完全人；他们忽然射他，并不惧怕。
64.en: They shoot from ambush at the innocent man; they shoot at him suddenly, without fear.

64.zh: 他们彼此勉励设下恶计；他们商量暗设网罗，说：谁能看见？
64.en: They encourage each other in evil plans, they talk about hiding their snares; they say, "Who will see them ?"

64.zh: 他们图谋奸恶，说：我们是极力图谋的。他们各人的意念心思是深的。
64.en: They plot injustice and say, "We have devised a perfect plan!" Surely the mind and heart of man are cunning.

64.zh: 但神要射他们；他们忽然被箭射伤。
64.en: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be struck down.

64.zh: 他们必然绊跌，被自己的舌头所害；凡看见他们的必都摇头。
64.en: He will turn their own tongues against them and bring them to ruin; all who see them will shake their heads in scorn.

64.zh: 众人都要害怕，要传扬神的工作，并且明白他的作为。
64.en: All mankind will fear; they will proclaim the works of God and ponder what he has done.

64.zh: 义人必因耶和华欢喜，并要投靠他；凡心里正直的人都要夸口。
64.en: Let the righteous rejoice in the Lord and take refuge in him; let all the upright in heart praise him!

65.zh: （大卫的诗歌，交与伶长。）神啊，锡安的人都等候赞美你；所许的愿也要向你偿还。
65.en: Praise awaits you, O God, in Zion; to you our vows will be fulfilled.

65.zh: 听祷告的主啊，凡有血气的都要来就你。
65.en: O you who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

65.zh: 罪孽胜了我；至于我们的过犯，你都要赦免。
65.en: When we were overwhelmed by sins, you forgave our transgressions.

65.zh: 你所拣选、使他亲近你、住在你院中的，这人便为有福！我们必因你居所、你圣殿的美福知足了。
65.en: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

65.zh: 拯救我们的神啊，你必以威严秉公义应允我们；你本是一切地极和海上远处的人所倚靠的。
65.en: You answer us with awesome deeds of righteousness, O God our Savior, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas,

65.zh: 他既以大能束腰，就用力量安定诸山，
65.en: who formed the mountains by your power, having armed yourself with strength,

65.zh: 使诸海的响声和其中波浪的响声，并万民的喧哗，都平静了。
65.en: who stilled the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

65.zh: 住在地极的人因你的神迹惧怕；你使日出日落之地都欢呼。
65.en: Those living far away fear your wonders; where morning dawns and evening fades you call forth songs of joy.

65.zh: 你眷顾地，降下透雨，使地大得肥美。神的河满了水；你这样浇灌了地，好为人预备五谷。
65.en: You care for the land and water it; you enrich it abundantly. The streams of God are filled with water to provide the people with grain, for so you have ordained it.

65.zh: 你浇透地的犁沟，润平犁脊，降甘霖，使地软和；其中发长的，蒙你赐福。
65.en: You drench its furrows and level its ridges; you soften it with showers and bless its crops.

65.zh: 你以恩典为年岁的冠冕；你的路径都滴下脂油，
65.en: You crown the year with your bounty, and your carts overflow with abundance.

65.zh: 滴在旷野的草场上。小山以欢乐束腰；
65.en: The grasslands of the desert overflow; the hills are clothed with gladness.

65.zh: 草场以羊群为衣；谷中也长满了五谷。这一切都欢呼歌唱。
65.en: The meadows are covered with flocks and the valleys are mantled with grain; they shout for joy and sing.

66.zh: （一篇诗歌，交与伶长。）全地都当向神欢呼！
66.en: Shout with joy to God, all the earth!

66.zh: 歌颂他名的荣耀！用赞美的言语将他的荣耀发明！
66.en: Sing the glory of his name; make his praise glorious!

66.zh: 当对神说：你的作为何等可畏！因你的大能，仇敌要投降你。
66.en: Say to God, "How awesome are your deeds! So great is your power that your enemies cringe before you.

66.zh: 全地要敬拜你，歌颂你，要歌颂你的名。（细拉）
66.en: All the earth bows down to you; they sing praise to you, they sing praise to your name." Selah

66.zh: 你们来看神所行的，他向世人所做之事是可畏的。
66.en: Come and see what God has done, how awesome his works in man's behalf!

66.zh: 他将海变成干地，众民步行过河；我们在那里因他欢喜。
66.en: He turned the sea into dry land, they passed through the waters on foot- come, let us rejoice in him.

66.zh: 他用权能治理万民，直到永远。他的眼睛鉴察列邦；悖逆的人不可自高。（细拉）
66.en: He rules forever by his power, his eyes watch the nations- let not the rebellious rise up against him. Selah

66.zh: 万民哪，你们当称颂我们的神，使人得听赞美他的声音。
66.en: Praise our God, O peoples, let the sound of his praise be heard;

66.zh: 他使我们的性命存活，也不叫我们的脚摇动。
66.en: he has preserved our lives and kept our feet from slipping.

66.zh: 神啊，你曾试验我们，熬炼我们，如熬炼银子一样。
66.en: For you, O God, tested us; you refined us like silver.

66.zh: 你使我们进入网罗，把重担放在我们的身上。
66.en: You brought us into prison and laid burdens on our backs.

66.zh: 你使人坐车轧我们的头；我们经过水火，你却使我们到丰富之地。
66.en: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but you brought us to a place of abundance.

66.zh: 我要用燔祭进你的殿，向你还我的愿，
66.en: I will come to your temple with burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you-

66.zh: 就是在急难时我嘴唇所发的、口中所许的。
66.en: vows my lips promised and my mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

66.zh: 我要把肥牛作燔祭，将公羊的香祭献给你，又把公牛和山羊献上。（细拉）
66.en: I will sacrifice fat animals to you and an offering of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah

66.zh: 凡敬畏神的人，你们都来听！我要述说他为我所行的事。
66.en: Come and listen, all you who fear God; let me tell you what he has done for me.

66.zh: 我曾用口求告他；我的舌头也称他为高。
66.en: I cried out to him with my mouth; his praise was on my tongue.

66.zh: 我若心里注重罪孽，主必不听。
66.en: If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened;

66.zh: 但神实在听见了；他侧耳听了我祷告的声音。
66.en: but God has surely listened and heard my voice in prayer.

66.zh: 神是应当称颂的！他并没有推却我的祷告，也没有叫他的慈爱离开我。
66.en: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer or withheld his love from me!

67.zh: （一篇诗歌，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）愿神怜悯我们，赐福与我们，用脸光照我们，（细拉）
67.en: May God be gracious to us and bless us and make his face shine upon us, Selah

67.zh: 好叫世界得知你的道路，万国得知你的救恩。
67.en: that your ways may be known on earth, your salvation among all nations.

67.zh: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！愿万民都称赞你！
67.en: May the peoples praise you, O God; may all the peoples praise you.

67.zh: 愿万国都快乐欢呼；因为你必按公正审判万民，引导世上的万国。（细拉）
67.en: May the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you rule the peoples justly and guide the nations of the earth. Selah

67.zh: 神啊，愿列邦称赞你！愿万民都称赞你！
67.en: May the peoples praise you, O God; may all the peoples praise you.

67.zh: 地已经出了土产；神─就是我们的　神要赐福与我们。
67.en: Then the land will yield its harvest, and God, our God, will bless us.

67.zh: 神要赐福与我们；地的四极都要敬畏他！
67.en: God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear him.

68.zh: （大卫的诗歌，交与伶长。）愿神兴起，使他的仇敌四散，叫那恨他的人从他面前逃跑。
68.en: May God arise, may his enemies be scattered; may his foes flee before him.

68.zh: 他们被驱逐，如烟被风吹散；恶人见神之面而消灭，如蜡被火镕化。
68.en: As smoke is blown away by the wind, may you blow them away; as wax melts before the fire, may the wicked perish before God.

68.zh: 惟有义人必然欢喜，在神面前高兴快乐。
68.en: But may the righteous be glad and rejoice before God; may they be happy and joyful.

68.zh: 你们当向神唱诗，歌颂他的名；为那坐车行过旷野的修平大路。他的名是耶和华，要在他面前欢乐！
68.en: Sing to God, sing praise to his name, extol him who rides on the clouds - his name is the Lord - and rejoice before him.

68.zh: 神在他的圣所作孤儿的父，作寡妇的伸冤者。
68.en: A father to the fatherless, a defender of widows, is God in his holy dwelling.

68.zh: 神叫孤独的有家，使被囚的出来享福；惟有悖逆的住在干燥之地。
68.en: God sets the lonely in families, he leads forth the prisoners with singing; but the rebellious live in a sun-scorched land.

68.zh: 神啊，你曾在你百姓前头出来，在旷野行走。（细拉）
68.en: When you went out before your people, O God, when you marched through the wasteland, Selah

68.zh: 那时，地见神的面而震动，天也落雨；西乃山见以色列　神的面也震动。
68.en: the earth shook, the heavens poured down rain, before God, the One of Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.

68.zh: 神啊，你降下大雨；你产业以色列疲乏的时候，你使他坚固。
68.en: You gave abundant showers, O God; you refreshed your weary inheritance.

68.zh: 你的会众住在其中；神啊，你的恩惠是为困苦人预备的。
68.en: Your people settled in it, and from your bounty, O God, you provided for the poor.

68.zh: 主发命令，传好信息的妇女成了大群。
68.en: The Lord announced the word, and great was the company of those who proclaimed it:

68.zh: 统兵的君王逃跑了，逃跑了；在家等候的妇女分受所夺的。
68.en: "Kings and armies flee in haste; in the camps men divide the plunder.

68.zh: 你们安卧在羊圈的时候，好像鸽子的翅膀镀白银，翎毛镀黄金一般。
68.en: Even while you sleep among the campfires, the wings of my dove are sheathed with silver, its feathers with shining gold."

68.zh: 全能者在境内赶散列王的时候，势如飘雪在撒们。
68.en: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like snow fallen on Zalmon.

68.zh: 巴珊山是神的山；巴珊山是多峰多岭的山。
68.en: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains; rugged are the mountains of Bashan.

68.zh: 你们多峰多岭的山哪，为何斜看神所愿居住的山？耶和华必住这山，直到永远！
68.en: Why gaze in envy, O rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign, where the Lord himself will dwell forever?

68.zh: 神的车葱讵万盈千；主在其中，好像在西乃圣山一样。
68.en: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands; the Lord has come from Sinai into his sanctuary.

68.zh: 你已经升上高天，掳掠仇敌；你在人间，就是在悖逆的人间，受了供献，叫耶和华神可以与他们同住。
68.en: When you ascended on high, you led captives in your train; you received gifts from men, even from the rebellious- that you, O Lord God, might dwell there.

68.zh: 天天背负我们重担的主，就是拯救我们的神，是应当称颂的！（细拉）
68.en: Praise be to the Lord, to God our Savior, who daily bears our burdens. Selah

68.zh: 神是为我们施行诸般救恩的神；人能脱离死亡是在乎主耶和华。
68.en: Our God is a God who saves; from the Sovereign Lord comes escape from death.

68.zh: 但神要打破他仇敌的头，就是那常犯罪之人的发顶。
68.en: Surely God will crush the heads of his enemies, the hairy crowns of those who go on in their sins.

68.zh: 主说：我要使众民从巴珊而归，使他们从深海而回，
68.en: The Lord says, "I will bring them from Bashan; I will bring them from the depths of the sea,

68.zh: 使你打碎仇敌，你的脚踹在血中，使你狗的舌头从其中得分。
68.en: that you may plunge your feet in the blood of your foes, while the tongues of your dogs have their share."

68.zh: 神啊，你是我的神，我的王；人已经看见你行走，进入圣所。
68.en: Your procession has come into view, O God, the procession of my God and King into the sanctuary.

68.zh: 歌唱的行在前，作乐的随在后，都在击鼓的童女中间。
68.en: In front are the singers, after them the musicians; with them are the maidens playing tambourines.

68.zh: 从以色列源头而来的，当在各会中称颂主神！
68.en: Praise God in the great congregation; praise the Lord in the assembly of Israel.

68.zh: 在那里，有统管他们的小便雅悯，有犹大的首领和他们的群众，有西布伦的首领，有拿弗他利的首领。
68.en: There is the little tribe of Benjamin, leading them, there the great throng of Judah's princes, and there the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.

68.zh: 以色列的能力是神所赐的；　神啊，求你坚固你为我们所成全的事！
68.en: Summon your power, O God ; show us your strength, O God, as you have done before.

68.zh: 因你耶路撒冷的殿，列王必带贡物献给你。
68.en: Because of your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring you gifts.

68.zh: 求你叱喝芦苇中的野兽和群公牛，并列邦中的牛犊。把银块踹在脚下；神已经赶散好争战的列邦。
68.en: Rebuke the beast among the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations. Humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

68.zh: 埃及的公侯要出来朝见神；古实人要急忙举手祷告。
68.en: Envoys will come from Egypt; Cush will submit herself to God.

68.zh: 世上的列国啊，你们要向神歌唱；愿你们歌颂主！
68.en: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth, sing praise to the Lord, Selah

68.zh: 歌颂那自古驾行在诸天以上的主！他发出声音，是极大的声音。
68.en: to him who rides the ancient skies above, who thunders with mighty voice.

68.zh: 你们要将能力归给神。他的威荣在以色列之上；他的能力是在穹苍。
68.en: Proclaim the power of God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose power is in the skies.

68.zh: 神啊，你从圣所显为可畏；以色列的神是那将力量权能赐给他百姓的。神是应当称颂的！
68.en: You are awesome, O God, in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

69.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。调用百合花。）神啊，求你救我！因为众水要淹没我。
69.en: Save me, O God, for the waters have come up to my neck.

69.zh: 我陷在深淤泥中，没有立脚之地；我到了深水中，大水漫过我身。
69.en: I sink in the miry depths, where there is no foothold. I have come into the deep waters; the floods engulf me.

69.zh: 我因呼求困乏，喉咙发干；我因等候神，眼睛失明。
69.en: I am worn out calling for help; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

69.zh: 无故恨我的，比我头发还多；无理与我为仇、要把我剪除的，甚为强盛。我没有抢夺的，要叫我偿还。
69.en: Those who hate me without reason outnumber the hairs of my head; many are my enemies without cause, those who seek to destroy me. I am forced to restore what I did not steal.

69.zh: 神啊，我的愚昧，你原知道；我的罪愆不能隐瞒。
69.en: You know my folly, O God; my guilt is not hidden from you.

69.zh: 万军的主─耶和华啊，求你叫那等候你的，不要因我蒙羞！以色列的神啊，求你叫那寻求你的，不要因我受辱！
69.en: May those who hope in you not be disgraced because of me, O Lord, the Lord Almighty; may those who seek you not be put to shame because of me, O God of Israel.

69.zh: 因我为你的缘故受了辱骂，满面羞愧。
69.en: For I endure scorn for your sake, and shame covers my face.

69.zh: 我的弟兄看我为外路人；我的同胞看我为外邦人。
69.en: I am a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my own mother's sons;

69.zh: 因我为你的殿心里焦急，如同火烧，并且辱骂你人的辱骂都落在我身上。
69.en: for zeal for your house consumes me, and the insults of those who insult you fall on me.

69.zh: 我哭泣，以禁食刻苦我心；这倒算为我的羞辱。
69.en: When I weep and fast, I must endure scorn;

69.zh: 我拿麻布当衣裳，就成了他们的笑谈。
69.en: when I put on sackcloth, people make sport of me.

69.zh: 坐在城门口的谈论我；酒徒也以我为歌曲。
69.en: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of the drunkards.

69.zh: 但我在悦纳的时候向你─耶和华祈祷。神啊，求你按你丰盛的慈爱，凭你拯救的诚实应允我！
69.en: But I pray to you, O Lord , in the time of your favor; in your great love, O God, answer me with your sure salvation.

69.zh: 求你搭救我出离淤泥，不叫我陷在其中；求你使我脱离那些恨我的人，使我出离深水。
69.en: Rescue me from the mire, do not let me sink; deliver me from those who hate me, from the deep waters.

69.zh: 求你不容大水漫过我，不容深渊吞灭我，不容坑坎在我以上合口。
69.en: Do not let the floodwaters engulf me or the depths swallow me up or the pit close its mouth over me.

69.zh: 耶和华啊，求你应允我！因为你的慈爱本为美好；求你按你丰盛的慈悲回转眷顾我！
69.en: Answer me, O Lord , out of the goodness of your love; in your great mercy turn to me.

69.zh: 不要掩面不顾你的仆人；我是在急难之中，求你速速地应允我！
69.en: Do not hide your face from your servant; answer me quickly, for I am in trouble.

69.zh: 求你亲近我，救赎我！求你因我的仇敌把我赎回！
69.en: Come near and rescue me; redeem me because of my foes.

69.zh: 你知道我受的辱骂、欺凌、羞辱；我的敌人都在你面前。
69.en: You know how I am scorned, disgraced and shamed; all my enemies are before you.

69.zh: 辱骂伤破了我的心，我又满了忧愁。我指望有人体恤，却没有一个；我指望有人安慰，却找不著一个。
69.en: Scorn has broken my heart and has left me helpless; I looked for sympathy, but there was none, for comforters, but I found none.

69.zh: 他们拿苦胆给我当食物；我渴了，他们拿醋给我喝。
69.en: They put gall in my food and gave me vinegar for my thirst.

69.zh: 愿他们的筵席在他们面前变为网罗，在他们平安的时候变为机槛。
69.en: May the table set before them become a snare; may it become retribution and a trap.

69.zh: 愿他们的眼睛昏蒙，不得看见；愿你使他们的腰常常战抖。
69.en: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.

69.zh: 求你将你的恼恨倒在他们身上，叫你的烈怒追上他们。
69.en: Pour out your wrath on them; let your fierce anger overtake them.

69.zh: 愿他们的住处变为荒场；愿他们的帐棚无人居住。
69.en: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.

69.zh: 因为，你所击打的，他们就逼迫；你所击伤的，他们戏说他的愁苦。
69.en: For they persecute those you wound and talk about the pain of those you hurt.

69.zh: 愿你在他们的罪上加罪，不容他们在你面前称义。
69.en: Charge them with crime upon crime; do not let them share in your salvation.

69.zh: 愿他们从生命册上被涂抹，不得记录在义人之中。
69.en: May they be blotted out of the book of life and not be listed with the righteous.

69.zh: 但我是困苦忧伤的；神啊，愿你的救恩将我安置在高处。
69.en: I am in pain and distress; may your salvation, O God, protect me.

69.zh: 我要以诗歌赞美神的名，以感谢称他为大！
69.en: I will praise God's name in song and glorify him with thanksgiving.

69.zh: 这便叫耶和华喜悦，胜似献牛，或是献有角有蹄的公牛。
69.en: This will please the Lord more than an ox, more than a bull with its horns and hoofs.

69.zh: 谦卑的人看见了就喜乐；寻求神的人，愿你们的心苏醒。
69.en: The poor will see and be glad- you who seek God, may your hearts live!

69.zh: 因为耶和华听了穷乏人，不藐视被囚的人。
69.en: The Lord hears the needy and does not despise his captive people.

69.zh: 愿天和地、洋海和其中一切的动物都赞美他！
69.en: Let heaven and earth praise him, the seas and all that move in them,

69.zh: 因为神要拯救锡安，建造犹大的城邑；他的民要在那里居住，得以为业。
69.en: for God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah. Then people will settle there and possess it;

69.zh: 他仆人的后裔要承受为业；爱他名的人也要住在其中。
69.en: the children of his servants will inherit it, and those who love his name will dwell there.

70.zh: （大卫的记念诗，交与伶长。）神啊，求你快快搭救我！耶和华啊，求你速速帮助我！
70.en: Hasten, O God, to save me; O Lord , come quickly to help me.

70.zh: 愿那些寻索我命的，抱愧蒙羞；愿那些喜悦我遭害的，退后受辱。
70.en: May those who seek my life be put to shame and confusion; may all who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

70.zh: 愿那些对我说阿哈、阿哈的，因羞愧退后。
70.en: May those who say to me, "Aha! Aha!" turn back because of their shame.

70.zh: 愿一切寻求你的，因你高兴欢喜；愿那些喜爱你救恩的，常说：当尊神为大！
70.en: But may all who seek you rejoice and be glad in you; may those who love your salvation always say, "Let God be exalted!"

70.zh: 但我是困苦穷乏的；神啊，求你速速到我这里来！你是帮助我的，搭救我的。耶和华啊，求你不要耽延！
70.en: Yet I am poor and needy; come quickly to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O Lord , do not delay.

71.zh: 耶和华啊，我投靠你；求你叫我永不羞愧！
71.en: In you, O Lord , I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.

71.zh: 求你凭你的公义搭救我，救拔我；侧耳听我，拯救我！
71.en: Rescue me and deliver me in your righteousness; turn your ear to me and save me.

71.zh: 求你作我常住的磐石；你已经命定要救我，因为你是我的岩石，我的山寨。
71.en: Be my rock of refuge, to which I can always go; give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

71.zh: 我的神啊，求你救我脱离恶人的手，脱离不义和残暴之人的手。
71.en: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of evil and cruel men.

71.zh: 主─耶和华啊，你是我所盼望的；从我年幼，你是我所倚靠的。
71.en: For you have been my hope, O Sovereign Lord , my confidence since my youth.

71.zh: 我从出母胎被你扶持；使我出母腹的是你。我必常常赞美你！
71.en: From birth I have relied on you; you brought me forth from my mother's womb. I will ever praise you.

71.zh: 许多人以我为怪，但你是我坚固的避难所。
71.en: I have become like a portent to many, but you are my strong refuge.

71.zh: 你的赞美，你的荣耀终日必满了我的口。
71.en: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.

71.zh: 我年老的时候，求你不要丢弃我！我力气衰弱的时候，求你不要离弃我！
71.en: Do not cast me away when I am old; do not forsake me when my strength is gone.

71.zh: 我的仇敌议论我；那些窥探要害我命的彼此商议，
71.en: For my enemies speak against me; those who wait to kill me conspire together.

71.zh: 说：神已经离弃他；我们追赶他，捉拿他罢！因为没有人搭救。
71.en: They say, "God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for no one will rescue him."

71.zh: 神啊，求你不要远离我！我的神啊，求你速速帮助我！
71.en: Be not far from me, O God; come quickly, O my God, to help me.

71.zh: 愿那与我性命为敌的，羞愧被灭；愿那谋害我的，受辱蒙羞。
71.en: May my accusers perish in shame; may those who want to harm me be covered with scorn and disgrace.

71.zh: 我却要常常盼望，并要越发赞美你。
71.en: But as for me, I will always have hope; I will praise you more and more.

71.zh: 我的口终日要述说你的公义和你的救恩，因我不计其数。
71.en: My mouth will tell of your righteousness, of your salvation all day long, though I know not its measure.

71.zh: 我要来说主─耶和华大能的事；我单要提说你的公义。
71.en: I will come and proclaim your mighty acts, O Sovereign Lord ; I will proclaim your righteousness, yours alone.

71.zh: 神啊，自我年幼时，你就教训我；直到如今，我传扬你奇妙的作为。
71.en: Since my youth, O God, you have taught me, and to this day I declare your marvelous deeds.

71.zh: 神啊，我到年老发白的时候，求你不要离弃我！等我将你的能力指示下代，将你的大能指示后世的人。
71.en: Even when I am old and gray, do not forsake me, O God, till I declare your power to the next generation, your might to all who are to come.

71.zh: 神啊，你的公义甚高；行过大事的神啊，谁能像你！
71.en: Your righteousness reaches to the skies, O God, you who have done great things. Who, O God, is like you?

71.zh: 你是叫我们多经历重大急难的，必使我们复活，从地的深处救上来。
71.en: Though you have made me see troubles, many and bitter, you will restore my life again; from the depths of the earth you will again bring me up.

71.zh: 求你使我越发昌大，又转来安慰我。
71.en: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.

71.zh: 我的神啊，我要鼓瑟称赞你，称赞你的诚实！以色列的圣者啊，我要弹琴歌颂你！
71.en: I will praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to you with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.

71.zh: 我歌颂你的时候，我的嘴唇和你所赎我的灵魂都必欢呼；
71.en: My lips will shout for joy when I sing praise to you- I, whom you have redeemed.

71.zh: 并且我的舌头必终日讲论你的公义，因为那些谋害我的人已经蒙羞受辱了。
71.en: My tongue will tell of your righteous acts all day long, for those who wanted to harm me have been put to shame and confusion.

72.zh: （所罗门的诗。）神啊，求你将判断的权柄赐给王，将公义赐给王的儿子。
72.en: Endow the king with your justice, O God, the royal son with your righteousness.

72.zh: 他要按公义审判你的民，按公平审判你的困苦人。
72.en: He will judge your people in righteousness, your afflicted ones with justice.

72.zh: 大山小山都要因公义使民得享平安。
72.en: The mountains will bring prosperity to the people, the hills the fruit of righteousness.

72.zh: 他必为民中的困苦人伸冤，拯救穷乏之辈，压碎那欺压人的。
72.en: He will defend the afflicted among the people and save the children of the needy; he will crush the oppressor.

72.zh: 太阳还存，月亮还在，人要敬畏你，直到万代！
72.en: He will endure as long as the sun, as long as the moon, through all generations.

72.zh: 他必降临，像雨降在已割的草地上，如甘霖滋润田地。
72.en: He will be like rain falling on a mown field, like showers watering the earth.

72.zh: 在他的日子，义人要发旺，大有平安，好像月亮长存。
72.en: In his days the righteous will flourish; prosperity will abound till the moon is no more.

72.zh: 他要执掌权柄，从这海直到那海，从大河直到地极。
72.en: He will rule from sea to sea and from the River to the ends of the earth.

72.zh: 住在旷野的，必在他面前下拜；他的仇敌必要舔土。
72.en: The desert tribes will bow before him and his enemies will lick the dust.

72.zh: 他施和海岛的王要进贡；示巴和西巴的王要献礼物。
72.en: The kings of Tarshish and of distant shores will bring tribute to him; the kings of Sheba and Seba will present him gifts.

72.zh: 诸王都要叩拜他；万国都要事奉他。
72.en: All kings will bow down to him and all nations will serve him.

72.zh: 因为，穷乏人呼求的时候，他要搭救；没有人帮助的困苦人，他也要搭救。
72.en: For he will deliver the needy who cry out, the afflicted who have no one to help.

72.zh: 他要怜恤贫寒和穷乏的人，拯救穷苦人的性命。
72.en: He will take pity on the weak and the needy and save the needy from death.

72.zh: 他要救赎他们脱离欺压和强暴；他们的血在他眼中看为宝贵。
72.en: He will rescue them from oppression and violence, for precious is their blood in his sight.

72.zh: 他们要存活。示巴的金子要奉给他；人要常常为他祷告，终日称颂他。
72.en: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him and bless him all day long.

72.zh: 在地的山顶上，五谷必然茂盛（或译：有一把五谷）；所结的谷实要响动，如利巴嫩的树林；城里的人要发旺，如地上的草。
72.en: Let grain abound throughout the land; on the tops of the hills may it sway. Let its fruit flourish like Lebanon; let it thrive like the grass of the field.

72.zh: 他的名要存到永远，要留传如日之久。人要因他蒙福；万国要称他有福。
72.en: May his name endure forever; may it continue as long as the sun. All nations will be blessed through him, and they will call him blessed.

72.zh: 独行奇事的耶和华─以色列的神是应当称颂的！
72.en: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

72.zh: 他荣耀的名也当称颂，直到永远。愿他的荣耀充满全地！阿们！阿们！
72.en: Praise be to his glorious name forever; may the whole earth be filled with his glory. Amen and Amen.

72.zh: 耶西的儿子─大卫的祈祷完毕。
72.en: This concludes the prayers of David son of Jesse.

73.zh: （亚萨的诗。）神实在恩待以色列那些清心的人！
73.en: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

73.zh: 至于我，我的脚几乎失闪；我的脚险些滑跌。
73.en: But as for me, my feet had almost slipped; I had nearly lost my foothold.

73.zh: 我见恶人和狂傲人享平安就心怀不平。
73.en: For I envied the arrogant when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

73.zh: 他们死的时候没有疼痛；他们的力气却也壮实。
73.en: They have no struggles; their bodies are healthy and strong.

73.zh: 他们不像别人受苦，也不像别人遭灾。
73.en: They are free from the burdens common to man; they are not plagued by human ills.

73.zh: 所以，骄傲如链子戴在他们的项上；强暴像衣裳遮住他们的身体。
73.en: Therefore pride is their necklace; they clothe themselves with violence.

73.zh: 他们的眼睛因体胖而凸出；他们所得的，过于心里所想的。
73.en: From their callous hearts comes iniquity ; the evil conceits of their minds know no limits.

73.zh: 他们讥笑人，凭恶意说欺压人的话；他们说话自高。
73.en: They scoff, and speak with malice; in their arrogance they threaten oppression.

73.zh: 他们的口亵渎上天；他们的舌毁谤全地。
73.en: Their mouths lay claim to heaven, and their tongues take possession of the earth.

73.zh: 所以神的民归到这里，喝尽了满杯的苦水。
73.en: Therefore their people turn to them and drink up waters in abundance.

73.zh: 他们说：神怎能晓得？至高者岂有知识呢？
73.en: They say, "How can God know? Does the Most High have knowledge?"

73.zh: 看哪，这就是恶人；他们既是常享安逸，财宝便加增。
73.en: This is what the wicked are like- always carefree, they increase in wealth.

73.zh: 我实在徒然洁净了我的心，徒然洗手表明无辜。
73.en: Surely in vain have I kept my heart pure; in vain have I washed my hands in innocence.

73.zh: 因为，我终日遭灾难；每早晨受惩治。
73.en: All day long I have been plagued; I have been punished every morning.

73.zh: 我若说，我要这样讲，这就是以奸诈待你的众子。
73.en: If I had said, "I will speak thus," I would have betrayed your children.

73.zh: 我思索怎能明白这事，眼看实系为难，
73.en: When I tried to understand all this, it was oppressive to me

73.zh: 等我进了神的圣所，思想他们的结局。
73.en: till I entered the sanctuary of God; then I understood their final destiny.

73.zh: 你实在把他们安在滑地，使他们掉在沉沦之中。
73.en: Surely you place them on slippery ground; you cast them down to ruin.

73.zh: 他们转眼之间成了何等的荒凉！他们被惊恐灭尽了。
73.en: How suddenly are they destroyed, completely swept away by terrors!

73.zh: 人睡醒了，怎样看梦；主啊，你醒了也必照样轻看他们的影像。
73.en: As a dream when one awakes, so when you arise, O Lord, you will despise them as fantasies.

73.zh: 因而，我心里发酸，肺腑被刺。
73.en: When my heart was grieved and my spirit embittered,

73.zh: 我这样愚昧无知，在你面前如畜类一般。
73.en: I was senseless and ignorant; I was a brute beast before you.

73.zh: 然而，我常与你同在；你搀著我的右手。
73.en: Yet I am always with you; you hold me by my right hand.

73.zh: 你要以你的训言引导我，以后必接我到荣耀里。
73.en: You guide me with your counsel, and afterward you will take me into glory.

73.zh: 除你以外，在天上我有谁呢？除你以外，在地上我也没有所爱慕的。
73.en: Whom have I in heaven but you? And earth has nothing I desire besides you.

73.zh: 我的肉体和我的心肠衰残；但神是我心里的力量，又是我的福分，直到永远。
73.en: My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

73.zh: 远离你的，必要死亡；凡离弃你行邪淫的，你都灭绝了。
73.en: Those who are far from you will perish; you destroy all who are unfaithful to you.

73.zh: 但我亲近神是与我有益；我以主耶和华为我的避难所，好叫我述说你一切的作为。
73.en: But as for me, it is good to be near God. I have made the Sovereign Lord my refuge; I will tell of all your deeds.

74.zh: （亚萨的训诲诗。）神啊，你为何永远丢弃我们呢？你为何向你草场的羊发怒，如烟冒出呢？
74.en: Why have you rejected us forever, O God? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

74.zh: 求你记念你古时所得来的会众，就是你所赎﹔作你产业支派的，并记念你向来所居住的锡安山。
74.en: Remember the people you purchased of old, the tribe of your inheritance, whom you redeemed- Mount Zion, where you dwelt.

74.zh: 求你举步去看那日久荒凉之地，仇敌在圣所中所行的一切恶事。
74.en: Turn your steps toward these everlasting ruins, all this destruction the enemy has brought on the sanctuary.

74.zh: 你的敌人在你会中吼叫；他们竖了自己的旗为记号。
74.en: Your foes roared in the place where you met with us; they set up their standards as signs.

74.zh: 他们好像人扬起斧子，砍伐林中的树。
74.en: They behaved like men wielding axes to cut through a thicket of trees.

74.zh: 圣所中一切雕刻的，他们现在用斧子锤子打坏了。
74.en: They smashed all the carved paneling with their axes and hatchets.

74.zh: 他们用火焚烧你的圣所，亵渎你名的居所，拆毁到地。
74.en: They burned your sanctuary to the ground; they defiled the dwelling place of your Name.

74.zh: 他们心里说：我们要尽行毁灭；他们就在遍地把神的会所都烧毁了。
74.en: They said in their hearts, "We will crush them completely!" They burned every place where God was worshiped in the land.

74.zh: 我们不见我们的标帜，不再有先知；我们内中也没有人知道这灾祸要到几时呢！
74.en: We are given no miraculous signs; no prophets are left, and none of us knows how long this will be.

74.zh: 神啊，敌人辱骂要到几时呢？仇敌亵渎你的名要到永远么？
74.en: How long will the enemy mock you, O God? Will the foe revile your name forever?

74.zh: 你为甚么缩回你的右手？求你从怀中伸出来，毁灭他们。
74.en: Why do you hold back your hand, your right hand? Take it from the folds of your garment and destroy them!

74.zh: 神自古以来为我的王，在地上施行拯救。
74.en: But you, O God, are my king from of old; you bring salvation upon the earth.

74.zh: 你曾用能力将海分开，将水中大鱼的头打破。
74.en: It was you who split open the sea by your power; you broke the heads of the monster in the waters.

74.zh: 你曾砸碎鳄鱼的头，把他给旷野的禽兽（禽兽：原文是民）为食物。
74.en: It was you who crushed the heads of Leviathan and gave him as food to the creatures of the desert.

74.zh: 你曾分裂磐石，水便成了溪河；你使长流的江河干了。
74.en: It was you who opened up springs and streams; you dried up the ever flowing rivers.

74.zh: 白昼属你，黑夜也属你；亮光和日头是你所预备的。
74.en: The day is yours, and yours also the night; you established the sun and moon.

74.zh: 地的一切疆界是你所立的；夏天和冬天是你所定的。
74.en: It was you who set all the boundaries of the earth; you made both summer and winter.

74.zh: 耶和华啊，仇敌辱骂，愚顽民亵渎了你的名，求你记念这事。
74.en: Remember how the enemy has mocked you, O Lord , how foolish people have reviled your name.

74.zh: 不要将你斑鸠的性命交给野兽；不要永远忘记你困苦人的性命。
74.en: Do not hand over the life of your dove to wild beasts; do not forget the lives of your afflicted people forever.

74.zh: 求你顾念所立的约，因为地上黑暗之处都满了强暴的居所。
74.en: Have regard for your covenant, because haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.

74.zh: 不要叫受欺压的人蒙羞回去；要叫困苦穷乏的人赞美你的名。
74.en: Do not let the oppressed retreat in disgrace; may the poor and needy praise your name.

74.zh: 神啊，求你起来为自己伸诉！要记念愚顽人怎样终日辱骂你。
74.en: Rise up, O God, and defend your cause; remember how fools mock you all day long.

74.zh: 不要忘记你敌人的声音；那起来敌你之人的喧哗时常上升。
74.en: Do not ignore the clamor of your adversaries, the uproar of your enemies, which rises continually.

75.zh: （亚萨的诗歌，交与伶长。调用休要毁坏。）神啊，我们称谢你，我们称谢你！因为你的名相近，人都述说你奇妙的作为。
75.en: We give thanks to you, O God, we give thanks, for your Name is near; men tell of your wonderful deeds.

75.zh: 我到了所定的日期，必按正直施行审判。
75.en: You say, "I choose the appointed time; it is I who judge uprightly.

75.zh: 地和其上的居民都消化了；我曾立了地的柱子。（细拉）
75.en: When the earth and all its people quake, it is I who hold its pillars firm. Selah

75.zh: 我对狂傲人说：不要行事狂傲！对凶恶人说：不要举角！
75.en: To the arrogant I say, 'Boast no more,' and to the wicked, 'Do not lift up your horns.

75.zh: 不要把你们的角高举；不要挺著颈项说话。
75.en: Do not lift your horns against heaven; do not speak with outstretched neck.' "

75.zh: 因为高举非从东，非从西，也非从南而来。
75.en: No one from the east or the west or from the desert can exalt a man.

75.zh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。
75.en: But it is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.

75.zh: 耶和华手里有杯，其中的酒起沫，杯内满了搀杂的酒；他倒出来，地上的恶人必都喝这酒的渣滓，而且喝尽。
75.en: In the hand of the Lord is a cup full of foaming wine mixed with spices; he pours it out, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to its very dregs.

75.zh: 但我要宣扬，直到永远！我要歌颂雅各的神！
75.en: As for me, I will declare this forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.

75.zh: 恶人一切的角，我要砍断；惟有义人的角必被高举。
75.en: I will cut off the horns of all the wicked, but the horns of the righteous will be lifted up.

76.zh: （亚萨的诗歌，交与伶长。用丝弦的乐器。）在犹大，神为人所认识；在以色列，他的名为大。
76.en: In Judah God is known; his name is great in Israel.

76.zh: 在撒冷有他的帐幕；在锡安有他的居所。
76.en: His tent is in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.

76.zh: 他在那里折断弓上的火箭，并盾牌、刀剑，和争战的兵器。（细拉）
76.en: There he broke the flashing arrows, the shields and the swords, the weapons of war. Selah

76.zh: 你从有野食之山而来，有光华和荣美。
76.en: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains rich with game.

76.zh: 心中勇敢的人都被抢夺；他们睡了长觉，没有一个英雄能措手。
76.en: Valiant men lie plundered, they sleep their last sleep; not one of the warriors can lift his hands.

76.zh: 雅各的神啊，你的斥责一发，坐车的﹔骑马的都沉睡了。
76.en: At your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and chariot lie still.

76.zh: 惟独你是可畏的！你怒气一发，谁能在你面前站得住呢？
76.en: You alone are to be feared. Who can stand before you when you are angry?

76.zh: 你从天上使人听判断。神起来施行审判，要救地上一切谦卑的人；那时地就惧怕而静默。（细拉）
76.en: From heaven you pronounced judgment, and the land feared and was quiet-
when you, O God, rose up to judge, to save all the afflicted of the land. Selah

76.zh: 人的忿怒要成全你的荣美；人的余怒，你要禁止。
76.en: Surely your wrath against men brings you praise, and the survivors of your wrath are restrained.

76.zh: 你们许愿，当向耶和华─你们的神还愿；在他四面的人都当拿贡物献给那可畏的主。
76.en: Make vows to the Lord your God and fulfill them; let all the neighboring lands bring gifts to the One to be feared.

76.zh: 他要挫折王子的骄气；他向地上的君王显威可畏。
76.en: He breaks the spirit of rulers; he is feared by the kings of the earth.

77.zh: （亚萨的诗，照耶杜顿的作法，交与伶长。）我要向神发声呼求；我向　神发声，他必留心听我。
77.en: I cried out to God for help; I cried out to God to hear me.

77.zh: 我在患难之日寻求主；我在夜间不住地举手祷告；我的心不肯受安慰。
77.en: When I was in distress, I sought the Lord; at night I stretched out untiring hands and my soul refused to be comforted.

77.zh: 我想念神，就烦燥不安；我沉吟悲伤，心便发昏。（细拉）
77.en: I remembered you, O God, and I groaned; I mused, and my spirit grew faint. Selah

77.zh: 你叫我不能闭眼；我烦乱不安，甚至不能说话。
77.en: You kept my eyes from closing; I was too troubled to speak.

77.zh: 我追想古时之日，上古之年。
77.en: I thought about the former days, the years of long ago;

77.zh: 我想起我夜间的歌曲，扪心自问；我心里也仔细省察。
77.en: I remembered my songs in the night. My heart mused and my spirit inquired:

77.zh: 难道主要永远丢弃我，不再施恩么？
77.en: "Will the Lord reject forever? Will he never show his favor again?

77.zh: 难道他的慈爱永远穷尽，他的应许世世废弃么？
77.en: Has his unfailing love vanished forever? Has his promise failed for all time?

77.zh: 难道神忘记开恩，因发怒就止住他的慈悲么？（细拉）
77.en: Has God forgotten to be merciful? Has he in anger withheld his compassion?" Selah

77.zh: 我便说：这是我的懦弱，但我要追念至高者显出右手之年代。
77.en: Then I thought, "To this I will appeal: the years of the right hand of the Most High."

77.zh: 我要提说耶和华所行的；我要记念你古时的奇事。
77.en: I will remember the deeds of the Lord ; yes, I will remember your miracles of long ago.

77.zh: 我也要思想你的经营，默念你的作为。
77.en: I will meditate on all your works and consider all your mighty deeds.

77.zh: 神啊，你的作为是洁净的；有何神大如神呢？
77.en: Your ways, O God, are holy. What god is so great as our God?

77.zh: 你是行奇事的神；你曾在列邦中彰显你的能力。
77.en: You are the God who performs miracles; you display your power among the peoples.

77.zh: 你曾用你的膀臂赎了你的民，就是雅各和约瑟的子孙。（细拉）
77.en: With your mighty arm you redeemed your people, the descendants of Jacob and Joseph. Selah

77.zh: 神啊，诸水见你，一见就都惊惶；深渊也都战抖。
77.en: The waters saw you, O God, the waters saw you and writhed; the very depths were convulsed.

77.zh: 云中倒出水来；天空发出响声；你的箭也飞行四方。
77.en: The clouds poured down water, the skies resounded with thunder; your arrows flashed back and forth.

77.zh: 你的雷声在旋风中；电光照亮世界；大地战抖震动。
77.en: Your thunder was heard in the whirlwind, your lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.

77.zh: 你的道在海中；你的路在大水中；你的脚踪无人知道。
77.en: Your path led through the sea, your way through the mighty waters, though your footprints were not seen.

77.zh: 你曾藉摩西和亚伦的手引导你的百姓，好像羊群一般。
77.en: You led your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

78.zh: （亚萨的训诲诗。）我的民哪，你们要留心听我的训诲，侧耳听我口中的话。
78.en: O my people, hear my teaching; listen to the words of my mouth.

78.zh: 我要开口说比喻；我要说出古时的谜语，
78.en: I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter hidden things, things from of old-

78.zh: 是我们所听见、所知道的，也是我们的祖宗告诉我们的。
78.en: what we have heard and known, what our fathers have told us.

78.zh: 我们不将这些事向他们的子孙隐瞒，要将耶和华的美德和他的能力，并他奇妙的作为，述说给后代听。
78.en: We will not hide them from their children; we will tell the next generation the praiseworthy deeds of the Lord , his power, and the wonders he has done.

78.zh: 因为，他在雅各中立法度，在以色列中设律法；是他吩咐我们祖宗要传给子孙的，
78.en: He decreed statutes for Jacob and established the law in Israel, which he commanded our forefathers to teach their children,

78.zh: 使将要生的后代子孙可以晓得；他们也要起来告诉他们的子孙，
78.en: so the next generation would know them, even the children yet to be born, and they in turn would tell their children.

78.zh: 好叫他们仰望神，不忘记神的作为，惟要守他的命令。
78.en: Then they would put their trust in God and would not forget his deeds but would keep his commands.

78.zh: 不要像他们的祖宗，是顽梗悖逆、居心不正之辈，向著神，心不诚实。
78.en: They would not be like their forefathers- a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose hearts were not loyal to God, whose spirits were not faithful to him.

78.zh: 以法莲的子孙带著兵器，拿著弓，临阵之日转身退后。
78.en: The men of Ephraim, though armed with bows, turned back on the day of battle;

78.zh: 他们不遵守神的约，不肯照他的律法行；
78.en: they did not keep God's covenant and refused to live by his law.

78.zh: 又忘记他所行的和他显给他们奇妙的作为。
78.en: They forgot what he had done, the wonders he had shown them.

78.zh: 他在埃及地，在琐安田，在他们祖宗的眼前施行奇事。
78.en: He did miracles in the sight of their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.

78.zh: 他将海分裂，使他们过去，又叫水立起如垒。
78.en: He divided the sea and led them through; he made the water stand firm like a wall.

78.zh: 他白日用云彩，终夜用火光引导他们。
78.en: He guided them with the cloud by day and with light from the fire all night.

78.zh: 他在旷野分裂磐石，多多地给他们水喝，如从深渊而出。
78.en: He split the rocks in the desert and gave them water as abundant as the seas;

78.zh: 他使水从磐石涌出，叫水如江河下流。
78.en: he brought streams out of a rocky crag and made water flow down like rivers.

78.zh: 他们却仍旧得罪他，在干燥之地悖逆至高者。
78.en: But they continued to sin against him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.

78.zh: 他们心中试探神，随自己所欲的求食物，
78.en: They willfully put God to the test by demanding the food they craved.

78.zh: 并且妄论神说：神在旷野岂能摆设筵席么？
78.en: They spoke against God, saying, "Can God spread a table in the desert?

78.zh: 他曾击打磐石，使水涌出，成了江河；他还能赐粮食么？还能为他的百姓预备肉么？
78.en: When he struck the rock, water gushed out, and streams flowed abundantly. But can he also give us food? Can he supply meat for his people?"

78.zh: 所以，耶和华听见就发怒；有烈火向雅各烧起；有怒气向以色列上腾；
78.en: When the Lord heard them, he was very angry; his fire broke out against Jacob, and his wrath rose against Israel,

78.zh: 因为他们不信服神，不倚赖他的救恩。
78.en: for they did not believe in God or trust in his deliverance.

78.zh: 他却吩咐天空，又敞开天上的门，
78.en: Yet he gave a command to the skies above and opened the doors of the heavens;

78.zh: 降吗哪，像雨给他们吃，将天上的粮食赐给他们。
78.en: he rained down manna for the people to eat, he gave them the grain of heaven.

78.zh: 各人（或译：人）吃大能者的食物；他赐下粮食，使他们饱足。
78.en: Men ate the bread of angels; he sent them all the food they could eat.

78.zh: 他领东风起在天空，又用能力引了南风来。
78.en: He let loose the east wind from the heavens and led forth the south wind by his power.

78.zh: 他降肉，像雨在他们当中，多如尘土，又降飞鸟，多如海沙，
78.en: He rained meat down on them like dust, flying birds like sand on the seashore.

78.zh: 落在他们的营中，在他们住处的四面。
78.en: He made them come down inside their camp, all around their tents.

78.zh: 他们吃了，而且饱足；这样就随了他们所欲的。
78.en: They ate till they had more than enough, for he had given them what they craved.

78.zh: 他们贪而无厌，食物还在他们口中的时候，
78.en: But before they turned from the food they craved, even while it was still in their mouths,

78.zh: 神的怒气就向他们上腾，杀了他们内中的肥壮人，打倒以色列的少年人。
78.en: God's anger rose against them; he put to death the sturdiest among them, cutting down the young men of Israel.

78.zh: 虽是这样，他们仍旧犯罪，不信他奇妙的作为。
78.en: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; in spite of his wonders, they did not believe.

78.zh: 因此，他叫他们的日子全归虚空，叫他们的年岁尽属惊恐。
78.en: So he ended their days in futility and their years in terror.

78.zh: 他杀他们的时候，他们才求问他，回心转意，切切地寻求神。
78.en: Whenever God slew them, they would seek him; they eagerly turned to him again.

78.zh: 他们也追念神是他们的磐石，至高的神是他们的救赎主。
78.en: They remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.

78.zh: 他们却用口谄媚他，用舌向他说谎。
78.en: But then they would flatter him with their mouths, lying to him with their tongues;

78.zh: 因他们的心向他不正，在他的约上也不忠心。
