78.en: their hearts were not loyal to him, they were not faithful to his covenant.

78.zh: 但他有怜悯，赦免他们的罪孽，不灭绝他们，而且屡次消他的怒气，不发尽他的忿怒。
78.en: Yet he was merciful; he forgave their iniquities and did not destroy them. Time after time he restrained his anger and did not stir up his full wrath.

78.zh: 他想到他们不过是血气，是一阵去而不返的风。
78.en: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.

78.zh: 他们在旷野悖逆他，在荒地叫他担忧，何其多呢！
78.en: How often they rebelled against him in the desert and grieved him in the wasteland!

78.zh: 他们再三试探神，惹动以色列的圣者。
78.en: Again and again they put God to the test; they vexed the Holy One of Israel.

78.zh: 他们不追念他的能力（原文是手）和赎他们脱离敌人的日子；
78.en: They did not remember his power- the day he redeemed them from the oppressor,

78.zh: 他怎样在埃及地显神迹，在琐安田显奇事，
78.en: the day he displayed his miraculous signs in Egypt, his wonders in the region of Zoan.

78.zh: 把他们的江河并河的水都变为血，使他们不能喝。
78.en: He turned their rivers to blood; they could not drink from their streams.

78.zh: 他叫苍蝇成群落在他们当中，嘬尽他们，又叫青蛙灭了他们，
78.en: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.

78.zh: 把他们的土产交给蚂蚱，把他们辛苦得来的交给蝗虫。
78.en: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, their produce to the locust.

78.zh: 他降冰雹打坏他们的葡萄树，下严霜打坏他们的桑树，
78.en: He destroyed their vines with hail and their sycamore-figs with sleet.

78.zh: 又把他们的牲畜交给冰雹，把他们的群畜交给闪电。
78.en: He gave over their cattle to the hail, their livestock to bolts of lightning.

78.zh: 他使猛烈的怒气和忿怒、恼恨、苦难成了一群降灾的使者，临到他们。
78.en: He unleashed against them his hot anger, his wrath, indignation and hostility- a band of destroying angels.

78.zh: 他为自己的怒气修平了路，将他们交给瘟疫，使他们死亡，
78.en: He prepared a path for his anger; he did not spare them from death but gave them over to the plague.

78.zh: 在埃及击杀一切长子，在含的帐棚中击杀他们强壮时头生的。
78.en: He struck down all the firstborn of Egypt, the firstfruits of manhood in the tents of Ham.

78.zh: 他却领出自己的民如羊，在旷野引他们如羊群。
78.en: But he brought his people out like a flock; he led them like sheep through the desert.

78.zh: 他领他们稳稳妥妥地，使他们不致害怕；海却淹没他们的仇敌。
78.en: He guided them safely, so they were unafraid; but the sea engulfed their enemies.

78.zh: 他带他们到自己圣地的边界，到他右手所得的这山地。
78.en: Thus he brought them to the border of his holy land, to the hill country his right hand had taken.

78.zh: 他在他们面前赶出外邦人，用绳子将外邦的地量给他们为业，叫以色列支派的人住在他们的帐棚里。
78.en: He drove out nations before them and allotted their lands to them as an inheritance; he settled the tribes of Israel in their homes.

78.zh: 他们仍旧试探、悖逆至高的神，不守他的法度，
78.en: But they put God to the test and rebelled against the Most High; they did not keep his statutes.

78.zh: 反倒退后，行诡诈，像他们的祖宗一样；他们改变，如同翻背的弓。
78.en: Like their fathers they were disloyal and faithless, as unreliable as a faulty bow.

78.zh: 因他们的邱坛惹了他的怒气；因他们雕刻的偶像触动他的愤恨。
78.en: They angered him with their high places; they aroused his jealousy with their idols.

78.zh: 神听见就发怒，极其憎恶以色列人。
78.en: When God heard them, he was very angry; he rejected Israel completely.

78.zh: 甚至他离弃示罗的帐幕，就是他在人间所搭的帐棚；
78.en: He abandoned the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent he had set up among men.

78.zh: 又将他的约柜（原文是能力）交与人掳去，将他的荣耀交在敌人手中；
78.en: He sent the ark of his might into captivity, his splendor into the hands of the enemy.

78.zh: 并将他的百姓交与刀剑，向他的产业发怒。
78.en: He gave his people over to the sword; he was very angry with his inheritance.

78.zh: 少年人被火烧灭；处女也无喜歌。
78.en: Fire consumed their young men, and their maidens had no wedding songs;

78.zh: 祭司倒在刀下，寡妇却不哀哭。
78.en: their priests were put to the sword, and their widows could not weep.

78.zh: 那时，主像世人睡醒，像勇士饮酒呼喊。
78.en: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, as a man wakes from the stupor of wine.

78.zh: 他就打退了他的敌人，叫他们永蒙羞辱；
78.en: He beat back his enemies; he put them to everlasting shame.

78.zh: 并且他弃掉约瑟的帐棚，不拣选以法莲支派，
78.en: Then he rejected the tents of Joseph, he did not choose the tribe of Ephraim;

78.zh: 却拣选犹大支派─他所喜爱的锡安山；
78.en: but he chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which he loved.

78.zh: 盖造他的圣所，好像高峰，又像他建立永存之地；
78.en: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth that he established forever.

78.zh: 又拣选他的仆人大卫，从羊圈中将他召来，
78.en: He chose David his servant and took him from the sheep pens;

78.zh: 叫他不再跟从那些带奶的母羊，为要牧养自己的百姓雅各和自己的产业以色列。
78.en: from tending the sheep he brought him to be the shepherd of his people Jacob, of Israel his inheritance.

78.zh: 于是，他按心中的纯正牧养他们，用手中的巧妙引导他们。
78.en: And David shepherded them with integrity of heart; with skillful hands he led them.

79.zh: （亚萨的诗。）神啊，外邦人进入你的产业，污秽你的圣殿，使耶路撒冷变成荒堆，
79.en: O God, the nations have invaded your inheritance; they have defiled your holy temple, they have reduced Jerusalem to rubble.

79.zh: 把你仆人的尸首交与天空的飞鸟为食，把你圣民的肉交与地上的野兽，
79.en: They have given the dead bodies of your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of your saints to the beasts of the earth.

79.zh: 在耶路撒冷周围流他们的血如水，无人葬埋。
79.en: They have poured out blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.

79.zh: 我们成为邻国的羞辱，成为我们四围人的嗤笑讥刺。
79.en: We are objects of reproach to our neighbors, of scorn and derision to those around us.

79.zh: 耶和华啊，这到几时呢？你要动怒到永远么？你的愤恨要如火焚烧么？
79.en: How long, O Lord ? Will you be angry forever? How long will your jealousy burn like fire?

79.zh: 愿你将你的忿怒倒在那不认识你的外邦和那不求告你名的国度。
79.en: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge you, on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;

79.zh: 因为他们吞了雅各，把他的住处变为荒场。
79.en: for they have devoured Jacob and destroyed his homeland.

79.zh: 求你不要记念我们先祖的罪孽，向我们追讨；愿你的慈悲快迎著我们，因为我们落到极卑微的地步。
79.en: Do not hold against us the sins of the fathers; may your mercy come quickly to meet us, for we are in desperate need.

79.zh: 拯救我们的神啊，求你因你名的荣耀帮助我们！为你名的缘故搭救我们，赦免我们的罪。
79.en: Help us, O God our Savior, for the glory of your name; deliver us and forgive our sins for your name's sake.

79.zh: 为何容外邦人说他们的神在哪里呢？愿你使外邦人知道你在我们眼前伸你仆人流血的冤。
79.en: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Before our eyes, make known among the nations that you avenge the outpoured blood of your servants.

79.zh: 愿被囚之人的叹息达到你面前；愿你按你的大能力存留那些将要死的人。
79.en: May the groans of the prisoners come before you; by the strength of your arm preserve those condemned to die.

79.zh: 主啊，愿你将我们邻邦所羞辱你的羞辱加七倍归到他们身上。
79.en: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors seven times the reproach they have hurled at you, O Lord.

79.zh: 这样，你的民，你草场的羊，要称谢你，直到永远；要述说赞美你的话，直到万代。
79.en: Then we your people, the sheep of your pasture, will praise you forever; from generation to generation we will recount your praise.

80.zh: （亚萨的诗，交与伶长。调用为证的百合花。）领约瑟如领羊群之以色列的牧者啊，求你留心听！坐在二基路伯上的啊，求你发出光来！
80.en: Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock; you who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth

80.zh: 在以法莲、便雅悯、玛拿西前面施展你的大能，来救我们。
80.en: before Ephraim, Benjamin and Manasseh. Awaken your might; come and save us.

80.zh: 神啊，求你使我们回转（或译：复兴），使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
80.en: Restore us, O God; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

80.zh: 耶和华─万军之神啊，你向你百姓的祷告发怒，要到几时呢？
80.en: O Lord God Almighty, how long will your anger smolder against the prayers of your people?

80.zh: 你以眼泪当食物给他们吃，又多量出眼泪给他们喝。
80.en: You have fed them with the bread of tears; you have made them drink tears by the bowlful.

80.zh: 你使邻邦因我们纷争；我们的仇敌彼此戏笑。
80.en: You have made us a source of contention to our neighbors, and our enemies mock us.

80.zh: 万军之神啊，求你使我们回转，使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
80.en: Restore us, O God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

80.zh: 你从埃及挪出一棵葡萄树，赶出外邦人，把这树栽上。
80.en: You brought a vine out of Egypt; you drove out the nations and planted it.

80.zh: 你在这树根前预备了地方，他就深深扎根，爬满了地。
80.en: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.

80.zh: 他的影子遮满了山，枝子好像佳美的香柏树。
80.en: The mountains were covered with its shade, the mighty cedars with its branches.

80.zh: 他发出枝子，长到大海，发出蔓子，延到大河。
80.en: It sent out its boughs to the Sea, its shoots as far as the River.

80.zh: 你为何拆毁这树的篱笆，任凭一切过路的人摘取？
80.en: Why have you broken down its walls so that all who pass by pick its grapes?

80.zh: 林中出来的野猪把他糟踏；野地的走兽拿他当食物。
80.en: Boars from the forest ravage it and the creatures of the field feed on it.

80.zh: 万军之神啊，求你回转！从天上垂看，眷顾这葡萄树，
80.en: Return to us, O God Almighty! Look down from heaven and see! Watch over this vine,

80.zh: 保护你右手所栽的和你为自已所坚固的枝子。
80.en: the root your right hand has planted, the son you have raised up for yourself.

80.zh: 这树已经被火焚烧，被刀砍伐；他们因你脸上的怒容就灭亡了。
80.en: Your vine is cut down, it is burned with fire; at your rebuke your people perish.

80.zh: 愿你的手扶持你右边的人，就是你为自已所坚固的人子。
80.en: Let your hand rest on the man at your right hand, the son of man you have raised up for yourself.

80.zh: 这样，我们便不退后离开你；求你救活我们，我们就要求告你的名。
80.en: Then we will not turn away from you; revive us, and we will call on your name.

80.zh: 耶和华─万军之神啊，求你使我们回转，使你的脸发光，我们便要得救！
80.en: Restore us, O Lord God Almighty; make your face shine upon us, that we may be saved.

81.zh: （亚萨的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。）你们当向神─我们的力量大声欢呼，向雅各的　神发声欢乐！
81.en: Sing for joy to God our strength; shout aloud to the God of Jacob!

81.zh: 唱起诗歌，打手鼓，弹美琴与瑟。
81.en: Begin the music, strike the tambourine, play the melodious harp and lyre.

81.zh: 当在月朔并月望─我们过节的日期吹角，
81.en: Sound the ram's horn at the New Moon, and when the moon is full, on the day of our Feast;

81.zh: 因这是为以色列定的律例，是雅各神的典章。
81.en: this is a decree for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

81.zh: 他去攻击埃及地的时候，在约瑟中间立此为证。我在那里听见我所不明白的言语：
81.en: He established it as a statute for Joseph when he went out against Egypt, where we heard a language we did not understand.

81.zh: 神说：我使你的肩得脱重担，你的手放下筐子。
81.en: He says, "I removed the burden from their shoulders; their hands were set free from the basket.

81.zh: 你在急难中呼求，我就搭救你；我在雷的隐密处应允你，在米利巴水那里试验你。（细拉）
81.en: In your distress you called and I rescued you, I answered you out of a thundercloud; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah

81.zh: 我的民哪，你当听，我要劝戒你；以色列啊，甚愿你肯听从我。
81.en: "Hear, O my people, and I will warn you- if you would but listen to me, O Israel!

81.zh: 在你当中，不可有别的神；外邦的神，你也不可下拜。
81.en: You shall have no foreign god among you; you shall not bow down to an alien god.

81.zh: 我是耶和华─你的神，曾把你从埃及地领上来；你要大大张口，我就给你充满。
81.en: I am the Lord your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth and I will fill it.

81.zh: 无奈，我的民不听我的声音；以色列全不理我。
81.en: "But my people would not listen to me; Israel would not submit to me.

81.zh: 我便任凭他们心里刚硬，随自己的计谋而行。
81.en: So I gave them over to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.

81.zh: 甚愿我的民肯听从我，以色列肯行我的道，
81.en: "If my people would but listen to me, if Israel would follow my ways,

81.zh: 我便速速治服他们的仇敌，反手攻击他们的敌人。
81.en: how quickly would I subdue their enemies and turn my hand against their foes!

81.zh: 恨耶和华的人必来投降，但他的百姓必永久长存。
81.en: Those who hate the Lord would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

81.zh: 他也必拿上好的麦子给他们吃，又拿从磐石出的蜂蜜叫他们饱足。
81.en: But you would be fed with the finest of wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you."

82.zh: （亚萨的诗。）神站在有权力者的会中，在诸　神中行审判，
82.en: God presides in the great assembly; he gives judgment among the "gods":

82.zh: 说：你们审判不秉公义，徇恶人的情面，要到几时呢？（细拉）
82.en: "How long will you defend the unjust and show partiality to the wicked? Selah

82.zh: 你们当为贫寒的人和孤儿伸冤；当为困苦和穷乏的人施行公义。
82.en: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

82.zh: 当保护贫寒和穷乏的人，救他们脱离恶人的手。
82.en: Rescue the weak and needy; deliver them from the hand of the wicked.

82.zh: 你们仍不知道，也不明白，在黑暗中走来走去；地的根基都摇动了。
82.en: "They know nothing, they understand nothing. They walk about in darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.

82.zh: 我曾说：你们是神，都是至高者的儿子。
82.en: "I said, 'You are "gods"; you are all sons of the Most High.'

82.zh: 然而，你们要死，与世人一样，要仆倒，像王子中的一位。
82.en: But you will die like mere men; you will fall like every other ruler."

82.zh: 神啊，求你起来审判世界，因为你要得万邦为业。
82.en: Rise up, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are your inheritance.

83.zh: （亚萨的诗歌。）神啊，求你不要静默！神啊，求你不要闭口，也不要不作声！
83.en: O God, do not keep silent; be not quiet, O God, be not still.

83.zh: 因为你的仇敌喧嚷，恨你的抬起头来。
83.en: See how your enemies are astir, how your foes rear their heads.

83.zh: 他们同谋奸诈要害你的百姓，彼此商议要害你所隐藏的人。
83.en: With cunning they conspire against your people; they plot against those you cherish.

83.zh: 他们说：来罢，我们将他们剪灭，使他们不再成国！使以色列的名不再被人记念！
83.en: "Come," they say, "let us destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel be remembered no more."

83.zh: 他们同心商议，彼此结盟，要抵挡你，
83.en: With one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against you-

83.zh: 就是住帐棚的以东人和以实玛利人，摩押和夏甲人，
83.en: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,

83.zh: 迦巴勒、亚扪，和亚玛力、非利士并推罗的居民。
83.en: Gebal, Ammon and Amalek, Philistia, with the people of Tyre.

83.zh: 亚述也与他们连合；他们作罗得子孙的帮手。（细拉）
83.en: Even Assyria has joined them to lend strength to the descendants of Lot. Selah

83.zh: 求你待他们，如待米甸，如在基顺河待西西拉和耶宾一样。
83.en: Do to them as you did to Midian, as you did to Sisera and Jabin at the river Kishon,

83.zh: 他们在隐多珥灭亡，成了地上的粪土。
83.en: who perished at Endor and became like refuse on the ground.

83.zh: 求你叫他们的首领像俄立和西伊伯，叫他们的王子都像西巴和撒慕拿。
83.en: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

83.zh: 他们说：我们要得神的住处，作为自己的产业。
83.en: who said, "Let us take possession of the pasturelands of God."

83.zh: 我的神啊，求你叫他们像旋风的尘土，像风前的碎秸。
83.en: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.

83.zh: 火怎样焚烧树林，火焰怎样烧著山岭，
83.en: As fire consumes the forest or a flame sets the mountains ablaze,

83.zh: 求你也照样用狂风追赶他们，用暴雨恐吓他们。
83.en: so pursue them with your tempest and terrify them with your storm.

83.zh: 愿你使他们满面羞耻，好叫他们寻求你─耶和华的名！
83.en: Cover their faces with shame so that men will seek your name, O Lord .

83.zh: 愿他们永远羞愧惊惶！愿他们惭愧灭亡！
83.en: May they ever be ashamed and dismayed; may they perish in disgrace.

83.zh: 使他们知道：惟独你─名为耶和华的─是全地以上的至高者！
83.en: Let them know that you, whose name is the Lord - that you alone are the Most High over all the earth.

84.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。用迦特乐器。）万军之耶和华啊，你的居所何等可爱！
84.en: How lovely is your dwelling place, O Lord Almighty!

84.zh: 我羡慕渴想耶和华的院宇；我的心肠，我的肉体向永生神呼吁（或译：欢呼）。
84.en: My soul yearns, even faints, for the courts of the Lord ; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

84.zh: 万军之耶和华─我的王，我的神啊，在你祭坛那里，麻雀为自己找著房屋，燕子为自己找著菢雏之窝。
84.en: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young- a place near your altar, O Lord Almighty, my King and my God.

84.zh: 如此住在你殿中的便为有福！他们仍要赞美你。（细拉）
84.en: Blessed are those who dwell in your house; they are ever praising you. Selah

84.zh: 靠你有力量、心中想往锡安大道的，这人便为有福！
84.en: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on pilgrimage.

84.zh: 他们经过流泪谷，叫这谷变为泉源之地；并有秋雨之福盖满了全谷。
84.en: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; the autumn rains also cover it with pools.

84.zh: 他们行走，力上加力，各人到锡安朝见神。
84.en: They go from strength to strength, till each appears before God in Zion.

84.zh: 耶和华─万军之神啊，求你听我的祷告！雅各的　神啊，求你留心听！（细拉）
84.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord God Almighty; listen to me, O God of Jacob. Selah

84.zh: 神啊，你是我们的盾牌；求你垂顾观看你受膏者的面！
84.en: Look upon our shield, O God; look with favor on your anointed one.

84.zh: 在你的院宇住一日，胜似在别处住千日；宁可在我神殿中看门，不愿住在恶人的帐棚里。
84.en: Better is one day in your courts than a thousand elsewhere; I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.

84.zh: 因为耶和华─神是日头，是盾牌，要赐下恩惠和荣耀。他未尝留下一样好处不给那些行动正直的人。
84.en: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

84.zh: 万军之耶和华啊，倚靠你的人便为有福！
84.en: O Lord Almighty, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

85.zh: （可拉后裔的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，你已经向你的地施恩，救回被掳的雅各。
85.en: You showed favor to your land, O Lord ; you restored the fortunes of Jacob.

85.zh: 你赦免了你百姓的罪孽，遮盖了他们一切的过犯。（细拉）
85.en: You forgave the iniquity of your people and covered all their sins. Selah

85.zh: 你收转了所发的忿怒和你猛烈的怒气。
85.en: You set aside all your wrath and turned from your fierce anger.

85.zh: 拯救我们的神啊，求你使我们回转，叫你的恼恨向我们止息。
85.en: Restore us again, O God our Savior, and put away your displeasure toward us.

85.zh: 你要向我们发怒到永远么？你要将你的怒气延留到万代么？
85.en: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger through all generations?

85.zh: 你不再将我们救活，使你的百姓靠你欢喜么？
85.en: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

85.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们得见你的慈爱，又将你的救恩赐给我们。
85.en: Show us your unfailing love, O Lord , and grant us your salvation.

85.zh: 我要听神─耶和华所说的话；因为他必应许将平安赐给他的百姓─他的圣民；他们却不可再转去妄行。
85.en: I will listen to what God the Lord will say; he promises peace to his people, his saints- but let them not return to folly.

85.zh: 他的救恩诚然与敬畏他的人相近，叫荣耀住在我们的地上。
85.en: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that his glory may dwell in our land.

85.zh: 慈爱和诚实彼此相遇；公义和平安彼此相亲。
85.en: Love and faithfulness meet together; righteousness and peace kiss each other.

85.zh: 诚实从地而生；公义从天而现。
85.en: Faithfulness springs forth from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.

85.zh: 耶和华必将好处赐给我们；我们的地也要多出土产。
85.en: The Lord will indeed give what is good, and our land will yield its harvest.

85.zh: 公义要行在他面前，叫他的脚踪成为可走的路。
85.en: Righteousness goes before him and prepares the way for his steps.

86.zh: （大卫的祈祷。）耶和华啊，求你侧耳应允我，因我是困苦穷乏的。
86.en: Hear, O Lord , and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

86.zh: 求你保存我的性命，因我是虔诚人。我的神啊，求你拯救这倚靠你的仆人！
86.en: Guard my life, for I am devoted to you. You are my God; save your servant who trusts in you.

86.zh: 主啊，求你怜悯我，因我终日求告你。
86.en: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I call to you all day long.

86.zh: 主啊，求你使仆人心里欢喜，因为我的心仰望你。
86.en: Bring joy to your servant, for to you, O Lord, I lift up my soul.

86.zh: 主啊，你本为良善，乐意饶恕人，有丰盛的慈爱赐给凡求告你的人。
86.en: You are forgiving and good, O Lord, abounding in love to all who call to you.

86.zh: 耶和华啊，求你留心听我的祷告，垂听我恳求的声音。
86.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord ; listen to my cry for mercy.

86.zh: 我在患难之日要求告你，因为你必应允我。
86.en: In the day of my trouble I will call to you, for you will answer me.

86.zh: 主啊，诸神之中没有可比你的；你的作为也无可比。
86.en: Among the gods there is none like you, O Lord; no deeds can compare with yours.

86.zh: 主啊，你所造的万民都要来敬拜你；他们也要荣耀你的名。
86.en: All the nations you have made will come and worship before you, O Lord; they will bring glory to your name.

86.zh: 因你为大，且行奇妙的事；惟独你是神。
86.en: For you are great and do marvelous deeds; you alone are God.

86.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的道指教我；我要照你的真理行；求你使我专心敬畏你的名！
86.en: Teach me your way, O Lord , and I will walk in your truth; give me an undivided heart, that I may fear your name.

86.zh: 主─我的神啊，我要一心称赞你；我要荣耀你的名，直到永远。
86.en: I will praise you, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify your name forever.

86.zh: 因为，你向我发的慈爱是大的；你救了我的灵魂免入极深的阴间。
86.en: For great is your love toward me; you have delivered me from the depths of the grave.

86.zh: 神啊，骄傲的人起来攻击我，又有一党强横的人寻索我的命；他们没有将你放在眼中。
86.en: The arrogant are attacking me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life- men without regard for you.

86.zh: 主啊，你是有怜悯有恩典的神，不轻易发怒，并有丰盛的慈爱和诚实。
86.en: But you, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in love and faithfulness.

86.zh: 求你向我转脸，怜恤我，将你的力量赐给仆人，救你婢女的儿子。
86.en: Turn to me and have mercy on me; grant your strength to your servant and save the son of your maidservant.

86.zh: 求你向我显出恩待我的凭据，叫恨我的人看见便羞愧，因为你─耶和华帮助我，安慰我。
86.en: Give me a sign of your goodness, that my enemies may see it and be put to shame, for you, O Lord , have helped me and comforted me.

87.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌。）耶和华所立的根基在圣山上。
87.en: He has set his foundation on the holy mountain;

87.zh: 他爱锡安的门，胜于爱雅各一切的住处。
87.en: the Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

87.zh: 神的城啊，有荣耀的事乃指著你说的。（细拉）
87.en: Glorious things are said of you, O city of God: Selah

87.zh: 我要提起拉哈伯和巴比伦人，是在认识我之中的；看哪，非利士和推罗并古实人，个个生在那里。
87.en: "I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me- Philistia too, and Tyre, along with Cush - and will say, 'This one was born in Zion.' "

87.zh: 论到锡安，必说：这一个、那一个都生在其中，而且至高者必亲自坚立这城。
87.en: Indeed, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High himself will establish her."

87.zh: 当耶和华记录万民的时候，他要点出这一个生在那里。（细拉）
87.en: The Lord will write in the register of the peoples: "This one was born in Zion." Selah

87.zh: 歌唱的，跳舞的，都要说：我的泉源都在你里面。
87.en: As they make music they will sing, "All my fountains are in you."

88.zh: （可拉后裔的诗歌，就是以斯拉人希幔的训诲诗，交与伶长。调用麻哈拉利暗俄。）耶和华─拯救我的神啊，我昼夜在你面前呼吁。
88.en: O Lord , the God who saves me, day and night I cry out before you.

88.zh: 愿我的祷告达到你面前；求你侧耳听我的呼求！
88.en: May my prayer come before you; turn your ear to my cry.

88.zh: 因为我心里满了患难；我的性命临近阴间。
88.en: For my soul is full of trouble and my life draws near the grave.

88.zh: 我算和下坑的人同列，如同无力（或译：没有帮助）的人一样。
88.en: I am counted among those who go down to the pit; I am like a man without strength.

88.zh: 我被丢在死人中，好像被杀的人躺在坟墓里。他们是你不再记念的，与你隔绝了。
88.en: I am set apart with the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more, who are cut off from your care.

88.zh: 你把我放在极深的坑里，在黑暗地方，在深处。
88.en: You have put me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

88.zh: 你的忿怒重压我身；你用一切的波浪困住我。（细拉）
88.en: Your wrath lies heavily upon me; you have overwhelmed me with all your waves. Selah

88.zh: 你把我所认识的隔在远处，使我为他们所憎恶；我被拘困，不得出来。
88.en: You have taken from me my closest friends and have made me repulsive to them. I am confined and cannot escape;

88.zh: 我的眼睛因困苦而干瘪。耶和华啊，我天天求告你，向你举手。
88.en: my eyes are dim with grief. I call to you, O Lord , every day; I spread out my hands to you.

88.zh: 你岂要行奇事给死人看么？难道阴魂还能起来称赞你么？（细拉）
88.en: Do you show your wonders to the dead? Do those who are dead rise up and praise you? Selah

88.zh: 岂能在坟墓里述说你的慈爱么？岂能在灭亡中述说你的信实么？
88.en: Is your love declared in the grave, your faithfulness in Destruction ?

88.zh: 你的奇事岂能在幽暗里被知道么？你的公义岂能在忘记之地被知道么？
88.en: Are your wonders known in the place of darkness, or your righteous deeds in the land of oblivion?

88.zh: 耶和华啊，我呼求你；我早晨的祷告要达到你面前。
88.en: But I cry to you for help, O Lord ; in the morning my prayer comes before you.

88.zh: 耶和华啊，你为何丢弃我？为何掩面不顾我？
88.en: Why, O Lord , do you reject me and hide your face from me?

88.zh: 我自幼受苦，几乎死亡；我受你的惊恐，甚至慌张。
88.en: From my youth I have been afflicted and close to death; I have suffered your terrors and am in despair.

88.zh: 你的烈怒漫过我身；你的惊吓把我剪除。
88.en: Your wrath has swept over me; your terrors have destroyed me.

88.zh: 这些终日如水环绕我，一齐都来围困我。
88.en: All day long they surround me like a flood; they have completely engulfed me.

88.zh: 你把我的良朋密友隔在远处，使我所认识的人进入黑暗里。
88.en: You have taken my companions and loved ones from me; the darkness is my closest friend.

89.zh: （以斯拉人以探的训诲诗。）我要歌唱耶和华的慈爱，直到永远；我要用口将你的信实传与万代。
89.en: I will sing of the Lord 's great love forever; with my mouth I will make your faithfulness known through all generations.

89.zh: 因我曾说：你的慈悲必建立到永远；你的信实必坚立在天上。
89.en: I will declare that your love stands firm forever, that you established your faithfulness in heaven itself.

89.zh: 我与我所拣选的人立了约，向我的仆人大卫起了誓：
89.en: You said, "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David my servant,

89.zh: 我要建立你的后裔，直到永远；要建立你的宝座，直到万代。（细拉）
89.en: 'I will establish your line forever and make your throne firm through all generations.' " Selah

89.zh: 耶和华啊，诸天要称赞你的奇事；在圣者的会中，要称赞你的信实。
89.en: The heavens praise your wonders, O Lord , your faithfulness too, in the assembly of the holy ones.

89.zh: 在天空谁能比耶和华呢？神的众子中，谁能像耶和华呢？
89.en: For who in the skies above can compare with the Lord ? Who is like the Lord among the heavenly beings?

89.zh: 他在圣者的会中，是大有威严的神，比一切在他四围的更可畏惧。
89.en: In the council of the holy ones God is greatly feared; he is more awesome than all who surround him.

89.zh: 耶和华─万军之神啊，哪一个大能者像你耶和华？你的信实是在你的四围。
89.en: O Lord God Almighty, who is like you? You are mighty, O Lord , and your faithfulness surrounds you.

89.zh: 你管辖海的狂傲；波浪翻腾，你就使他平静了。
89.en: You rule over the surging sea; when its waves mount up, you still them.

89.zh: 你打碎了拉哈伯，似乎是已杀的人；你用有能的膀臂打散了你的仇敌。
89.en: You crushed Rahab like one of the slain; with your strong arm you scattered your enemies.

89.zh: 天属你，地也属你；世界和其中所充满的都为你所建立。
89.en: The heavens are yours, and yours also the earth; you founded the world and all that is in it.

89.zh: 南北为你所创造；他泊和黑门都因你的名欢呼。
89.en: You created the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon sing for joy at your name.

89.zh: 你有大能的膀臂；你的手有力，你的右手也高举。
89.en: Your arm is endued with power; your hand is strong, your right hand exalted.

89.zh: 公义和公平是你宝座的根基；慈爱和诚实行在你前面。
89.en: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne; love and faithfulness go before you.

89.zh: 知道向你欢呼的，那民是有福的！耶和华啊，他们在你脸上的末毼行走。
89.en: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, O Lord .

89.zh: 他们因你的名终日欢乐，因你的公义得以高举。
89.en: They rejoice in your name all day long; they exult in your righteousness.

89.zh: 你是他们力量的荣耀；因为你喜悦我们，我们的角必被高举。
89.en: For you are their glory and strength, and by your favor you exalt our horn.

89.zh: 我们的盾牌属耶和华；我们的王属以色列的圣者。
89.en: Indeed, our shield belongs to the Lord , our king to the Holy One of Israel.

89.zh: 当时，你在异象中晓谕你的圣民，说：我已把救助之力加在那有能者的身上；我高举那从民中所拣选的。
89.en: Once you spoke in a vision, to your faithful people you said: "I have bestowed strength on a warrior; I have exalted a young man from among the people.

89.zh: 我寻得我的仆人大卫，用我的圣膏膏他。
89.en: I have found David my servant; with my sacred oil I have anointed him.

89.zh: 我的手必使他坚立；我的膀臂也必坚固他。
89.en: My hand will sustain him; surely my arm will strengthen him.

89.zh: 仇敌必不勒索他；凶恶之子也不苦害他。
89.en: No enemy will subject him to tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

89.zh: 我要在他面前打碎他的敌人，击杀那恨他的人。
89.en: I will crush his foes before him and strike down his adversaries.

89.zh: 只是我的信实和我的慈爱要与他同在；因我的名，他的角必被高举。
89.en: My faithful love will be with him, and through my name his horn will be exalted.

89.zh: 我要使他的左手伸到海上，右手伸到河上。
89.en: I will set his hand over the sea, his right hand over the rivers.

89.zh: 他要称呼我说：你是我的父，是我的神，是拯救我的磐石。
89.en: He will call out to me, 'You are my Father, my God, the Rock my Savior.'

89.zh: 我也要立他为长子，为世上最高的君王。
89.en: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the most exalted of the kings of the earth.

89.zh: 我要为他存留我的慈爱，直到永远；我与他立的约必要坚定。
89.en: I will maintain my love to him forever, and my covenant with him will never fail.

89.zh: 我也要使他的后裔存到永远，使他的宝座如天之久。
89.en: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

89.zh: 倘若他的子孙离弃我的律法，不照我的典章行，
89.en: "If his sons forsake my law and do not follow my statutes,

89.zh: 背弃我的律例，不遵守我的诫命，
89.en: if they violate my decrees and fail to keep my commands,

89.zh: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯，用鞭责罚他们的罪孽。
89.en: I will punish their sin with the rod, their iniquity with flogging;

89.zh: 只是我必不将我的慈爱全然收回，也必不叫我的信实废弃。
89.en: but I will not take my love from him, nor will I ever betray my faithfulness.

89.zh: 我必不背弃我的约，也不改变我口中所出的。
89.en: I will not violate my covenant or alter what my lips have uttered.

89.zh: 我一次指著自己的圣洁起誓：我决不向大卫说谎！
89.en: Once for all, I have sworn by my holiness- and I will not lie to David-

89.zh: 他的后裔要存到永远；他的宝座在我面前如日之恒一般，
89.en: that his line will continue forever and his throne endure before me like the sun;

89.zh: 又如月亮永远坚立，如天上确实的见证。（细拉）
89.en: it will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah

89.zh: 但你恼怒你的受膏者，就丢掉弃绝他。
89.en: But you have rejected, you have spurned, you have been very angry with your anointed one.

89.zh: 你厌恶了与仆人所立的约，将他的冠冕践踏于地。
89.en: You have renounced the covenant with your servant and have defiled his crown in the dust.

89.zh: 你拆毁了他一切的篱笆，使他的保障变为荒场。
89.en: You have broken through all his walls and reduced his strongholds to ruins.

89.zh: 凡过路的人都抢夺他；他成为邻邦的羞辱。
89.en: All who pass by have plundered him; he has become the scorn of his neighbors.

89.zh: 你高举了他敌人的右手；你叫他一切的仇敌欢喜。
89.en: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; you have made all his enemies rejoice.

89.zh: 你叫他的刀剑卷刃，叫他在争战之中站立不住。
89.en: You have turned back the edge of his sword and have not supported him in battle.

89.zh: 你使他的光辉止息，将他的宝座推倒于地。
89.en: You have put an end to his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.

89.zh: 你减少他青年的日子，又使他蒙羞。（细拉）
89.en: You have cut short the days of his youth; you have covered him with a mantle of shame. Selah

89.zh: 耶和华啊，这要到几时呢？你要将自己隐藏到永远么？你的忿怒如火焚烧要到几时呢？
89.en: How long, O Lord ? Will you hide yourself forever? How long will your wrath burn like fire?

89.zh: 求你想念我的时候是何等的短少；你创造世人，要使他们归何等的虚空呢？
89.en: Remember how fleeting is my life. For what futility you have created all men!

89.zh: 谁能常活免死、救他的灵魂脱离阴间的权柄呢？（细拉）
89.en: What man can live and not see death, or save himself from the power of the grave ? Selah

89.zh: 主啊，你从前凭你的信实向大卫立誓要施行的慈爱在哪里呢？
89.en: O Lord, where is your former great love, which in your faithfulness you swore to David?

89.zh: 主啊，求你记念仆人们所受的羞辱，记念我怎样将一切强盛民的羞辱存在我怀里。
89.en: Remember, Lord, how your servant has been mocked, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the nations,

89.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人，羞辱了你受膏者的脚踪。
89.en: the taunts with which your enemies have mocked, O Lord , with which they have mocked every step of your anointed one.

89.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远。阿们！阿们！
89.en: Praise be to the Lord forever! Amen and Amen. BOOK IV Psalms 90-106

90.zh: （神人摩西的祈祷）主啊，你世世代代作我们的居所。
90.en: Lord, you have been our dwelling place throughout all generations.

90.zh: 诸山未曾生出，地与世界你未曾造成，从亘古到永远，你是神。
90.en: Before the mountains were born or you brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting you are God.

90.zh: 你使人归于尘土，说：你们世人要归回。
90.en: You turn men back to dust, saying, "Return to dust, O sons of men."

90.zh: 在你看来，千年如已过的昨日，又如夜间的一更。
90.en: For a thousand years in your sight are like a day that has just gone by, or like a watch in the night.

90.zh: 你叫他们如水冲去；他们如睡一觉。早晨，他们如生长的草，
90.en: You sweep men away in the sleep of death; they are like the new grass of the morning-

90.zh: 早晨发芽生长，晚上割下枯干。
90.en: though in the morning it springs up new, by evening it is dry and withered.

90.zh: 我们因你的怒气而消灭，因你的忿怒而惊惶。
90.en: We are consumed by your anger and terrified by your indignation.

90.zh: 你将我们的罪孽摆在你面前，将我们的隐恶摆在你面光之中。
90.en: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

90.zh: 我们经过的日子都在你震怒之下；我们度尽的年岁好像一声叹息。
90.en: All our days pass away under your wrath; we finish our years with a moan.

90.zh: 我们一生的年日是七十岁，若是强壮可到八十岁；但其中所矜夸的不过是劳苦愁烦，转眼成空，我们便如飞而去。
90.en: The length of our days is seventy years- or eighty, if we have the strength; yet their span is but trouble and sorrow, for they quickly pass, and we fly away.

90.zh: 谁晓得你怒气的权势？谁按著你该受的敬畏晓得你的忿怒呢？
90.en: Who knows the power of your anger? For your wrath is as great as the fear that is due you.

90.zh: 求你指教我们怎样数算自己的日子，好叫我们得著智慧的心。
90.en: Teach us to number our days aright, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

90.zh: 耶和华啊，我们要等到几时呢？求你转回，为你的仆人后悔。
90.en: Relent, O Lord ! How long will it be? Have compassion on your servants.

90.zh: 求你使我们早早饱得你的慈爱，好叫我们一生一世欢呼喜乐。
90.en: Satisfy us in the morning with your unfailing love, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.

90.zh: 求你照著你使我们受苦的日子，和我们遭难的年岁，叫我们喜乐。
90.en: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen trouble.

90.zh: 愿你的作为向你仆人显现；愿你的荣耀向他们子孙显明。
90.en: May your deeds be shown to your servants, your splendor to their children.

90.zh: 愿主─我们神的荣美归于我们身上。愿你坚立我们手所做的工；我们手所做的工，愿你坚立。
90.en: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish the work of our hands for us- yes, establish the work of our hands.

91.zh: 住在至高者隐密处的，必住在全能者的荫下。
91.en: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

91.zh: 我要论到耶和华说：他是我的避难所，是我的山寨，是我的神，是我所倚靠的。
91.en: I will say of the Lord , "He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust."

91.zh: 他必救你脱离捕鸟人的网罗和毒害的瘟疫。
91.en: Surely he will save you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.

91.zh: 他必用自己的翎毛遮蔽你；你要投靠在他的翅膀底下；他的诚实是大小的盾牌。
91.en: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

91.zh: 你必不怕黑夜的惊骇，或是白日飞的箭，
91.en: You will not fear the terror of night, nor the arrow that flies by day,

91.zh: 也不怕黑夜行的瘟疫，或是午间灭人的毒病。
91.en: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the plague that destroys at midday.

91.zh: 虽有千人仆倒在你旁边，万人仆倒在你右边，这灾却不得临近你。
91.en: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.

91.zh: 你惟亲眼观看，见恶人遭报。
91.en: You will only observe with your eyes and see the punishment of the wicked.

91.zh: 耶和华是我的避难所；你已将至高者当你的居所，
91.en: If you make the Most High your dwelling- even the Lord , who is my refuge-

91.zh: 祸患必不临到你，灾害也不挨近你的帐棚。
91.en: then no harm will befall you, no disaster will come near your tent.

91.zh: 因他要为你吩咐他的使者，在你行的一切道路上保护你。
91.en: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways;

91.zh: 他们要用手托著你，免得你的脚碰在石头上。
91.en: they will lift you up in their hands, so that you will not strike your foot against a stone.

91.zh: 你要踹在狮子和虺蛇的身上，践踏少壮狮子和大蛇。
91.en: You will tread upon the lion and the cobra; you will trample the great lion and the serpent.

91.zh: 神说：因为他专心爱我，我就要搭救他；因为他知道我的名，我要把他安置在高处。
91.en: "Because he loves me," says the Lord , "I will rescue him; I will protect him, for he acknowledges my name.

91.zh: 他若求告我，我就应允他；他在急难中，我要与他同在；我要搭救他，使他尊贵。
91.en: He will call upon me, and I will answer him; I will be with him in trouble, I will deliver him and honor him.

91.zh: 我要使他足享长寿，将我的救恩显明给他。
91.en: With long life will I satisfy him and show him my salvation."

92.zh: （安息日的诗歌。）称谢耶和华！歌颂你至高者的名！
92.en: It is good to praise the Lord and make music to your name, O Most High,

92.zh: 用十弦的乐器和瑟，用琴弹幽雅的声音，早晨传扬你的慈爱；每夜传扬你的信实。这本为美事。
92.en: to proclaim your love in the morning and your faithfulness at night,
to the music of the ten-stringed lyre and the melody of the harp.

92.zh: 因你─耶和华藉著你的作为叫我高兴，我要因你手的工作欢呼。
92.en: For you make me glad by your deeds, O Lord ; I sing for joy at the works of your hands.

92.zh: 耶和华啊，你的工作何其大！你的心思极其深！
92.en: How great are your works, O Lord , how profound your thoughts!

92.zh: 畜类人不晓得；愚顽人也不明白。
92.en: The senseless man does not know, fools do not understand,

92.zh: 恶人茂盛如草，一切作孽之人发旺的时候，正是他们要灭亡，直到永远。
92.en: that though the wicked spring up like grass and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.

92.zh: 惟你─耶和华是至高，直到永远。
92.en: But you, O Lord , are exalted forever.

92.zh: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌都要灭亡；一切作孽的也要离散。
92.en: For surely your enemies, O Lord , surely your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.

92.zh: 你却高举了我的角，如野牛的角；我是被新油膏了的。
92.en: You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; fine oils have been poured upon me.

92.zh: 我眼睛看见仇敌遭报；我耳朵听见那些起来攻击我的恶人受罚。
92.en: My eyes have seen the defeat of my adversaries; my ears have heard the rout of my wicked foes.

92.zh: 义人要发旺如棕树，生长如利巴嫩的香柏树。
92.en: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, they will grow like a cedar of Lebanon;

92.zh: 他们栽于耶和华的殿中，发旺在我们神的院里。
92.en: planted in the house of the Lord , they will flourish in the courts of our God.

92.zh: 他们年老的时候仍要结果子，要满了汁浆而常发青，
92.en: They will still bear fruit in old age, they will stay fresh and green,

92.zh: 好显明耶和华是正直的。他是我的磐石，在他毫无不义。
92.en: proclaiming, "The Lord is upright; he is my Rock, and there is no wickedness in him."

93.zh: 耶和华作王！他以威严为衣穿上；耶和华以能力为衣，以能力束腰，世界就坚定，不得动摇。
93.en: The Lord reigns, he is robed in majesty; the Lord is robed in majesty and is armed with strength. The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved.

93.zh: 你的宝座从太初立定；你从亘古就有。
93.en: Your throne was established long ago; you are from all eternity.

93.zh: 耶和华啊，大水扬起，大水发声，波浪澎湃。
93.en: The seas have lifted up, O Lord , the seas have lifted up their voice; the seas have lifted up their pounding waves.

93.zh: 耶和华在高处大有能力，胜过诸水的响声，洋海的大浪。
93.en: Mightier than the thunder of the great waters, mightier than the breakers of the sea- the Lord on high is mighty.

93.zh: 耶和华啊，你的法度最的确；你的殿永称为圣，是合宜的。
93.en: Your statutes stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days, O Lord .

94.zh: 耶和华啊，你是伸冤的神；伸冤的神啊，求你发出光来！
94.en: O Lord , the God who avenges, O God who avenges, shine forth.

94.zh: 审判世界的主啊，求你挺身而立，使骄傲人受应得的报应！
94.en: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; pay back to the proud what they deserve.

94.zh: 耶和华啊，恶人夸胜要到几时呢？要到几时呢？
94.en: How long will the wicked, O Lord , how long will the wicked be jubilant?

94.zh: 他们絮絮叨叨说傲慢的话；一切作孽的人都自己夸张。
94.en: They pour out arrogant words; all the evildoers are full of boasting.

94.zh: 耶和华啊，他们强压你的百姓，苦害你的产业。
94.en: They crush your people, O Lord ; they oppress your inheritance.

94.zh: 他们杀死寡妇和寄居的，又杀害孤儿。
94.en: They slay the widow and the alien; they murder the fatherless.

94.zh: 他们说：耶和华必不看见；雅各的神必不思念。
94.en: They say, "The Lord does not see; the God of Jacob pays no heed."

94.zh: 你们民间的畜类人当思想；你们愚顽人到几时才有智慧呢？
94.en: Take heed, you senseless ones among the people; you fools, when will you become wise?

94.zh: 造耳朵的，难道自己不听见么？造眼睛的，难道自己不看见么？
94.en: Does he who implanted the ear not hear? Does he who formed the eye not see?

94.zh: 管教列邦的，就是叫人得知识的，难道自己不惩治人么？
94.en: Does he who disciplines nations not punish? Does he who teaches man lack knowledge?

94.zh: 耶和华知道人的意念是虚妄的。
94.en: The Lord knows the thoughts of man; he knows that they are futile.

94.zh: 耶和华啊，你所管教、用律法所教训的人是有福的！
94.en: Blessed is the man you discipline, O Lord , the man you teach from your law;

94.zh: 你使他在遭难的日子得享平安；惟有恶人陷在所挖的坑中。
94.en: you grant him relief from days of trouble, till a pit is dug for the wicked.

94.zh: 因为耶和华必不丢弃他的百姓，也不离弃他的产业。
94.en: For the Lord will not reject his people; he will never forsake his inheritance.

94.zh: 审判要转向公义；心里正直的，必都随从。
94.en: Judgment will again be founded on righteousness, and all the upright in heart will follow it.

94.zh: 谁肯为我起来攻击作恶的？谁肯为我站起抵挡作孽的？
94.en: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will take a stand for me against evildoers?

94.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我，我就住在寂静之中了。
94.en: Unless the Lord had given me help, I would soon have dwelt in the silence of death.

94.zh: 我正说我失了脚，耶和华啊，那时你的慈爱扶助我。
94.en: When I said, "My foot is slipping," your love, O Lord , supported me.

94.zh: 我心里多忧多疑，你安慰我，就使我欢乐。
94.en: When anxiety was great within me, your consolation brought joy to my soul.

94.zh: 那藉著律例架弄残害、在位上行奸恶的，岂能与你相交么？
94.en: Can a corrupt throne be allied with you- one that brings on misery by its decrees?

94.zh: 他们大家聚集攻击义人，将无辜的人定为死罪。
94.en: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.

94.zh: 但耶和华向来作了我的高台；我的神作了我投靠的磐石。
94.en: But the Lord has become my fortress, and my God the rock in whom I take refuge.

94.zh: 他叫他们的罪孽归到他们身上。他们正在行恶之中，他要剪除他们；耶和华─我们的神要把他们剪除。
94.en: He will repay them for their sins and destroy them for their wickedness; the Lord our God will destroy them.

95.zh: 来啊，我们要向耶和华歌唱，向拯救我们的磐石欢呼！
95.en: Come, let us sing for joy to the Lord ; let us shout aloud to the Rock of our salvation.

95.zh: 我们要来感谢他，用诗歌向他欢呼！
95.en: Let us come before him with thanksgiving and extol him with music and song.

95.zh: 因耶和华为大神，为大王，超乎万神之上。
95.en: For the Lord is the great God, the great King above all gods.

95.zh: 地的深处在他手中；山的高峰也属他。
95.en: In his hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to him.

95.zh: 海洋属他，是他造的；旱地也是他手造成的。
95.en: The sea is his, for he made it, and his hands formed the dry land.

95.zh: 来啊，我们要屈身敬拜，在造我们的耶和华面前跪下。
95.en: Come, let us bow down in worship, let us kneel before the Lord our Maker;

95.zh: 因为他是我们的神；我们是他草场的羊，是他手下的民。惟愿你们今天听他的话：
95.en: for he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if you hear his voice,

95.zh: 你们不可硬著心，像当日在米利巴，就是在旷野的玛撒。
95.en: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, as you did that day at Massah in the desert,

95.zh: 那时，你们的祖宗试我探我，并且观看我的作为。
95.en: where your fathers tested and tried me, though they had seen what I did.

95.zh: 四十年之久，我厌烦那世代，说：这是心里迷糊的百姓，竟不晓得我的作为！
95.en: For forty years I was angry with that generation; I said, "They are a people whose hearts go astray, and they have not known my ways."

95.zh: 所以，我在怒中起誓，说：他们断不可进入我的安息！
95.en: So I declared on oath in my anger, "They shall never enter my rest."

96.zh: 你们要向耶和华唱新歌！全地都要向耶和华歌唱！
96.en: Sing to the Lord a new song; sing to the Lord , all the earth.

96.zh: 要向耶和华歌唱，称颂他的名！天天传扬他的救恩！
96.en: Sing to the Lord , praise his name; proclaim his salvation day after day.

96.zh: 在列邦中述说他的荣耀！在万民中述说他的奇事！
96.en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous deeds among all peoples.

96.zh: 因耶和华为大，当受极大的赞美；他在万神之上，当受敬畏。
96.en: For great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; he is to be feared above all gods.

96.zh: 外邦的神都属虚无；惟独耶和华创造诸天。
96.en: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.

96.zh: 有尊荣和威严在他面前；有能力与华美在他圣所。
96.en: Splendor and majesty are before him; strength and glory are in his sanctuary.

96.zh: 民中的万族啊，你们要将荣耀、能力归给耶和华，都归给耶和华！
96.en: Ascribe to the Lord , O families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

96.zh: 要将耶和华的名所当得的荣耀归给他，拿供物来进入他的院宇。
96.en: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his name; bring an offering and come into his courts.

96.zh: 当以圣洁的（的：或译为）妆饰敬拜耶和华；全地要在他面前战抖！
96.en: Worship the Lord in the splendor of his holiness; tremble before him, all the earth.

96.zh: 人在列邦中要说：耶和华作王！世界就坚定，不得动摇；他要按公正审判众民。
96.en: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns." The world is firmly established, it cannot be moved; he will judge the peoples with equity.

96.zh: 愿天欢喜，愿地快乐！愿海和其中所充满的澎湃！
96.en: Let the heavens rejoice, let the earth be glad; let the sea resound, and all that is in it;

96.zh: 愿田和其中所有的都欢乐！那时，林中的树木都要在耶和华面前欢呼。
96.en: let the fields be jubilant, and everything in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy;

96.zh: 因为他来了，他来要审判全地。他要按公义审判世界，按他的信实审判万民。
96.en: they will sing before the Lord , for he comes, he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in his truth.

97.zh: 耶和华作王！愿地快乐！愿众海岛欢喜！
97.en: The Lord reigns, let the earth be glad; let the distant shores rejoice.

97.zh: 密云和幽暗在他的四围；公义和公平是他宝座的根基。
97.en: Clouds and thick darkness surround him; righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

97.zh: 有烈火在他前头行，烧灭他四围的敌人。
97.en: Fire goes before him and consumes his foes on every side.

97.zh: 他的闪电光照世界，大地看见便震动。
97.en: His lightning lights up the world; the earth sees and trembles.

97.zh: 诸山见耶和华的面，就是全地之主的面，便消化如蜡。
97.en: The mountains melt like wax before the Lord , before the Lord of all the earth.

97.zh: 诸天表明他的公义；万民看见他的荣耀。
97.en: The heavens proclaim his righteousness, and all the peoples see his glory.

97.zh: 愿一切事奉雕刻的偶像、靠虚无之神自夸的，都蒙羞愧。万神哪，你们都当拜他。
97.en: All who worship images are put to shame, those who boast in idols- worship him, all you gods!

97.zh: 耶和华啊，锡安听见你的判断就欢喜；犹大的城邑（原文是女子）也都快乐。
97.en: Zion hears and rejoices and the villages of Judah are glad because of your judgments, O Lord .

97.zh: 因为你─耶和华至高，超乎全地；你被尊崇，远超万神之上。
97.en: For you, O Lord , are the Most High over all the earth; you are exalted far above all gods.

97.zh: 你们爱耶和华的，都当恨恶罪恶；他保护圣民的性命，搭救他们脱离恶人的手。
97.en: Let those who love the Lord hate evil, for he guards the lives of his faithful ones and delivers them from the hand of the wicked.

97.zh: 散布亮光是为义人；预备喜乐是为正直人。
97.en: Light is shed upon the righteous and joy on the upright in heart.

97.zh: 你们义人当靠耶和华欢喜，称谢他可记念的圣名。
97.en: Rejoice in the Lord , you who are righteous, and praise his holy name.

98.zh: （一篇诗。）你们要向耶和华唱新歌！因为他行过奇妙的事；他的右手和圣臂施行救恩。
98.en: Sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things; his right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

98.zh: 耶和华发明了他的救恩，在列邦人眼前显出公义；
98.en: The Lord has made his salvation known and revealed his righteousness to the nations.

98.zh: 记念他向以色列家所发的慈爱，所凭的信实。地的四极都看见我们神的救恩。
98.en: He has remembered his love and his faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

98.zh: 全地都要向耶和华欢乐；要发起大声，欢呼歌颂！
98.en: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth, burst into jubilant song with music;

98.zh: 要用琴歌颂耶和华，用琴和诗歌的声音歌颂他！
98.en: make music to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the sound of singing,

98.zh: 用号和角声，在大君王耶和华面前欢呼！
98.en: with trumpets and the blast of the ram's horn- shout for joy before the Lord , the King.

98.zh: 愿海和其中所充满的澎湃；世界和住在其间的也要发声。
98.en: Let the sea resound, and everything in it, the world, and all who live in it.

98.zh: 愿大水拍手；愿诸山在耶和华面前一同欢呼；
98.en: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy;

98.zh: 因为他来要审判遍地。他要按公义审判世界，按公正审判万民。
98.en: let them sing before the Lord , for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples with equity.

99.zh: 耶和华作王；万民当战抖！他坐在二基路伯上，地当动摇。
99.en: The Lord reigns, let the nations tremble; he sits enthroned between the cherubim, let the earth shake.

99.zh: 耶和华在锡安为大；他超乎万民之上。
99.en: Great is the Lord in Zion; he is exalted over all the nations.

99.zh: 他们当称赞他大而可畏的名；他本为圣！
99.en: Let them praise your great and awesome name- he is holy.

99.zh: 王有能力，喜爱公平，坚立公正，在雅各中施行公平和公义。
99.en: The King is mighty, he loves justice- you have established equity; in Jacob you have done what is just and right.

99.zh: 你们当尊崇耶和华─我们的神，在他脚凳前下拜。他本为圣！
99.en: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his footstool; he is holy.

99.zh: 在他的祭司中有摩西和亚伦；在求告他名的人中有撒母耳。他们求告耶和华，他就应允他们。
99.en: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who called on his name; they called on the Lord and he answered them.

99.zh: 他在云柱中对他们说话；他们遵守他的法度和他所赐给他们的律例。
99.en: He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud; they kept his statutes and the decrees he gave them.

99.zh: 耶和华─我们的神啊，你应允他们；你是赦免他们的　神，却按他们所行的报应他们。
99.en: O Lord our God, you answered them; you were to Israel a forgiving God, though you punished their misdeeds.

99.zh: 你们要尊崇耶和华─我们的神，在他的圣山下拜，因为耶和华─我们的　神本为圣！
99.en: Exalt the Lord our God and worship at his holy mountain, for the Lord our God is holy.

100.zh: （称谢诗。）普天下当向耶和华欢呼！
100.en: Shout for joy to the Lord , all the earth.

100.zh: 你们当乐意事奉耶和华，当来向他歌唱！
100.en: Worship the Lord with gladness; come before him with joyful songs.

100.zh: 你们当晓得耶和华是神！我们是他造的，也是属他的；我们是他的民，也是他草场的羊。
100.en: Know that the Lord is God. It is he who made us, and we are his ; we are his people, the sheep of his pasture.

100.zh: 当称谢进入他的门；当赞美进入他的院。当感谢他，称颂他的名！
100.en: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

100.zh: 因为耶和华本为善。他的慈爱存到永远；他的信实直到万代。
100.en: For the Lord is good and his love endures forever; his faithfulness continues through all generations.

101.zh: （大卫的诗）我要歌唱慈爱和公平；耶和华啊，我要向你歌颂！
101.en: I will sing of your love and justice; to you, O Lord , I will sing praise.

101.zh: 我要用智慧行完全的道。你几时到我这里来呢？我要存完全的心行在我家中。
101.en: I will be careful to lead a blameless life- when will you come to me? I will walk in my house with blameless heart.

101.zh: 邪僻的事，我都不摆在我眼前；悖逆人所做的事，我甚恨恶，不容沾在我身上。
101.en: I will set before my eyes no vile thing. The deeds of faithless men I hate; they will not cling to me.

101.zh: 弯曲的心思，我必远离；一切的恶人（或译：恶事），我不认识。
101.en: Men of perverse heart shall be far from me; I will have nothing to do with evil.

101.zh: 在暗中谗谤他邻居的，我必将他灭绝；眼目高傲、心里骄纵的，我必不容他。
101.en: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, him will I put to silence; whoever has haughty eyes and a proud heart, him will I not endure.

101.zh: 我眼要看国中的诚实人，叫他们与我同住；行为完全的，他要伺候我。
101.en: My eyes will be on the faithful in the land, that they may dwell with me; he whose walk is blameless will minister to me.

101.zh: 行诡诈的，必不得住在我家里；说谎话的，必不得立在我眼前。
101.en: No one who practices deceit will dwell in my house; no one who speaks falsely will stand in my presence.

101.zh: 我每日早晨要灭绝国中所有的恶人，好把一切作孽的从耶和华的城里剪除。
101.en: Every morning I will put to silence all the wicked in the land; I will cut off every evildoer from the city of the Lord .

102.zh: （困苦人发昏的时候，在耶和华面前吐露苦情的祷告。）耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，容我的呼求达到你面前！
102.en: Hear my prayer, O Lord ; let my cry for help come to you.

102.zh: 我在急难的日子，求你向我侧耳；不要向我掩面！我呼求的日子，求你快快应允我！
102.en: Do not hide your face from me when I am in distress. Turn your ear to me; when I call, answer me quickly.

102.zh: 因为，我的年日如烟云消灭；我的骨头如火把烧著。
102.en: For my days vanish like smoke; my bones burn like glowing embers.

102.zh: 我的心被伤，如草枯干，甚至我忘记吃饭。
102.en: My heart is blighted and withered like grass; I forget to eat my food.

102.zh: 因我唉哼的声音，我的肉紧贴骨头。
102.en: Because of my loud groaning I am reduced to skin and bones.

102.zh: 我如同旷野的鹈鹕；我好像荒场的鸮鸟。
102.en: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.

102.zh: 我警醒不睡；我像房顶上孤单的麻雀。
102.en: I lie awake; I have become like a bird alone on a roof.

102.zh: 我的仇敌终日辱骂我；向我猖狂的人指著我赌咒。
102.en: All day long my enemies taunt me; those who rail against me use my name as a curse.

102.zh: 我吃过炉灰，如同吃饭；我所喝的与眼泪搀杂。
102.en: For I eat ashes as my food and mingle my drink with tears

102.zh: 这都因你的恼恨和忿怒；你把我拾起来，又把我摔下去。
102.en: because of your great wrath, for you have taken me up and thrown me aside.

102.zh: 我的年日如日影偏斜；我也如草枯干。
102.en: My days are like the evening shadow; I wither away like grass.

102.zh: 惟你─耶和华必存到永远；你可记念的名也存到万代。
102.en: But you, O Lord , sit enthroned forever; your renown endures through all generations.

102.zh: 你必起来怜恤锡安，因现在是可怜他的时候，日期已经到了。
102.en: You will arise and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show favor to her; the appointed time has come.

102.zh: 你的仆人原来喜悦他的石头，可怜他的尘土。
102.en: For her stones are dear to your servants; her very dust moves them to pity.

102.zh: 列国要敬畏耶和华的名；世上诸王都敬畏你的荣耀。
102.en: The nations will fear the name of the Lord , all the kings of the earth will revere your glory.

102.zh: 因为耶和华建造了锡安，在他荣耀里显现。
102.en: For the Lord will rebuild Zion and appear in his glory.

102.zh: 他垂听穷人的祷告，并不藐视他们的祈求。
102.en: He will respond to the prayer of the destitute; he will not despise their plea.

102.zh: 这必为后代的人记下，将来受造的民要赞美耶和华。
102.en: Let this be written for a future generation, that a people not yet created may praise the Lord :

102.zh: 因为，他从至高的圣所垂看；耶和华从天向地观察，
102.en: "The Lord looked down from his sanctuary on high, from heaven he viewed the earth,

102.zh: 要垂听被囚之人的叹息，要释放将要死的人，
102.en: to hear the groans of the prisoners and release those condemned to death."

102.zh: 使人在锡安传扬耶和华的名，在耶路撒冷传扬赞美他的话，
102.en: So the name of the Lord will be declared in Zion and his praise in Jerusalem

102.zh: 就是在万民和列国聚会事奉耶和华的时候。
102.en: when the peoples and the kingdoms assemble to worship the Lord .

102.zh: 他使我的力量中道衰弱，使我的年日短少。
102.en: In the course of my life he broke my strength; he cut short my days.

102.zh: 我说：我的神啊，不要使我中年去世。你的年数世世无穷！
102.en: So I said: "Do not take me away, O my God, in the midst of my days; your years go on through all generations.

102.zh: 你起初立了地的根基；天也是你手所造的。
102.en: In the beginning you laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of your hands.

102.zh: 天地都要灭没，你却要长存；天地都要如外衣渐渐旧了。你要将天地如里衣更换，天地就改变了。
102.en: They will perish, but you remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing you will change them and they will be discarded.

102.zh: 惟有你永不改变；你的年数没有穷尽。
102.en: But you remain the same, and your years will never end.

102.zh: 你仆人的子孙要长存；他们的后裔要坚立在你面前。
102.en: The children of your servants will live in your presence; their descendants will be established before you."

103.zh: （大卫的诗。）我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！凡在我里面的，也要称颂他的圣名！
103.en: Praise the Lord , O my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

103.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！不可忘记他的一切恩惠！
103.en: Praise the Lord , O my soul, and forget not all his benefits-

103.zh: 他赦免你的一切罪孽，医治你的一切疾病。
103.en: who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases,

103.zh: 他救赎你的命脱离死亡，以仁爱和慈悲为你的冠冕。
103.en: who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion,

103.zh: 他用美物使你所愿的得以知足，以致你如鹰返老还童。
103.en: who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

103.zh: 耶和华施行公义，为一切受屈的人伸冤。
103.en: The Lord works righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.

103.zh: 他使摩西知道他的法则，叫以色列人晓得他的作为。
103.en: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the people of Israel:

103.zh: 耶和华有怜悯，有恩典，不轻易发怒，且有丰盛的慈爱。
103.en: The Lord is compassionate and gracious, slow to anger, abounding in love.

103.zh: 他不长久责备，也不永远怀怒。
103.en: He will not always accuse, nor will he harbor his anger forever;

103.zh: 他没有按我们的罪过待我们，也没有照我们的罪孽报应我们。
103.en: he does not treat us as our sins deserve or repay us according to our iniquities.

103.zh: 天离地何等的高，他的慈爱向敬畏他的人也是何等的大！
103.en: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is his love for those who fear him;

103.zh: 东离西有多远，他叫我们的过犯离我们也有多远！
103.en: as far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

103.zh: 父亲怎样怜恤他的儿女，耶和华也怎样怜恤敬畏他的人！
103.en: As a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him;

103.zh: 因为他知道我们的本体，思念我们不过是尘土。
103.en: for he knows how we are formed, he remembers that we are dust.

103.zh: 至于世人，他的年日如草一样。他发旺如野地的花，
103.en: As for man, his days are like grass, he flourishes like a flower of the field;

103.zh: 经风一吹，便归无有；他的原处也不再认识他。
103.en: the wind blows over it and it is gone, and its place remembers it no more.

103.zh: 但耶和华的慈爱归于敬畏他的人，从亘古到永远；他的公义也归于子子孙孙
103.en: But from everlasting to everlasting the Lord 's love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children's children-

103.zh: 就是那些遵守他的约、记念他的训词而遵行的人。
103.en: with those who keep his covenant and remember to obey his precepts.

103.zh: 耶和华在天上立定宝座；他的权柄（原文是国）统管万有。
103.en: The Lord has established his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over all.

103.zh: 听从他命令、成全他旨意、有大能的天使，都要称颂耶和华！
103.en: Praise the Lord , you his angels, you mighty ones who do his bidding, who obey his word.

103.zh: 你们作他的诸军，作他的仆役，行他所喜悦的，都要称颂耶和华！
103.en: Praise the Lord , all his heavenly hosts, you his servants who do his will.

103.zh: 你们一切被他造的，在他所治理的各处，都要称颂耶和华！我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！
103.en: Praise the Lord , all his works everywhere in his dominion. Praise the Lord , O my soul.

104.zh: 我的心哪，你要称颂耶和华！耶和华─我的神啊，你为至大！你以尊荣威严为衣服，
104.en: Praise the Lord , O my soul. O Lord my God, you are very great; you are clothed with splendor and majesty.

104.zh: 披上亮光，如披外袍，铺张穹苍，如铺幔子，
104.en: He wraps himself in light as with a garment; he stretches out the heavens like a tent

104.zh: 在水中立楼阁的栋梁，用云彩为车辇，藉著风的翅膀而行，
104.en: and lays the beams of his upper chambers on their waters. He makes the clouds his chariot and rides on the wings of the wind.

104.zh: 以风为使者，以火焰为仆役，
104.en: He makes winds his messengers, flames of fire his servants.

104.zh: 将地立在根基上，使地永不动摇。
104.en: He set the earth on its foundations; it can never be moved.

104.zh: 你用深水遮盖地面，犹如衣裳；诸水高过山岭。
104.en: You covered it with the deep as with a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.

104.zh: 你的斥责一发，水便奔逃；你的雷声一发，水便奔流。
104.en: But at your rebuke the waters fled, at the sound of your thunder they took to flight;

104.zh: 诸山升上，诸谷沉下（或译：随山上翻，随谷下流），归你为他所安定之地。
104.en: they flowed over the mountains, they went down into the valleys, to the place you assigned for them.

104.zh: 你定了界限，使水不能过去，不再转回遮盖地面。
104.en: You set a boundary they cannot cross; never again will they cover the earth.

104.zh: 耶和华使泉源涌在山谷，流在山间，
104.en: He makes springs pour water into the ravines; it flows between the mountains.

104.zh: 使野地的走兽有水喝，野驴得解其渴。
104.en: They give water to all the beasts of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.

104.zh: 天上的飞鸟在水旁住宿，在树枝上啼叫。
104.en: The birds of the air nest by the waters; they sing among the branches.

104.zh: 他从楼阁中浇灌山岭；因他作为的功效，地就丰足。
104.en: He waters the mountains from his upper chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of his work.

104.zh: 他使草生长，给六畜吃，使菜蔬发长，供给人用，使人从地里能得食物，
104.en: He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for man to cultivate- bringing forth food from the earth:

104.zh: 又得酒能悦人心，得油能润人面，得粮能养人心。
104.en: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil to make his face shine, and bread that sustains his heart.

104.zh: 佳美的树木，就是利巴嫩的香柏树，是耶和华所栽种的，都满了汁浆。
104.en: The trees of the Lord are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.

104.zh: 雀鸟在其上搭窝；至于鹤，松树是他的房屋。
104.en: There the birds make their nests; the stork has its home in the pine trees.

104.zh: 高山为野山羊的住所；岩石为沙番的藏处。
104.en: The high mountains belong to the wild goats; the crags are a refuge for the coneys.

104.zh: 你安置月亮为定节令；日头自知沉落。
104.en: The moon marks off the seasons, and the sun knows when to go down.

104.zh: 你造黑暗为夜，林中的百兽就都爬出来。
104.en: You bring darkness, it becomes night, and all the beasts of the forest prowl.

104.zh: 少壮狮子吼叫，要抓食，向神寻求食物。
104.en: The lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.

104.zh: 日头一出，兽便躲避，卧在洞里。
104.en: The sun rises, and they steal away; they return and lie down in their dens.

104.zh: 人出去做工，劳碌直到晚上。
104.en: Then man goes out to his work, to his labor until evening.

104.zh: 耶和华啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。
104.en: How many are your works, O Lord ! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.

104.zh: 那里有海，又大又广；其中有无数的动物，大小活物都有。
104.en: There is the sea, vast and spacious, teeming with creatures beyond number- living things both large and small.

104.zh: 那里有船行走，有你所造的鳄鱼游泳在其中。
104.en: There the ships go to and fro, and the leviathan, which you formed to frolic there.

104.zh: 这都仰望你按时给他食物。
104.en: These all look to you to give them their food at the proper time.

104.zh: 你给他们，他们便拾起来；你张手，他们饱得美食。
104.en: When you give it to them, they gather it up; when you open your hand, they are satisfied with good things.

104.zh: 你掩面，他们便惊惶；你收回他们的气，他们就死亡，归于尘土。
104.en: When you hide your face, they are terrified; when you take away their breath, they die and return to the dust.

104.zh: 你发出你的灵，他们便受造；你使地面更换为新。
104.en: When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you renew the face of the earth.

104.zh: 愿耶和华的荣耀存到永远！愿耶和华喜悦自己所造的！
104.en: May the glory of the Lord endure forever; may the Lord rejoice in his works-

104.zh: 他看地，地便震动；他摸山，山就冒烟。
104.en: he who looks at the earth, and it trembles, who touches the mountains, and they smoke.

104.zh: 我要一生向耶和华唱诗！我还活的时候，要向我神歌颂！
104.en: I will sing to the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

104.zh: 愿他以我的默念为甘甜！我要因耶和华欢喜！
104.en: May my meditation be pleasing to him, as I rejoice in the Lord .

104.zh: 愿罪人从世上消灭！愿恶人归于无有！我的心哪，要称颂耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华（原文是哈利路亚；下同）！
104.en: But may sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Praise the Lord , O my soul. Praise the Lord .

105.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，求告他的名，在万民中传扬他的作为！
105.en: Give thanks to the Lord , call on his name; make known among the nations what he has done.

105.zh: 要向他唱诗歌颂，谈论他一切奇妙的作为！
105.en: Sing to him, sing praise to him; tell of all his wonderful acts.

105.zh: 要以他的圣名夸耀！寻求耶和华的人，心中应当欢喜！
105.en: Glory in his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

105.zh: 要寻求耶和华与他的能力，时常寻求他的面。
105.en: Look to the Lord and his strength; seek his face always.

105.zh: 他仆人亚伯拉罕的后裔，他所拣选雅各的子孙哪，你们要记念他奇妙的作为和他的奇事，并他口中的判语。
105.en: Remember the wonders he has done, his miracles, and the judgments he pronounced,

105.zh: a
105.en: O descendants of Abraham his servant, O sons of Jacob, his chosen ones.

105.zh: 他是耶和华─我们的神；全地都有他的判断。
105.en: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.

105.zh: 他记念他的约，直到永远；他所吩咐的话，直到千代─
105.en: He remembers his covenant forever, the word he commanded, for a thousand generations,

105.zh: 就是与亚伯拉罕所立的约，向以撒所起的誓。
105.en: the covenant he made with Abraham, the oath he swore to Isaac.

105.zh: 他又将这约向雅各定为律例，向以色列定为永远的约，
105.en: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

105.zh: 说：我必将迦南地赐给你，作你产业的分。
105.en: "To you I will give the land of Canaan as the portion you will inherit."

105.zh: 当时，他们人丁有限，数目稀少，并且在那地为寄居的。
105.en: When they were but few in number, few indeed, and strangers in it,

105.zh: 他们从这邦游到那邦，从这国行到那国。
105.en: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

105.zh: 他不容甚么人欺负他们，为他们的缘故责备君王，
105.en: He allowed no one to oppress them; for their sake he rebuked kings:

105.zh: 说：不可难为我受膏的人，也不可恶待我的先知。
105.en: "Do not touch my anointed ones; do my prophets no harm."

105.zh: 他命饥荒降在那地上，将所倚靠的粮食全行断绝，
105.en: He called down famine on the land and destroyed all their supplies of food;

105.zh: 在他们以先打发一个人去─约瑟被卖为奴仆。
105.en: and he sent a man before them- Joseph, sold as a slave.

105.zh: 人用脚镣伤他的脚；他被铁炼捆拘。
105.en: They bruised his feet with shackles, his neck was put in irons,

105.zh: 耶和华的话试炼他，直等到他所说的应验了。
105.en: till what he foretold came to pass, till the word of the Lord proved him true.

105.zh: 王打发人把他解开，就是治理众民的，把他释放，
105.en: The king sent and released him, the ruler of peoples set him free.

105.zh: 立他作王家之主，掌管他一切所有的，
105.en: He made him master of his household, ruler over all he possessed,

105.zh: 使他随意捆绑他的臣宰，将智慧教导他的长老。
105.en: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.

105.zh: 以色列也到了埃及；雅各在含地寄居。
105.en: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob lived as an alien in the land of Ham.

105.zh: 耶和华使他的百姓生养众多，使他们比敌人强盛，
105.en: The Lord made his people very fruitful; he made them too numerous for their foes,

105.zh: 使敌人的心转去恨他的百姓，并用诡计待他的仆人。
105.en: whose hearts he turned to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

105.zh: 他打发他的仆人摩西和他所拣选的亚伦，
105.en: He sent Moses his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

105.zh: 在敌人中间显他的神迹，在含地显他的奇事。
105.en: They performed his miraculous signs among them, his wonders in the land of Ham.

105.zh: 他命黑暗，就有黑暗；没有违背他话的。
105.en: He sent darkness and made the land dark- for had they not rebelled against his words?

105.zh: 他叫埃及的水变为血，叫他们的鱼死了。
105.en: He turned their waters into blood, causing their fish to die.

105.zh: 在他们的地上以及王宫的内室，青蛙多多滋生。
105.en: Their land teemed with frogs, which went up into the bedrooms of their rulers.

105.zh: 他说一声，苍蝇就成群而来，并有虱子进入他们四境。
105.en: He spoke, and there came swarms of flies, and gnats throughout their country.

105.zh: 他给他们降下冰雹为雨，在他们的地上降下火焰。
105.en: He turned their rain into hail, with lightning throughout their land;

105.zh: 他也击打他们的葡萄树和无花果树，毁坏他们境内的树木。
105.en: he struck down their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.

105.zh: 他说一声，就有蝗虫蚂蚱上来，不计其数，
105.en: He spoke, and the locusts came, grasshoppers without number;

105.zh: 吃尽了他们地上各样的菜蔬和田地的出产。
105.en: they ate up every green thing in their land, ate up the produce of their soil.

105.zh: 他又击杀他们国内一切的长子，就是他们强壮时头生的。
105.en: Then he struck down all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their manhood.

105.zh: 他领自己的百姓带银子金子出来；他支派中没有一个软弱的。
105.en: He brought out Israel, laden with silver and gold, and from among their tribes no one faltered.

105.zh: 他们出来的时候，埃及人便欢喜；原来埃及人惧怕他们。
105.en: Egypt was glad when they left, because dread of Israel had fallen on them.

105.zh: 他铺张云彩当遮盖，夜间使火光照。
105.en: He spread out a cloud as a covering, and a fire to give light at night.

105.zh: 他们一求，他就使鹌鹑飞来，并用天上的粮食叫他们饱足。
105.en: They asked, and he brought them quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

105.zh: 他打开磐石，水就涌出；在干旱之处，水流成河。
105.en: He opened the rock, and water gushed out; like a river it flowed in the desert.

105.zh: 这都因他记念他的圣言和他的仆人亚伯拉罕。
105.en: For he remembered his holy promise given to his servant Abraham.

105.zh: 他带领百姓欢乐而出，带领选民欢呼前往。
105.en: He brought out his people with rejoicing, his chosen ones with shouts of joy;

105.zh: 他将列国的地赐给他们，他们便承巡蛦民劳碌得来的，
105.en: he gave them the lands of the nations, and they fell heir to what others had toiled for-

105.zh: 好使他们遵他的律例，守他的律法。你们要赞美耶和华！
105.en: that they might keep his precepts and observe his laws. Praise the Lord .

106.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！
106.en: Praise the Lord . Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

106.zh: 谁能传说耶和华的大能？谁能表明他一切的美德？
106.en: Who can proclaim the mighty acts of the Lord or fully declare his praise?

106.zh: 凡遵守公平﹔常行公义的，这人便为有福！
106.en: Blessed are they who maintain justice, who constantly do what is right.

106.zh: 耶和华啊，你用恩惠待你的百姓；求你也用这恩惠记念我，开你的救恩眷顾我，
106.en: Remember me, O Lord , when you show favor to your people, come to my aid when you save them,

106.zh: 使我见你选民的福，乐你国民的乐，与你的产业一同夸耀。
106.en: that I may enjoy the prosperity of your chosen ones, that I may share in the joy of your nation and join your inheritance in giving praise.

106.zh: 我们与我们的祖宗一同犯罪；我们作了孽，行了恶。
106.en: We have sinned, even as our fathers did; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

106.zh: 我们的祖宗在埃及不明白你的奇事，不记念你丰盛的慈爱，反倒在红海行了悖逆。
106.en: When our fathers were in Egypt, they gave no thought to your miracles; they did not remember your many kindnesses, and they rebelled by the sea, the Red Sea.

106.zh: 然而，他因自己的名拯救他们，为要彰显他的大能，
106.en: Yet he saved them for his name's sake, to make his mighty power known.

106.zh: 并且斥责红海，海便干了；他带领他们经过深处，如同经过旷野。
106.en: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; he led them through the depths as through a desert.

106.zh: 他拯救他们脱离恨他们人的手，从仇敌手中救赎他们。
106.en: He saved them from the hand of the foe; from the hand of the enemy he redeemed them.

106.zh: 水淹没他们的敌人，没有一个存留。
106.en: The waters covered their adversaries; not one of them survived.

106.zh: 那时，他们才信了他的话，歌唱赞美他。
106.en: Then they believed his promises and sang his praise.

106.zh: 等不多时，他们就忘了他的作为，不仰望他的指教，
106.en: But they soon forgot what he had done and did not wait for his counsel.

106.zh: 反倒在旷野大起欲心，在荒地试探神。
106.en: In the desert they gave in to their craving; in the wasteland they put God to the test.

106.zh: 他将他们所求的赐给他们，却使他们的心灵软弱。
106.en: So he gave them what they asked for, but sent a wasting disease upon them.

106.zh: 他们又在营中嫉妒摩西和耶和华的圣者亚伦。
106.en: In the camp they grew envious of Moses and of Aaron, who was consecrated to the Lord .

106.zh: 地裂开，吞下大坍，掩盖亚比兰一党的人。
106.en: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it buried the company of Abiram.

106.zh: 有火在他们的党中发起；有火焰烧毁了恶人。
106.en: Fire blazed among their followers; a flame consumed the wicked.

106.zh: 他们在何烈山造了牛犊，叩拜铸成的像。
106.en: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped an idol cast from metal.

106.zh: 如此将他们荣耀的主换为吃草之牛的像，
106.en: They exchanged their Glory for an image of a bull, which eats grass.

106.zh: 忘了神─他们的救主；他曾在埃及行大事，
106.en: They forgot the God who saved them, who had done great things in Egypt,

106.zh: 在含地行奇事，在红海行可畏的事。
106.en: miracles in the land of Ham and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

106.zh: 所以，他说要灭绝他们；若非有他所拣选的摩西站在当中（原文是破口），使他的忿怒转消，恐怕他就灭绝他们。
106.en: So he said he would destroy them- had not Moses, his chosen one, stood in the breach before him to keep his wrath from destroying them.

106.zh: 他们又藐视那美地，不信他的话，
106.en: Then they despised the pleasant land; they did not believe his promise.

106.zh: 在自己帐棚内发怨言，不听耶和华的声音。
106.en: They grumbled in their tents and did not obey the Lord .

106.zh: 所以，他对他们起誓：必叫他们倒在旷野，
106.en: So he swore to them with uplifted hand that he would make them fall in the desert,

106.zh: 叫他们的后裔倒在列国之中，分散在各地。
106.en: make their descendants fall among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

106.zh: 他们又与巴力•毗珥连合，且吃了祭死神（或译：人）的物。
106.en: They yoked themselves to the Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods;

106.zh: 他们这样行，惹耶和华发怒，便有瘟疫流行在他们中间。
106.en: they provoked the Lord to anger by their wicked deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

106.zh: 那时，非尼哈站起，刑罚恶人，瘟疫这才止息。
106.en: But Phinehas stood up and intervened, and the plague was checked.

106.zh: 那就算为他的义，世世代代，直到永远。
106.en: This was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

106.zh: 他们在米利巴水又叫耶和华发怒，甚至摩西也受了亏损，
106.en: By the waters of Meribah they angered the Lord , and trouble came to Moses because of them;

106.zh: 是因他们惹动他的灵，摩西（原文是他）用嘴说了急躁的话。
106.en: for they rebelled against the Spirit of God, and rash words came from Moses' lips.

106.zh: 他们不照耶和华所吩咐的灭绝外邦人，
106.en: They did not destroy the peoples as the Lord had commanded them,

106.zh: 反与他们混杂相合，学习他们的行为，
106.en: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

106.zh: 事奉他们的偶像，这就成了自己的网罗，
106.en: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

106.zh: 把自己的儿女祭祀鬼魔，
106.en: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

106.zh: 流无辜人的血，就是自己儿女的血，把他们祭祀迦南的偶像，那地就被血污秽了。
106.en: They shed innocent blood, the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was desecrated by their blood.

106.zh: 这样，他们被自己所做的污秽了，在行为上犯了邪淫。
106.en: They defiled themselves by what they did; by their deeds they prostituted themselves.

106.zh: 所以，耶和华的怒气向他的百姓发作，憎恶他的产业，
106.en: Therefore the Lord was angry with his people and abhorred his inheritance.

106.zh: 将他们交在外邦人的手里；恨他们的人就辖制他们。
106.en: He handed them over to the nations, and their foes ruled over them.

106.zh: 他们的仇敌也欺压他们，他们就伏在敌人手下。
106.en: Their enemies oppressed them and subjected them to their power.

106.zh: 他屡次搭救他们，他们却设谋背逆，因自己的罪孽降为卑下。
106.en: Many times he delivered them, but they were bent on rebellion and they wasted away in their sin.

106.zh: 然而，他听见他们哀告的时候，就眷顾他们的急难，
106.en: But he took note of their distress when he heard their cry;

106.zh: 为他们记念他的约，照他丰盛的慈爱后悔。
106.en: for their sake he remembered his covenant and out of his great love he relented.

106.zh: 他也使他们在凡掳掠他们的人面前蒙怜恤。
106.en: He caused them to be pitied by all who held them captive.

106.zh: 耶和华─我们的神啊，求你拯救我们，从外邦中招聚我们，我们好称赞你的圣名，以赞美你为夸胜。
106.en: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to your holy name and glory in your praise.

106.zh: 耶和华─以色列的神是应当称颂的，从亘古直到永远。愿众民都说：阿们！你们要赞美耶和华！
106.en: Praise be to the Lord , the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, "Amen!" Praise the Lord .

107.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！
107.en: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

107.zh: 愿耶和华的赎民说这话，就是他从敌人手中所救赎的，
107.en: Let the redeemed of the Lord say this- those he redeemed from the hand of the foe,

107.zh: 从各地，从东从西，从南从北，所招聚来的。
107.en: those he gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.

107.zh: 他们在旷野荒地漂流，寻不见可住的城邑，
107.en: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no way to a city where they could settle.

107.zh: 又饥又渴，心里发昏。
107.en: They were hungry and thirsty, and their lives ebbed away.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；他从他们的祸患中搭救他们，
107.en: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them from their distress.

107.zh: 又领他们行走直路，使他们往可居住的城邑。
107.en: He led them by a straight way to a city where they could settle.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；
107.en: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men,

107.zh: 因他使心里渴慕的人得以知足，使心里饥饿的人得饱美物。
107.en: for he satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.

107.zh: 那些坐在黑暗中、死荫里的人被困苦和铁炼捆锁，
107.en: Some sat in darkness and the deepest gloom, prisoners suffering in iron chains,

107.zh: 是因他们违背神的话语，藐视至高者的旨意。
107.en: for they had rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.

107.zh: 所以，他用劳苦治服他们的心；他们仆倒，无人扶助。
107.en: So he subjected them to bitter labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。
107.en: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

107.zh: 他从黑暗中和死荫里领他们出来，折断他们的绑索。
107.en: He brought them out of darkness and the deepest gloom and broke away their chains.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他；
107.en: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men,

107.zh: 因为他打破了铜门，砍断了铁闩。
107.en: for he breaks down gates of bronze and cuts through bars of iron.

107.zh: 愚妄人因自己的过犯和自己的罪孽便受苦楚。
107.en: Some became fools through their rebellious ways and suffered affliction because of their iniquities.

107.zh: 他们心里厌恶各样的食物，就临近死门。
107.en: They loathed all food and drew near the gates of death.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华；他从他们的祸患中拯救他们。
107.en: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them from their distress.

107.zh: 他发命医治他们，救他们脱离死亡。
107.en: He sent forth his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。
107.en: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men.

107.zh: 愿他们以感谢为祭献给他，欢呼述说他的作为！
107.en: Let them sacrifice thank offerings and tell of his works with songs of joy.

107.zh: 在海上坐船，在大水中经理事务的，
107.en: Others went out on the sea in ships; they were merchants on the mighty waters.

107.zh: 他们看见耶和华的作为，并他在深水中的奇事。
107.en: They saw the works of the Lord , his wonderful deeds in the deep.

107.zh: 因他一吩咐，狂风就起来，海中的波浪也扬起。
107.en: For he spoke and stirred up a tempest that lifted high the waves.

107.zh: 他们上到天空，下到海底；他们的心因患难便消化。
107.en: They mounted up to the heavens and went down to the depths; in their peril their courage melted away.

107.zh: 他们摇摇幌幌，东倒西歪，好像醉酒的人；他们的智慧无法可施。
107.en: They reeled and staggered like drunken men; they were at their wits' end.

107.zh: 于是，他们在苦难中哀求耶和华，他从他们的祸患中领出他们来。
107.en: Then they cried out to the Lord in their trouble, and he brought them out of their distress.

107.zh: 他使狂风止息，波浪就平静。
107.en: He stilled the storm to a whisper; the waves of the sea were hushed.

107.zh: 风息浪静，他们便欢喜；他就引他们到所愿去的海口。
107.en: They were glad when it grew calm, and he guided them to their desired haven.

107.zh: 但愿人因耶和华的慈爱和他向人所行的奇事都称赞他。
107.en: Let them give thanks to the Lord for his unfailing love and his wonderful deeds for men.

107.zh: 愿他们在民的会中尊崇他，在长老的位上赞美他！
107.en: Let them exalt him in the assembly of the people and praise him in the council of the elders.

107.zh: 他使江河变为旷野，叫水泉变为干渴之地，
107.en: He turned rivers into a desert, flowing springs into thirsty ground,

107.zh: 使肥地变为碱地；这都因其间居民的罪恶。
107.en: and fruitful land into a salt waste, because of the wickedness of those who lived there.

107.zh: 他使旷野变为水潭，叫旱地变为水泉。
107.en: He turned the desert into pools of water and the parched ground into flowing springs;

107.zh: 他使饥饿的人住在那里，好建造可住的城邑，
107.en: there he brought the hungry to live, and they founded a city where they could settle.

107.zh: 又种田地，栽葡萄园，得享所出的土产。
107.en: They sowed fields and planted vineyards that yielded a fruitful harvest;

107.zh: 他又赐福给他们，叫他们生养众多，也不叫他们的牲畜减少。
107.en: he blessed them, and their numbers greatly increased, and he did not let their herds diminish.

107.zh: 他们又因暴虐、患难、愁苦，就减少且卑下。
107.en: Then their numbers decreased, and they were humbled by oppression, calamity and sorrow;

107.zh: 他使君王蒙羞被辱，使他们在荒废无路之地漂流。
107.en: he who pours contempt on nobles made them wander in a trackless waste.

107.zh: 他却将穷乏人安置在高处，脱离苦难，使他的家属多如羊群。
107.en: But he lifted the needy out of their affliction and increased their families like flocks.

107.zh: 正直人看见就欢喜；罪孽之辈必塞口无言。
107.en: The upright see and rejoice, but all the wicked shut their mouths.

107.zh: 凡有智慧的，必在这些事上留心，也必思想耶和华的慈爱。
107.en: Whoever is wise, let him heed these things and consider the great love of the Lord .

108.zh: （大卫的诗歌。）神啊，我心坚定；我口（原文是荣耀）要唱诗歌颂！
108.en: My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my soul.

108.zh: 琴瑟啊，你们当醒起！我自己要极早醒起！
108.en: Awake, harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.

108.zh: 耶和华啊，我要在万民中称谢你，在列邦中歌颂你！
108.en: I will praise you, O Lord , among the nations; I will sing of you among the peoples.

108.zh: 因为，你的慈爱大过诸天；你的诚实达到穹苍。
108.en: For great is your love, higher than the heavens; your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

108.zh: 神啊，愿你崇高过于诸天！愿你的荣耀高过全地！
108.en: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens, and let your glory be over all the earth.

108.zh: 求你应允我们，用右手拯救我们，好叫你所亲爱的人得救。
108.en: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

108.zh: 神已经指著他的圣洁说（说：或译应许我）：我要欢乐；我要分开示剑，丈量疏割谷。
108.en: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph I will parcel out Shechem and measure off the Valley of Succoth.

108.zh: 基列是我的；玛拿西是我的；以法莲是护卫我头的；犹大是我的杖；
108.en: Gilead is mine, Manasseh is mine; Ephraim is my helmet, Judah my scepter.

108.zh: 摩押是我的沐浴盆；我要向以东抛鞋；我必因胜非利士呼喊。
108.en: Moab is my washbasin, upon Edom I toss my sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph."

108.zh: 谁能领我进坚固城？谁能引我到以东地？
108.en: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

108.zh: 神啊，你不是丢弃了我们么？神啊，你不和我们的军兵同去么？
108.en: Is it not you, O God, you who have rejected us and no longer go out with our armies?

108.zh: 求你帮助我们攻击敌人，因为人的帮助是枉然的。
108.en: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.

108.zh: 我们倚靠神才得施展大能，因为践踏我们敌人的就是他。
108.en: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

109.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）我所赞美的神啊，求你不要闭口不言。
109.en: O God, whom I praise, do not remain silent,

109.zh: 因为恶人的嘴和诡诈人的口已经张开攻击我；他们用撒谎的舌头对我说话。
109.en: for wicked and deceitful men have opened their mouths against me; they have spoken against me with lying tongues.

109.zh: 他们围绕我，说怨恨的话，又无故地攻打我。
109.en: With words of hatred they surround me; they attack me without cause.

109.zh: 他们与我为敌以报我爱，但我专心祈祷。
109.en: In return for my friendship they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.

109.zh: 他们向我以恶报善，以恨报爱。
109.en: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my friendship.

109.zh: 愿你派一个恶人辖制他，派一个对头站在他右边！
109.en: Appoint an evil man to oppose him; let an accuser stand at his right hand.

109.zh: 他受审判的时候，愿他出来担当罪名！愿他的祈祷反成为罪！
109.en: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayers condemn him.

109.zh: 愿他的年日短少！愿别人得他的职分！
109.en: May his days be few; may another take his place of leadership.

109.zh: 愿他的儿女为孤儿，他的妻子为寡妇！
109.en: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.

109.zh: 愿他的儿女漂流讨饭，从他们荒凉之处出来求食！
109.en: May his children be wandering beggars; may they be driven from their ruined homes.

109.zh: 愿强暴的债主牢笼他一切所有的！愿外人抢他劳碌得来的！
109.en: May a creditor seize all he has; may strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.

109.zh: 愿无人向他延绵施恩！愿无人可怜他的孤儿！
109.en: May no one extend kindness to him or take pity on his fatherless children.

109.zh: 愿他的后人断绝，名字被涂抹，不传于下代！
109.en: May his descendants be cut off, their names blotted out from the next generation.

109.zh: 愿他祖宗的罪孽被耶和华记念！愿他母亲的罪过不被涂抹！
109.en: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the Lord ; may the sin of his mother never be blotted out.

109.zh: 愿这些罪常在耶和华面前，使他的名号断绝于世！
109.en: May their sins always remain before the Lord , that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

109.zh: 因为他不想施恩，却逼迫困苦穷乏的和伤心的人，要把他们治死。
109.en: For he never thought of doing a kindness, but hounded to death the poor and the needy and the brokenhearted.

109.zh: 他爱咒骂，咒骂就临到他；他不喜爱福乐，福乐就与他远离！
109.en: He loved to pronounce a curse- may it come on him; he found no pleasure in blessing- may it be far from him.

109.zh: 他拿咒骂当衣服穿上；这咒骂就如水进他里面，像油入他的骨头。
109.en: He wore cursing as his garment; it entered into his body like water, into his bones like oil.

109.zh: 愿这咒骂当他遮身的衣服，当他常束的腰带！
109.en: May it be like a cloak wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.

109.zh: 这就是我对头和用恶言议论我的人从耶和华那里所受的报应。
109.en: May this be the Lord 's payment to my accusers, to those who speak evil of me.

109.zh: 主─耶和华啊，求你为你的名恩待我；因你的慈爱美好，求你搭救我！
109.en: But you, O Sovereign Lord , deal well with me for your name's sake; out of the goodness of your love, deliver me.

109.zh: 因为我困苦穷乏，内心受伤。
109.en: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

109.zh: 我如日影渐渐偏斜而去；我如蝗虫被抖出来。
109.en: I fade away like an evening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.

109.zh: 我因禁食，膝骨软弱；我身上的肉也渐渐瘦了。
109.en: My knees give way from fasting; my body is thin and gaunt.

109.zh: 我受他们的羞辱，他们看见我便摇头。
109.en: I am an object of scorn to my accusers; when they see me, they shake their heads.

109.zh: 耶和华─我的神啊，求你帮助我，照你的慈爱拯救我，
109.en: Help me, O Lord my God; save me in accordance with your love.

109.zh: 使他们知道这是你的手，是你─耶和华所行的事。
109.en: Let them know that it is your hand, that you, O Lord , have done it.

109.zh: 任凭他们咒骂，惟愿你赐福；他们几时起来就必蒙羞，你的仆人却要欢喜。
109.en: They may curse, but you will bless; when they attack they will be put to shame, but your servant will rejoice.

109.zh: 愿我的对头披戴羞辱！愿他们以自己的羞愧为外袍遮身！
109.en: My accusers will be clothed with disgrace and wrapped in shame as in a cloak.

109.zh: 我要用口极力称谢耶和华；我要在众人中间赞美他；
109.en: With my mouth I will greatly extol the Lord ; in the great throng I will praise him.

109.zh: 因为他必站在穷乏人的右边，要救他脱离审判他灵魂的人。
109.en: For he stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save his life from those who condemn him.

110.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华对我主说：你坐在我的右边，等我使你仇敌作你的脚凳。
110.en: The Lord says to my Lord: "Sit at my right hand until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet."

110.zh: 耶和华必使你从锡安伸出能力的杖来；你要在你仇敌中掌权。
110.en: The Lord will extend your mighty scepter from Zion; you will rule in the midst of your enemies.

110.zh: 当你掌权的日子（或译：行军的日子），你的民要以圣洁的妆饰为衣（或译：以圣洁为妆饰），甘心牺牲自己；你的民多如清晨的甘露（或译：你少年时光耀如清晨的甘露）。
