110.en: Your troops will be willing on your day of battle. Arrayed in holy majesty, from the womb of the dawn you will receive the dew of your youth.

110.zh: 耶和华起了誓，决不后悔，说：你是照著麦基洗德的等次永远为祭司。
110.en: The Lord has sworn and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever, in the order of Melchizedek."

110.zh: 在你右边的主，当他发怒的日子，必打伤列王。
110.en: The Lord is at your right hand; he will crush kings on the day of his wrath.

110.zh: 他要在列邦中刑罚恶人，尸首就遍满各处；他要在许多国中打破仇敌的头。
110.en: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead and crushing the rulers of the whole earth.

110.zh: 他要喝路旁的河水，因此必抬起头来。
110.en: He will drink from a brook beside the way ; therefore he will lift up his head.

111.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！我要在正直人的大会中，并公会中，一心称谢耶和华。
111.en: Praise the Lord . I will extol the Lord with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

111.zh: 耶和华的作为本为大；凡喜爱的都必考察。
111.en: Great are the works of the Lord ; they are pondered by all who delight in them.

111.zh: 他所行的是尊荣和威严；他的公义存到永远。
111.en: Glorious and majestic are his deeds, and his righteousness endures forever.

111.zh: 他行了奇事，使人记念；耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯。
111.en: He has caused his wonders to be remembered; the Lord is gracious and compassionate.

111.zh: 他赐粮食给敬畏他的人；他必永远记念他的约。
111.en: He provides food for those who fear him; he remembers his covenant forever.

111.zh: 他向百姓显出大能的作为，把外邦的地赐给他们为业。
111.en: He has shown his people the power of his works, giving them the lands of other nations.

111.zh: 他手所行的是诚实公平；他的训词都是确实的，
111.en: The works of his hands are faithful and just; all his precepts are trustworthy.

111.zh: 是永永远远坚定的，是按诚实正直设立的。
111.en: They are steadfast for ever and ever, done in faithfulness and uprightness.

111.zh: 他向百姓施行救赎，命定他的约，直到永远；他的名圣而可畏。
111.en: He provided redemption for his people; he ordained his covenant forever- holy and awesome is his name.

111.zh: 敬畏耶和华是智慧的开端；凡遵行他命令的是聪明人。耶和华是永远当赞美的！
111.en: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow his precepts have good understanding. To him belongs eternal praise.

112.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！敬畏耶和华，甚喜爱他命令的，这人便为有福！
112.en: Praise the Lord . Blessed is the man who fears the Lord , who finds great delight in his commands.

112.zh: 他的后裔在世必强盛；正直人的后代必要蒙福。
112.en: His children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

112.zh: 他家中有货物，有钱财；他的公义存到永远。
112.en: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.

112.zh: 正直人在黑暗中，有光向他发现；他有恩惠，有怜悯，有公义。
112.en: Even in darkness light dawns for the upright, for the gracious and compassionate and righteous man.

112.zh: 施恩与人、借贷与人的，这人事情顺利；他被审判的时候要诉明自己的冤。
112.en: Good will come to him who is generous and lends freely, who conducts his affairs with justice.

112.zh: 他永不动摇；义人被记念，直到永远。
112.en: Surely he will never be shaken; a righteous man will be remembered forever.

112.zh: 他必不怕凶恶的信息；他心坚定，倚靠耶和华。
112.en: He will have no fear of bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord .

112.zh: 他心确定，总不惧怕，直到他看见敌人遭报。
112.en: His heart is secure, he will have no fear; in the end he will look in triumph on his foes.

112.zh: 他施舍钱财，赒济贫穷；他的仁义存到永远。他的角必被高举，大有荣耀。
112.en: He has scattered abroad his gifts to the poor, his righteousness endures forever; his horn will be lifted high in honor.

112.zh: 恶人看见便恼恨，必咬牙而消化；恶人的心愿要归灭绝。
112.en: The wicked man will see and be vexed, he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the longings of the wicked will come to nothing.

113.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！耶和华的仆人哪，你们要赞美，赞美耶和华的名！
113.en: Praise the Lord . Praise, O servants of the Lord , praise the name of the Lord .

113.zh: 耶和华的名是应当称颂的，从今时直到永远！
113.en: Let the name of the Lord be praised, both now and forevermore.

113.zh: 从日出之地到日落之处，耶和华的名是应当赞美的！
113.en: From the rising of the sun to the place where it sets, the name of the Lord is to be praised.

113.zh: 耶和华超乎万民之上；他的荣耀高过诸天。
113.en: The Lord is exalted over all the nations, his glory above the heavens.

113.zh: 谁像耶和华─我们的神呢？他坐在至高之处，
113.en: Who is like the Lord our God, the One who sits enthroned on high,

113.zh: 自己谦卑，观看天上地下的事。
113.en: who stoops down to look on the heavens and the earth?

113.zh: 他从灰尘里抬举贫寒人，从粪堆中提拔穷乏人，
113.en: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap;

113.zh: 使他们与王子同坐，就是与本国的王子同坐。
113.en: he seats them with princes, with the princes of their people.

113.zh: 他使不能生育的妇人安居家中，为多子的乐母。你们要赞美耶和华！
113.en: He settles the barren woman in her home as a happy mother of children. Praise the Lord .

114.zh: 以色列出了埃及，雅各家离开说异言之民；
114.en: When Israel came out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue,

114.zh: 那时，犹大为主的圣所，以色列为他所治理的国度。
114.en: Judah became God's sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

114.zh: 沧海看见就奔逃；约但河也倒流。
114.en: The sea looked and fled, the Jordan turned back;

114.zh: 大山踊跃，如公羊；小山跳舞，如羊羔。
114.en: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.

114.zh: 沧海啊，你为何奔逃？约但哪，你为何倒流？
114.en: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,

114.zh: 大山哪，你为何踊跃，如公羊？小山哪，你为何跳舞，如羊羔？
114.en: you mountains, that you skipped like rams, you hills, like lambs?

114.zh: 大地啊，你因见主的面，就是雅各神的面，便要震动。
114.en: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

114.zh: 他叫磐石变为水池，叫坚石变为泉源。
114.en: who turned the rock into a pool, the hard rock into springs of water.

115.zh: 耶和华啊，荣耀不要归与我们，不要归与我们；要因你的慈爱和诚实归在你的名下！
115.en: Not to us, O Lord , not to us but to your name be the glory, because of your love and faithfulness.

115.zh: 为何容外邦人说：他们的神在哪里呢？
115.en: Why do the nations say, "Where is their God?"

115.zh: 然而，我们的神在天上，都随自己的意旨行事。
115.en: Our God is in heaven; he does whatever pleases him.

115.zh: 他们的偶像是金的，银的，是人手所造的，
115.en: But their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

115.zh: 有口却不能言，有眼却不能看，
115.en: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but they cannot see;

115.zh: 有耳却不能听，有鼻却不能闻，
115.en: they have ears, but cannot hear, noses, but they cannot smell;

115.zh: 有手却不能摸，有脚却不能走，有喉咙也不能出声。
115.en: they have hands, but cannot feel, feet, but they cannot walk; nor can they utter a sound with their throats.

115.zh: 造他的要和他一样；凡靠他的也要如此。
115.en: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

115.zh: 以色列啊，你要倚靠耶和华！他是你的帮助和你的盾牌。
115.en: O house of Israel, trust in the Lord - he is their help and shield.

115.zh: 亚伦家啊，你们要倚靠耶和华！他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。
115.en: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord - he is their help and shield.

115.zh: 你们敬畏耶和华的，要倚靠耶和华！他是你们的帮助和你们的盾牌。
115.en: You who fear him, trust in the Lord - he is their help and shield.

115.zh: 耶和华向来眷念我们；他还要赐福给我们：要赐福给以色列的家，赐福给亚伦的家。
115.en: The Lord remembers us and will bless us: He will bless the house of Israel, he will bless the house of Aaron,

115.zh: 凡敬畏耶和华的，无论大小，主必赐福给他。
115.en: he will bless those who fear the Lord - small and great alike.

115.zh: 愿耶和华叫你们和你们的子孙日见加增。
115.en: May the Lord make you increase, both you and your children.

115.zh: 你们蒙了造天地之耶和华的福！
115.en: May you be blessed by the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

115.zh: 天，是耶和华的天；地，他却给了世人。
115.en: The highest heavens belong to the Lord , but the earth he has given to man.

115.zh: 死人不能赞美耶和华；下到寂静中的也都不能。
115.en: It is not the dead who praise the Lord , those who go down to silence;

115.zh: 但我们要称颂耶和华，从今时直到永远。你们要赞美耶和华！
115.en: it is we who extol the Lord , both now and forevermore. Praise the Lord .

116.zh: 我爱耶和华，因为他听了我的声音和我的恳求。
116.en: I love the Lord , for he heard my voice; he heard my cry for mercy.

116.zh: 他既向我侧耳，我一生要求告他。
116.en: Because he turned his ear to me, I will call on him as long as I live.

116.zh: 死亡的绳索缠绕我；阴间的痛苦抓住我；我遭遇患难愁苦。
116.en: The cords of death entangled me, the anguish of the grave came upon me; I was overcome by trouble and sorrow.

116.zh: 那时，我便求告耶和华的名，说：耶和华啊，求你救我的灵魂！
116.en: Then I called on the name of the Lord : "O Lord , save me!"

116.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有公义；我们的神以怜悯为怀。
116.en: The Lord is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.

116.zh: 耶和华保护愚人；我落到卑微的地步，他救了我。
116.en: The Lord protects the simplehearted; when I was in great need, he saved me.

116.zh: 我的心哪！你要仍归安乐，因为耶和华用厚恩待你。
116.en: Be at rest once more, O my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

116.zh: 主啊，你救我的命免了死亡，救我的眼免了流泪，救我的脚免了跌倒。
116.en: For you, O Lord , have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling,

116.zh: 我要在耶和华面前行活人之路。
116.en: that I may walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

116.zh: 我因信，所以如此说话；我受了极大的困苦。
116.en: I believed; therefore I said, "I am greatly afflicted."

116.zh: 我曾急促地说：人都是说谎的！
116.en: And in my dismay I said, "All men are liars."

116.zh: 我拿甚么报答耶和华向我所赐的一切厚恩？
116.en: How can I repay the Lord for all his goodness to me?

116.zh: 我要举起救恩的杯，称扬耶和华的名。
116.en: I will lift up the cup of salvation and call on the name of the Lord .

116.zh: 我要在他众民面前向耶和华还我的愿。
116.en: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people.

116.zh: 在耶和华眼中，看圣民之死极为宝贵。
116.en: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

116.zh: 耶和华啊，我真是你的仆人；我是你的仆人，是你婢女的儿子。你已经解开我的绑索。
116.en: O Lord , truly I am your servant; I am your servant, the son of your maidservant ; you have freed me from my chains.

116.zh: 我要以感谢为祭献给你，又要求告耶和华的名。
116.en: I will sacrifice a thank offering to you and call on the name of the Lord .

116.zh: 我要在他众民面前，在耶和华殿的院内，在耶路撒冷当中，向耶和华还我的愿。你们要赞美耶和华！
116.en: I will fulfill my vows to the Lord in the presence of all his people,
in the courts of the house of the Lord - in your midst, O Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .

117.zh: 万国啊，你们都当赞美耶和华！万民哪，你们都当颂赞他！
117.en: Praise the Lord , all you nations; extol him, all you peoples.

117.zh: 因为他向我们大施慈爱；耶和华的诚实存到永远。你们要赞美耶和华！
117.en: For great is his love toward us, and the faithfulness of the Lord endures forever. Praise the Lord .

118.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

118.zh: 愿以色列说：他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Let Israel say: "His love endures forever."

118.zh: 愿亚伦的家说：他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Let the house of Aaron say: "His love endures forever."

118.zh: 愿敬畏耶和华的说：他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Let those who fear the Lord say: "His love endures forever."

118.zh: 我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我，把我安置在宽阔之地。
118.en: In my anguish I cried to the Lord , and he answered by setting me free.

118.zh: 有耶和华帮助我，我必不惧怕，人能把我怎么样呢？
118.en: The Lord is with me; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

118.zh: 在那帮助我的人中，有耶和华帮助我，所以我要看见那恨我的人遭报。
118.en: The Lord is with me; he is my helper. I will look in triumph on my enemies.

118.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖人；
118.en: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in man.

118.zh: 投靠耶和华，强似倚赖王子。
118.en: It is better to take refuge in the Lord than to trust in princes.

118.zh: 万民围绕我，我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。
118.en: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the Lord I cut them off.

118.zh: 他们环绕我，围困我，我靠耶和华的名必剿灭他们。
118.en: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the Lord I cut them off.

118.zh: 他们如同蜂子围绕我，好像烧荆棘的火，必被熄灭；我靠耶和华的名，必剿灭他们。
118.en: They swarmed around me like bees, but they died out as quickly as burning thorns; in the name of the Lord I cut them off.

118.zh: 你推我，要叫我跌倒，但耶和华帮助了我。
118.en: I was pushed back and about to fall, but the Lord helped me.

118.zh: 耶和华是我的力量，是我的诗歌；他也成了我的拯救。
118.en: The Lord is my strength and my song; he has become my salvation.

118.zh: 在义人的帐棚里，有欢呼拯救的声音；耶和华的右手施展大能。
118.en: Shouts of joy and victory resound in the tents of the righteous: "The Lord 's right hand has done mighty things!

118.zh: 耶和华的右手高举；耶和华的右手施展大能。
118.en: The Lord 's right hand is lifted high; the Lord 's right hand has done mighty things!"

118.zh: 我必不致死，仍要存活，并要传扬耶和华的作为。
118.en: I will not die but live, and will proclaim what the Lord has done.

118.zh: 耶和华虽严严地惩治我，却未曾将我交于死亡。
118.en: The Lord has chastened me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

118.zh: 给我敞开义门；我要进去称谢耶和华！
118.en: Open for me the gates of righteousness; I will enter and give thanks to the Lord .

118.zh: 这是耶和华的门；义人要进去！
118.en: This is the gate of the Lord through which the righteous may enter.

118.zh: 我要称谢你，因为你已经应允我，又成了我的拯救！
118.en: I will give you thanks, for you answered me; you have become my salvation.

118.zh: 匠人所弃的石头已成了房角的头块石头。
118.en: The stone the builders rejected has become the capstone;

118.zh: 这是耶和华所做的，在我们眼中看为希奇。
118.en: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes.

118.zh: 这是耶和华所定的日子，我们在其中要高兴欢喜！
118.en: This is the day the Lord has made; let us rejoice and be glad in it.

118.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救！耶和华啊，求你使我们亨通！
118.en: O Lord , save us; O Lord , grant us success.

118.zh: 奉耶和华名来的是应当称颂的！我们从耶和华的殿中为你们祝福！
118.en: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord . From the house of the Lord we bless you.

118.zh: 耶和华是神；他光照了我们。理当用绳索把祭牲拴住，牵到坛角那里。
118.en: The Lord is God, and he has made his light shine upon us. With boughs in hand, join in the festal procession up to the horns of the altar.

118.zh: 你是我的神，我要称谢你！你是我的神，我要尊崇你！
118.en: You are my God, and I will give you thanks; you are my God, and I will exalt you.

118.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存！
118.en: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good; his love endures forever.

119.zh: 行为完全、遵行耶和华律法的，这人便为有福！
119.en: Blessed are they whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the law of the Lord .

119.zh: 遵守他的法度、一心寻求他的，这人便为有福！
119.en: Blessed are they who keep his statutes and seek him with all their heart.

119.zh: 这人不做非义的事，但遵行他的道。
119.en: They do nothing wrong; they walk in his ways.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你曾将你的训词吩咐我们，为要我们殷勤遵守。
119.en: You have laid down precepts that are to be fully obeyed.

119.zh: 但愿我行事坚定，得以遵守你的律例。
119.en: Oh, that my ways were steadfast in obeying your decrees!

119.zh: 我看重你的一切命令，就不至于羞愧。
119.en: Then I would not be put to shame when I consider all your commands.

119.zh: 我学了你公义的判语，就要以正直的心称谢你。
119.en: I will praise you with an upright heart as I learn your righteous laws.

119.zh: 我必守你的律例；求你总不要丢弃我！
119.en: I will obey your decrees; do not utterly forsake me.

119.zh: 少年人用甚么洁净他的行为呢？是要遵行你的话！
119.en: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

119.zh: 我一心寻求了你；求你不要叫我偏离你的命令。
119.en: I seek you with all my heart; do not let me stray from your commands.

119.zh: 我将你的话藏在心里，免得我得罪你。
119.en: I have hidden your word in my heart that I might not sin against you.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你是应当称颂的！求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: Praise be to you, O Lord ; teach me your decrees.

119.zh: 我用嘴唇传扬你口中的一切典章。
119.en: With my lips I recount all the laws that come from your mouth.

119.zh: 我喜悦你的法度，如同喜悦一切的财物。
119.en: I rejoice in following your statutes as one rejoices in great riches.

119.zh: 我要默想你的训词，看重你的道路。
119.en: I meditate on your precepts and consider your ways.

119.zh: 我要在你的律例中自乐；我不忘记你的话。
119.en: I delight in your decrees; I will not neglect your word.

119.zh: 求你用厚恩待你的仆人，使我存活，我就遵守你的话。
119.en: Do good to your servant, and I will live; I will obey your word.

119.zh: 求你开我的眼睛，使我看出你律法中的奇妙。
119.en: Open my eyes that I may see wonderful things in your law.

119.zh: 我是在地上作寄居的；求你不要向我隐瞒你的命令！
119.en: I am a stranger on earth; do not hide your commands from me.

119.zh: 我时常切慕你的典章，甚至心碎。
119.en: My soul is consumed with longing for your laws at all times.

119.zh: 受咒诅、偏离你命令的骄傲人，你已经责备他们。
119.en: You rebuke the arrogant, who are cursed and who stray from your commands.

119.zh: 求你除掉我所受的羞辱和藐视，因我遵守你的法度。
119.en: Remove from me scorn and contempt, for I keep your statutes.

119.zh: 虽有首领坐著妄论我，你仆人却思想你的律例。
119.en: Though rulers sit together and slander me, your servant will meditate on your decrees.

119.zh: 你的法度是我所喜乐的，是我的谋士。
119.en: Your statutes are my delight; they are my counselors.

119.zh: 我的性命几乎归于尘土；求你照你的话将我救活！
119.en: I am laid low in the dust; preserve my life according to your word.

119.zh: 我述说我所行的，你应允了我；求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: I recounted my ways and you answered me; teach me your decrees.

119.zh: 求你使我明白你的训词，我就思想你的奇事。
119.en: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts; then I will meditate on your wonders.

119.zh: 我的心因愁苦而消化；求你照你的话使我坚立！
119.en: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

119.zh: 求你使我离开奸诈的道，开恩将你的律法赐给我！
119.en: Keep me from deceitful ways; be gracious to me through your law.

119.zh: 我拣选了忠信的道，将你的典章摆在我面前。
119.en: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set my heart on your laws.

119.zh: 我持守你的法度；耶和华啊，求你不要叫我羞愧！
119.en: I hold fast to your statutes, O Lord ; do not let me be put to shame.

119.zh: 你开广我心的时候，我就往你命令的道上直奔。
119.en: I run in the path of your commands, for you have set my heart free.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，求你将你的律例指教我，我必遵守到底！
119.en: Teach me, O Lord , to follow your decrees; then I will keep them to the end.

119.zh: 求你赐我悟性，我便遵守你的律法，且要一心遵守。
119.en: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law and obey it with all my heart.

119.zh: 求你叫我遵行你的命令，因为这是我所喜乐的。
119.en: Direct me in the path of your commands, for there I find delight.

119.zh: 求你使我的心趋向你的法度，不趋向非义之财。
119.en: Turn my heart toward your statutes and not toward selfish gain.

119.zh: 求你叫我转眼不看虚假，又叫我在你的道中生活。
119.en: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; preserve my life according to your word.

119.zh: 你向敬畏你的人所应许的话，求你向仆人坚定！
119.en: Fulfill your promise to your servant, so that you may be feared.

119.zh: 求你使我所怕的羞辱远离我，因你的典章本为美。
119.en: Take away the disgrace I dread, for your laws are good.

119.zh: 我羡慕你的训词；求你使我在你的公义上生活！
119.en: How I long for your precepts! Preserve my life in your righteousness.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，愿你照你的话，使你的慈爱，就是你的救恩，临到我身上，
119.en: May your unfailing love come to me, O Lord , your salvation according to your promise;

119.zh: 我就有话回答那羞辱我的，因我倚靠你的话。
119.en: then I will answer the one who taunts me, for I trust in your word.

119.zh: 求你叫真理的话总不离开我口，因我仰望你的典章。
119.en: Do not snatch the word of truth from my mouth, for I have put my hope in your laws.

119.zh: 我要常守你的律法，直到永永远远。
119.en: I will always obey your law, for ever and ever.

119.zh: 我要自由而行（或译：我要行在宽阔之地），因我素来考究你的训词。
119.en: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

119.zh: 我也要在君王面前论说你的法度，并不至于羞愧。
119.en: I will speak of your statutes before kings and will not be put to shame,

119.zh: 我要在你的命令中自乐；这命令素来是我所爱的。
119.en: for I delight in your commands because I love them.

119.zh: 我又要遵行（原文是举手）你的命令，这命令素来是我所爱的；我也要思想你的律例。
119.en: I lift up my hands to your commands, which I love, and I meditate on your decrees.

119.zh: 求你记念向你仆人所应许的话，叫我有盼望。
119.en: Remember your word to your servant, for you have given me hope.

119.zh: 这话将我救活了；我在患难中，因此得安慰。
119.en: My comfort in my suffering is this: Your promise preserves my life.

119.zh: 骄傲的人甚侮慢我，我却未曾偏离你的律法。
119.en: The arrogant mock me without restraint, but I do not turn from your law.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我记念你从古以来的典章，就得了安慰。
119.en: I remember your ancient laws, O Lord , and I find comfort in them.

119.zh: 我见恶人离弃你的律法，就怒气发作，犹如火烧。
119.en: Indignation grips me because of the wicked, who have forsaken your law.

119.zh: 我在世寄居，素来以你的律例为诗歌。
119.en: Your decrees are the theme of my song wherever I lodge.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我夜间记念你的名，遵守你的律法。
119.en: In the night I remember your name, O Lord , and I will keep your law.

119.zh: 我所以如此，是因我守你的训词。
119.en: This has been my practice: I obey your precepts.

119.zh: 耶和华是我的福分；我曾说，我要遵守你的言语。
119.en: You are my portion, O Lord ; I have promised to obey your words.

119.zh: 我一心求过你的恩；愿你照你的话怜悯我！
119.en: I have sought your face with all my heart; be gracious to me according to your promise.

119.zh: 我思想我所行的道，就转步归向你的法度。
119.en: I have considered my ways and have turned my steps to your statutes.

119.zh: 我急忙遵守你的命令，并不迟延。
119.en: I will hasten and not delay to obey your commands.

119.zh: 恶人的绳索缠绕我，我却没有忘记你的律法。
119.en: Though the wicked bind me with ropes, I will not forget your law.

119.zh: 我因你公义的典章，半夜必起来称谢你。
119.en: At midnight I rise to give you thanks for your righteous laws.

119.zh: 凡敬畏你、守你训词的人，我都与他作伴。
119.en: I am a friend to all who fear you, to all who follow your precepts.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈爱遍满大地；求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: The earth is filled with your love, O Lord ; teach me your decrees.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你向来是照你的话善待仆人。
119.en: Do good to your servant according to your word, O Lord .

119.zh: 求你将精明和知识赐给我，因我信了你的命令。
119.en: Teach me knowledge and good judgment, for I believe in your commands.

119.zh: 我未受苦以先走迷了路，现在却遵守你的话。
119.en: Before I was afflicted I went astray, but now I obey your word.

119.zh: 你本为善，所行的也善；求你将你的律例教训我！
119.en: You are good, and what you do is good; teach me your decrees.

119.zh: 骄傲人编造谎言攻击我，我却要一心守你的训词。
119.en: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep your precepts with all my heart.

119.zh: 他们心蒙脂油，我却喜爱你的律法。
119.en: Their hearts are callous and unfeeling, but I delight in your law.

119.zh: 我受苦是与我有益，为要使我学习你的律例。
119.en: It was good for me to be afflicted so that I might learn your decrees.

119.zh: 你口中的训言（或译：律法）与我有益，胜于千万的金银。
119.en: The law from your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of silver and gold.

119.zh: 你的手制造我，建立我；求你赐我悟性，可以学习你的命令！
119.en: Your hands made me and formed me; give me understanding to learn your commands.

119.zh: 敬畏你的人见我就要欢喜，因我仰望你的话。
119.en: May those who fear you rejoice when they see me, for I have put my hope in your word.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我知道你的判语是公义的；你使我受苦是以诚实待我。
119.en: I know, O Lord , that your laws are righteous, and in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

119.zh: 求你照著应许仆人的话，以慈爱安慰我。
119.en: May your unfailing love be my comfort, according to your promise to your servant.

119.zh: 愿你的慈悲临到我，使我存活，因你的律法是我所喜爱的。
119.en: Let your compassion come to me that I may live, for your law is my delight.

119.zh: 愿骄傲人蒙羞，因为他们无理地倾覆我；但我要思想你的训词。
119.en: May the arrogant be put to shame for wronging me without cause; but I will meditate on your precepts.

119.zh: 愿敬畏你的人归向我，他们就知道你的法度。
119.en: May those who fear you turn to me, those who understand your statutes.

119.zh: 愿我的心在你的律例上完全，使我不致蒙羞。
119.en: May my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be put to shame.

119.zh: 我心渴想你的救恩，仰望你的应许。
119.en: My soul faints with longing for your salvation, but I have put my hope in your word.

119.zh: 我因盼望你的应许眼睛失明，说：你何时安慰我？
119.en: My eyes fail, looking for your promise; I say, "When will you comfort me?"

119.zh: 我好像烟薰的皮袋，却不忘记你的律例。
119.en: Though I am like a wineskin in the smoke, I do not forget your decrees.

119.zh: 你仆人的年日有多少呢？你几时向逼迫我的人施行审判呢？
119.en: How long must your servant wait? When will you punish my persecutors?

119.zh: 不从你律法的骄傲人为我掘了坑。
119.en: The arrogant dig pitfalls for me, contrary to your law.

119.zh: 你的命令尽都诚实；他们无理地逼迫我，求你帮助我！
119.en: All your commands are trustworthy; help me, for men persecute me without cause.

119.zh: 他们几乎把我从世上灭绝，但我没有离弃你的训词。
119.en: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken your precepts.

119.zh: 求你照你的慈爱将我救活，我就遵守你口中的法度。
119.en: Preserve my life according to your love, and I will obey the statutes of your mouth.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你的话安定在天，直到永远。
119.en: Your word, O Lord , is eternal; it stands firm in the heavens.

119.zh: 你的诚实存到万代；你坚定了地，地就长存。
119.en: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; you established the earth, and it endures.

119.zh: 天地照你的安排存到今日；万物都是你的仆役。
119.en: Your laws endure to this day, for all things serve you.

119.zh: 我若不是喜爱你的律法，早就在苦难中灭绝了！
119.en: If your law had not been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

119.zh: 我永不忘记你的训词，因你用这训词将我救活了。
119.en: I will never forget your precepts, for by them you have preserved my life.

119.zh: 我是属你的，求你救我，因我寻求了你的训词。
119.en: Save me, for I am yours; I have sought out your precepts.

119.zh: 恶人等待我，要灭绝我，我却要揣摩你的法度。
119.en: The wicked are waiting to destroy me, but I will ponder your statutes.

119.zh: 我看万事尽都有限，惟有你的命令极其宽广。
119.en: To all perfection I see a limit; but your commands are boundless.

119.zh: 我何等爱慕你的律法，终日不住地思想。
119.en: Oh, how I love your law! I meditate on it all day long.

119.zh: 你的命令常存在我心里，使我比仇敌有智慧。
119.en: Your commands make me wiser than my enemies, for they are ever with me.

119.zh: 我比我的师傅更通达，因我思想你的法度。
119.en: I have more insight than all my teachers, for I meditate on your statutes.

119.zh: 我比年老的更明白，因我守了你的训词。
119.en: I have more understanding than the elders, for I obey your precepts.

119.zh: 我禁止我脚走一切的邪路，为要遵守你的话。
119.en: I have kept my feet from every evil path so that I might obey your word.

119.zh: 我没有偏离你的典章，因为你教训了我。
119.en: I have not departed from your laws, for you yourself have taught me.

119.zh: 你的言语在我上膛何等甘美，在我口中比蜜更甜！
119.en: How sweet are your words to my taste, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

119.zh: 我藉著你的训词得以明白，所以我恨一切的假道。
119.en: I gain understanding from your precepts; therefore I hate every wrong path.

119.zh: 你的话是我脚前的灯，是我路上的光。
119.en: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light for my path.

119.zh: 你公义的典章，我曾起誓遵守，我必按誓而行。
119.en: I have taken an oath and confirmed it, that I will follow your righteous laws.

119.zh: 我甚是受苦；耶和华啊，求你照你的话将我救活！
119.en: I have suffered much; preserve my life, O Lord , according to your word.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，求你悦纳我口中的赞美为供物，又将你的典章教训我！
119.en: Accept, O Lord , the willing praise of my mouth, and teach me your laws.

119.zh: 我的性命常在危险之中，我却不忘记你的律法。
119.en: Though I constantly take my life in my hands, I will not forget your law.

119.zh: 恶人为我设下网罗，我却没有偏离你的训词。
119.en: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from your precepts.

119.zh: 我以你的法度为永远的产业，因这是我心中所喜爱的。
119.en: Your statutes are my heritage forever; they are the joy of my heart.

119.zh: 我的心专向你的律例，永远遵行，一直到底。
119.en: My heart is set on keeping your decrees to the very end.

119.zh: 心怀二意的人为我所恨；但你的律法为我所爱。
119.en: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

119.zh: 你是我藏身之处，又是我的盾牌；我甚仰望你的话语。
119.en: You are my refuge and my shield; I have put my hope in your word.

119.zh: 作恶的人哪，你们离开我罢！我好遵守我神的命令。
119.en: Away from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commands of my God!

119.zh: 求你照你的话扶持我，使我存活，也不叫我因失望而害羞。
119.en: Sustain me according to your promise, and I will live; do not let my hopes be dashed.

119.zh: 求你扶持我，我便得救，时常看重你的律例。
119.en: Uphold me, and I will be delivered; I will always have regard for your decrees.

119.zh: 凡偏离你律例的人，你都轻弃他们，因为他们的诡诈必归虚空。
119.en: You reject all who stray from your decrees, for their deceitfulness is in vain.

119.zh: 凡地上的恶人，你除掉他，好像除掉渣滓；因此我爱你的法度。
119.en: All the wicked of the earth you discard like dross; therefore I love your statutes.

119.zh: 我因惧怕你，肉就发抖；我也怕你的判语。
119.en: My flesh trembles in fear of you; I stand in awe of your laws.

119.zh: 我行过公平和公义，求你不要撇下我给欺压我的人！
119.en: I have done what is righteous and just; do not leave me to my oppressors.

119.zh: 求你为仆人作保，使我得好处，不容骄傲人欺压我！
119.en: Ensure your servant's well-being; let not the arrogant oppress me.

119.zh: 我因盼望你的救恩和你公义的话眼睛失明。
119.en: My eyes fail, looking for your salvation, looking for your righteous promise.

119.zh: 求你照你的慈爱待仆人，将你的律例教训我。
119.en: Deal with your servant according to your love and teach me your decrees.

119.zh: 我是你的仆人，求你赐我悟性，使我得知你的法度。
119.en: I am your servant; give me discernment that I may understand your statutes.

119.zh: 这是耶和华降罚的时候，因人废了你的律法。
119.en: It is time for you to act, O Lord ; your law is being broken.

119.zh: 所以，我爱你的命令胜于金子，更胜于精金。
119.en: Because I love your commands more than gold, more than pure gold,

119.zh: 你一切的训词，在万事上我都以为正直；我却恨恶一切假道。
119.en: and because I consider all your precepts right, I hate every wrong path.

119.zh: 你的法度奇妙，所以我一心谨守。
119.en: Your statutes are wonderful; therefore I obey them.

119.zh: 你的言语一解开就发出亮光，使愚人通达。
119.en: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

119.zh: 我张口而气喘，因我切慕你的命令。
119.en: I open my mouth and pant, longing for your commands.

119.zh: 求你转向我，怜悯我，好像你素常待那些爱你名的人。
119.en: Turn to me and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

119.zh: 求你用你的话使我脚步稳当，不许甚么罪孽辖制我。
119.en: Direct my footsteps according to your word; let no sin rule over me.

119.zh: 求你救我脱离人的欺压，我要遵守你的训词。
119.en: Redeem me from the oppression of men, that I may obey your precepts.

119.zh: 求你用脸光照仆人，又将你的律例教训我。
119.en: Make your face shine upon your servant and teach me your decrees.

119.zh: 我的眼泪下流成河，因为他们不守你的律法。
119.en: Streams of tears flow from my eyes, for your law is not obeyed.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你是公义的；你的判语也是正直的！
119.en: Righteous are you, O Lord , and your laws are right.

119.zh: 你所命定的法度是凭公义和至诚。
119.en: The statutes you have laid down are righteous; they are fully trustworthy.

119.zh: 我心焦急，如同火烧，因我敌人忘记你的言语。
119.en: My zeal wears me out, for my enemies ignore your words.

119.zh: 你的话极其精炼，所以你的仆人喜爱。
119.en: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

119.zh: 我微小，被人藐视，却不忘记你的训词。
119.en: Though I am lowly and despised, I do not forget your precepts.

119.zh: 你的公义永远长存；你的律法尽都真实。
119.en: Your righteousness is everlasting and your law is true.

119.zh: 我遭遇患难愁苦，你的命令却是我所喜爱的。
119.en: Trouble and distress have come upon me, but your commands are my delight.

119.zh: 你的法度永远是公义的；求你赐我悟性，我就活了。
119.en: Your statutes are forever right; give me understanding that I may live.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我一心呼吁你；求你应允我，我必谨守你的律例！
119.en: I call with all my heart; answer me, O Lord , and I will obey your decrees.

119.zh: 我向你呼吁，求你救我！我要遵守你的法度。
119.en: I call out to you; save me and I will keep your statutes.

119.zh: 我趁天未亮呼求；我仰望了你的言语。
119.en: I rise before dawn and cry for help; I have put my hope in your word.

119.zh: 我趁夜更未换将眼睁开，为要思想你的话语。
119.en: My eyes stay open through the watches of the night, that I may meditate on your promises.

119.zh: 求你照你的慈爱听我的声音；耶和华啊，求你照你的典章将我救活！
119.en: Hear my voice in accordance with your love; preserve my life, O Lord , according to your laws.

119.zh: 追求奸恶的人临近了；他们远离你的律法。
119.en: Those who devise wicked schemes are near, but they are far from your law.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你与我相近；你一切的命令尽都真实！
119.en: Yet you are near, O Lord , and all your commands are true.

119.zh: 我因学你的法度，久已知道是你永远立定的。
119.en: Long ago I learned from your statutes that you established them to last forever.

119.zh: 求你看顾我的苦难，搭救我，因我不忘记你的律法。
119.en: Look upon my suffering and deliver me, for I have not forgotten your law.

119.zh: 求你为我辨屈，救赎我，照你的话将我救活。
119.en: Defend my cause and redeem me; preserve my life according to your promise.

119.zh: 救恩远离恶人，因为他们不寻求你的律例。
119.en: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they do not seek out your decrees.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，你的慈悲本为大；求你照你的典章将我救活。
119.en: Your compassion is great, O Lord ; preserve my life according to your laws.

119.zh: 逼迫我的，抵挡我的，很多，我却没有偏离你的法度。
119.en: Many are the foes who persecute me, but I have not turned from your statutes.

119.zh: 我看见奸恶的人就甚憎恶，因为他们不遵守你的话。
119.en: I look on the faithless with loathing, for they do not obey your word.

119.zh: 你看我怎样爱你的训词！耶和华啊，求你照你的慈爱将我救活！
119.en: See how I love your precepts; preserve my life, O Lord , according to your love.

119.zh: 你话的总纲是真实；你一切公义的典章是永远长存。
119.en: All your words are true; all your righteous laws are eternal.

119.zh: 首领无故地逼迫我，但我的心畏惧你的言语。
119.en: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart trembles at your word.

119.zh: 我喜爱你的话，好像人得了许多掳物。
119.en: I rejoice in your promise like one who finds great spoil.

119.zh: 谎话是我所恨恶所憎嫌的；惟你的律法是我所爱的。
119.en: I hate and abhor falsehood but I love your law.

119.zh: 我因你公义的典章一天七次赞美你。
119.en: Seven times a day I praise you for your righteous laws.

119.zh: 爱你律法的人有大平安，甚么都不能使他们绊脚。
119.en: Great peace have they who love your law, and nothing can make them stumble.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我仰望了你的救恩，遵行了你的命令。
119.en: I wait for your salvation, O Lord , and I follow your commands.

119.zh: 我心里守了你的法度；这法度我甚喜爱。
119.en: I obey your statutes, for I love them greatly.

119.zh: 我遵守了你的训词和法度，因我一切所行的都在你面前。
119.en: I obey your precepts and your statutes, for all my ways are known to you.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，愿我的呼吁达到你面前，照你的话赐我悟性。
119.en: May my cry come before you, O Lord ; give me understanding according to your word.

119.zh: 愿我的恳求达到你面前，照你的话搭救我。
119.en: May my supplication come before you; deliver me according to your promise.

119.zh: 愿我的嘴发出赞美的话，因为你将律例教训我。
119.en: May my lips overflow with praise, for you teach me your decrees.

119.zh: 愿我的舌头歌唱你的话，因你一切的命令尽都公义。
119.en: May my tongue sing of your word, for all your commands are righteous.

119.zh: 愿你用手帮助我，因我拣选了你的训词。
119.en: May your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

119.zh: 耶和华啊，我切慕你的救恩！你的律法也是我所喜爱的。
119.en: I long for your salvation, O Lord , and your law is my delight.

119.zh: 愿我的性命存活，得以赞美你！愿你的典章帮助我！
119.en: Let me live that I may praise you, and may your laws sustain me.

119.zh: 我如亡羊走迷了路，求你寻找仆人，因我不忘记你的命令。
119.en: I have strayed like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I have not forgotten your commands.

120.zh: （上行（或作登阶，下同）之诗。）我在急难中求告耶和华，他就应允我。
120.en: I call on the Lord in my distress, and he answers me.

120.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离说谎的嘴唇和诡诈的舌头！
120.en: Save me, O Lord , from lying lips and from deceitful tongues.

120.zh: 诡诈的舌头啊，要给你甚么呢？要拿甚么加给你呢？
120.en: What will he do to you, and what more besides, O deceitful tongue?

120.zh: 就是勇士的利箭和罗腾木（小树名，松类）的炭火。
120.en: He will punish you with a warrior's sharp arrows, with burning coals of the broom tree.

120.zh: 我寄居在米设，住在基达帐棚之中，有祸了！
120.en: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!

120.zh: 我与那恨恶和睦的人许久同住。
120.en: Too long have I lived among those who hate peace.

120.zh: 我愿和睦，但我发言，他们就要争战。
120.en: I am a man of peace; but when I speak, they are for war.

121.zh: （上行之诗。）我要向山举目；我的帮助从何而来？
121.en: I lift up my eyes to the hills- where does my help come from?

121.zh: 我的帮助从造天地的耶和华而来。
121.en: My help comes from the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

121.zh: 他必不叫你的脚摇动；保护你的必不打盹！
121.en: He will not let your foot slip- he who watches over you will not slumber;

121.zh: 保护以色列的，也不打盹也不睡觉。
121.en: indeed, he who watches over Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

121.zh: 保护你的是耶和华；耶和华在你右边荫庇你。
121.en: The Lord watches over you- the Lord is your shade at your right hand;

121.zh: 白日，太阳必不伤你；夜间，月亮必不害你。
121.en: the sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

121.zh: 耶和华要保护你，免受一切的灾害；他要保护你的性命。
121.en: The Lord will keep you from all harm- he will watch over your life;

121.zh: 你出你入，耶和华要保护你，从今时直到永远。
121.en: the Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

122.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）人对我说：我们往耶和华的殿去，我就欢喜。
122.en: I rejoiced with those who said to me, "Let us go to the house of the Lord ."

122.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，我们的脚站在你的门内。
122.en: Our feet are standing in your gates, O Jerusalem.

122.zh: 耶路撒冷被建造，如同连络整齐的一座城。
122.en: Jerusalem is built like a city that is closely compacted together.

122.zh: 众支派，就是耶和华的支派，上那里去，按以色列的常例（或译：作以色列的证据）称赞耶和华的名。
122.en: That is where the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord , to praise the name of the Lord according to the statute given to Israel.

122.zh: 因为在那里设立审判的宝座，就是大卫家的宝座。
122.en: There the thrones for judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.

122.zh: 你们要为耶路撒冷求平安！耶路撒冷啊，爱你的人必然兴旺！
122.en: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: "May those who love you be secure.

122.zh: 愿你城中平安！愿你宫内兴旺！
122.en: May there be peace within your walls and security within your citadels."

122.zh: 因我弟兄和同伴的缘故，我要说：愿平安在你中间！
122.en: For the sake of my brothers and friends, I will say, "Peace be within you."

122.zh: 因耶和华─我们神殿的缘故，我要为你求福！
122.en: For the sake of the house of the Lord our God, I will seek your prosperity.

123.zh: （上行之诗。）坐在天上的主啊，我向你举目。
123.en: I lift up my eyes to you, to you whose throne is in heaven.

123.zh: 看哪，仆人的眼睛怎样望主人的手，使女的眼睛怎样望主母的手，我们的眼睛也照样望耶和华─我们的神，直到他怜悯我们。
123.en: As the eyes of slaves look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the Lord our God, till he shows us his mercy.

123.zh: 耶和华啊，求你怜悯我们，怜悯我们！因为我们被藐视，已到极处。
123.en: Have mercy on us, O Lord , have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

123.zh: 我们被那些安逸人的讥诮和骄傲人的藐视，已到极处。
123.en: We have endured much ridicule from the proud, much contempt from the arrogant.

124.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）以色列人要说：若不是耶和华帮助我们，
124.en: If the Lord had not been on our side- let Israel say-

124.zh: 若不是耶和华帮助我们，当人起来攻击我们、
124.en: if the Lord had not been on our side when men attacked us,

124.zh: 向我们发怒的时候，就把我们活活地吞了。
124.en: when their anger flared against us, they would have swallowed us alive;

124.zh: 那时，波涛必漫过我们，河水必淹没我们，
124.en: the flood would have engulfed us, the torrent would have swept over us,
the raging waters would have swept us away.

124.zh: 耶和华是应当称颂的！他没有把我们当野食交给他们吞吃（原文是牙齿）。
124.en: Praise be to the Lord , who has not let us be torn by their teeth.

124.zh: 我们好像雀鸟，从捕鸟人的网罗里逃脱；网罗破裂，我们逃脱了。
124.en: We have escaped like a bird out of the fowler's snare; the snare has been broken, and we have escaped.

124.zh: 我们得帮助，是在乎倚靠造天地之耶和华的名。
124.en: Our help is in the name of the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth.

125.zh: （上行之诗。）倚靠耶和华的人好像锡安山，永不动摇。
125.en: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

125.zh: 众山怎样围绕耶路撒冷，耶和华也照样围绕他的百姓，从今时直到永远。
125.en: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the Lord surrounds his people both now and forevermore.

125.zh: 恶人的杖不常落在义人的分上，免得义人伸手作恶。
125.en: The scepter of the wicked will not remain over the land allotted to the righteous, for then the righteous might use their hands to do evil.

125.zh: 耶和华啊，求你善待那些为善和心里正直的人。
125.en: Do good, O Lord , to those who are good, to those who are upright in heart.

125.zh: 至于那偏行弯曲道路的人，耶和华必使他和作恶的人一同出去受刑。愿平安归于以色列！
125.en: But those who turn to crooked ways the Lord will banish with the evildoers. Peace be upon Israel.

126.zh: （上行之诗。）当耶和华将那些被掳的带回锡安的时候，我们好像做梦的人。
126.en: When the Lord brought back the captives to Zion, we were like men who dreamed.

126.zh: 我们满口喜笑、满舌欢呼的时候，外邦中就有人说：耶和华为他们行了大事！
126.en: Our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with songs of joy. Then it was said among the nations, "The Lord has done great things for them."

126.zh: 耶和华果然为我们行了大事，我们就欢喜。
126.en: The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

126.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使我们被掳的人归回，好像南地的河水复流。
126.en: Restore our fortunes, O Lord , like streams in the Negev.

126.zh: 流泪撒种的，必欢呼收割！
126.en: Those who sow in tears will reap with songs of joy.

126.zh: 那带种流泪出去的，必要欢欢乐乐地带禾捆回来！
126.en: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed to sow, will return with songs of joy, carrying sheaves with him.

127.zh: （所罗门上行之诗。）若不是耶和华建造房屋，建造的人就枉然劳力；若不是耶和华看守城池，看守的人就枉然警醒。
127.en: Unless the Lord builds the house, its builders labor in vain. Unless the Lord watches over the city, the watchmen stand guard in vain.

127.zh: 你们清晨早起，夜晚安歇，吃劳碌得来的饭，本是枉然；惟有耶和华所亲爱的，必叫他安然睡觉。
127.en: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat- for he grants sleep to those he loves.

127.zh: 儿女是耶和华所赐的产业；所怀的胎是他所给的赏赐。
127.en: Sons are a heritage from the Lord , children a reward from him.

127.zh: 少年时所生的儿女好像勇士手中的箭。
127.en: Like arrows in the hands of a warrior are sons born in one's youth.

127.zh: 箭袋充满的人便为有福；他们在城门口和仇敌说话的时候，必不至于羞愧。
127.en: Blessed is the man whose quiver is full of them. They will not be put to shame when they contend with their enemies in the gate.

128.zh: （上行之诗。）凡敬畏耶和华、遵行他道的人便为有福！
128.en: Blessed are all who fear the Lord , who walk in his ways.

128.zh: 你要吃劳碌得来的；你要享福，事情顺利。
128.en: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

128.zh: 你妻子在你的内室，好像多结果子的葡萄树；你儿女围绕你的桌子，好像橄榄栽子。
128.en: Your wife will be like a fruitful vine within your house; your sons will be like olive shoots around your table.

128.zh: 看哪，敬畏耶和华的人必要这样蒙福！
128.en: Thus is the man blessed who fears the Lord .

128.zh: 愿耶和华从锡安赐福给你！愿你一生一世看见耶路撒冷的好处！
128.en: May the Lord bless you from Zion all the days of your life; may you see the prosperity of Jerusalem,

128.zh: 愿你看见你儿女的儿女！愿平安归于以色列！
128.en: and may you live to see your children's children. Peace be upon Israel.

129.zh: （上行之诗。）以色列当说：从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我，
129.en: They have greatly oppressed me from my youth- let Israel say-

129.zh: 从我幼年以来，敌人屡次苦害我，却没有胜了我。
129.en: they have greatly oppressed me from my youth, but they have not gained the victory over me.

129.zh: 如同扶犁的在我背上扶犁而耕，耕的犁沟甚长。
129.en: Plowmen have plowed my back and made their furrows long.

129.zh: 耶和华是公义的；他砍断了恶人的绳索。
129.en: But the Lord is righteous; he has cut me free from the cords of the wicked.

129.zh: 愿恨恶锡安的都蒙羞退后！
129.en: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.

129.zh: 愿他们像房顶上的草，未长成而枯干，
129.en: May they be like grass on the roof, which withers before it can grow;

129.zh: 收割的不够一把，捆禾的也不满怀。
129.en: with it the reaper cannot fill his hands, nor the one who gathers fill his arms.

129.zh: 过路的也不说：愿耶和华所赐的福归与你们！我们奉耶和华的名给你们祝福！
129.en: May those who pass by not say, "The blessing of the Lord be upon you; we bless you in the name of the Lord ."

130.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华啊，我从深处向你求告！
130.en: Out of the depths I cry to you, O Lord ;

130.zh: 主啊，求你听我的声音！愿你侧耳听我恳求的声音！
130.en: O Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to my cry for mercy.

130.zh: 主─耶和华啊，你若究察罪孽，谁能站得住呢？
130.en: If you, O Lord , kept a record of sins, O Lord, who could stand?

130.zh: 但在你有赦免之恩，要叫人敬畏你。
130.en: But with you there is forgiveness; therefore you are feared.

130.zh: 我等候耶和华，我的心等候；我也仰望他的话。
130.en: I wait for the Lord , my soul waits, and in his word I put my hope.

130.zh: 我的心等候主，胜于守夜的，等候天亮，胜于守夜的，等候天亮。
130.en: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning, more than watchmen wait for the morning.

130.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华！因他有慈爱，有丰盛的救恩。
130.en: O Israel, put your hope in the Lord , for with the Lord is unfailing love and with him is full redemption.

130.zh: 他必救赎以色列脱离一切的罪孽。
130.en: He himself will redeem Israel from all their sins.

131.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）耶和华啊，我的心不狂傲，我的眼不高大；重大和测不透的事，我也不敢行。
131.en: My heart is not proud, O Lord , my eyes are not haughty; I do not concern myself with great matters or things too wonderful for me.

131.zh: 我的心平稳安静，好像断过奶的孩子在他母亲的怀中；我的心在我里面真像断过奶的孩子。
131.en: But I have stilled and quieted my soul; like a weaned child with its mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

131.zh: 以色列啊，你当仰望耶和华，从今时直到永远！
131.en: O Israel, put your hope in the Lord both now and forevermore.

132.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华啊，求你记念大卫所受的一切苦难！
132.en: O Lord , remember David and all the hardships he endured.

132.zh: 他怎样向耶和华起誓，向雅各的大能者许愿，
132.en: He swore an oath to the Lord and made a vow to the Mighty One of Jacob:

132.zh: 说：我必不进我的帐幕，也不上我的床榻；
132.en: "I will not enter my house or go to my bed-

132.zh: 我不容我的眼睛睡觉，也不容我的眼目打盹；
132.en: I will allow no sleep to my eyes, no slumber to my eyelids,

132.zh: 直等我为耶和华寻得所在，为雅各的大能者寻得居所。
132.en: till I find a place for the Lord , a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob."

132.zh: 我们听说约柜在以法他，我们在基列耶琳就寻见了。
132.en: We heard it in Ephrathah, we came upon it in the fields of Jaar :

132.zh: 我们要进他的居所，在他脚凳前下拜。
132.en: "Let us go to his dwelling place; let us worship at his footstool-

132.zh: 耶和华啊，求你兴起，和你有能力的约柜同入安息之所！
132.en: arise, O Lord , and come to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.

132.zh: 愿你的祭司披上公义！愿你的圣民欢呼！
132.en: May your priests be clothed with righteousness; may your saints sing for joy."

132.zh: 求你因你仆人大卫的缘故，不要厌弃你的受膏者！
132.en: For the sake of David your servant, do not reject your anointed one.

132.zh: 耶和华向大卫、凭诚实起了誓，必不反覆，说：我要使你所生的坐在你的宝座上。
132.en: The Lord swore an oath to David, a sure oath that he will not revoke: "One of your own descendants I will place on your throne-

132.zh: 你的众子若守我的约和我所教训他们的法度，他们的子孙必永远坐在你的宝座上。
132.en: if your sons keep my covenant and the statutes I teach them, then their sons will sit on your throne for ever and ever."

132.zh: 因为耶和华拣选了锡安，愿意当作自己的居所，
132.en: For the Lord has chosen Zion, he has desired it for his dwelling:

132.zh: 说：这是我永远安息之所；我要住在这里，因为是我所愿意的。
132.en: "This is my resting place for ever and ever; here I will sit enthroned, for I have desired it-

132.zh: 我要使其中的粮食丰满，使其中的穷人饱足。
132.en: I will bless her with abundant provisions; her poor will I satisfy with food.

132.zh: 我要使祭司披上救恩，圣民大声欢呼！
132.en: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will ever sing for joy.

132.zh: 我要叫大卫的角在那里发生；我为我的受膏者预备明灯。
132.en: "Here I will make a horn grow for David and set up a lamp for my anointed one.

132.zh: 我要使他的仇敌披上羞耻；但他的冠冕要在头上发光。
132.en: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown on his head will be resplendent."

133.zh: （大卫上行之诗。）看哪，弟兄和睦同居是何等地善，何等地美！
133.en: How good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in unity!

133.zh: 这好比那贵重的油浇在亚伦的头上，流到胡须，又流到他的衣襟；
133.en: It is like precious oil poured on the head, running down on the beard, running down on Aaron's beard, down upon the collar of his robes.

133.zh: 又好比黑门的甘露降在锡安山；因为在那里有耶和华所命定的福，就是永远的生命。
133.en: It is as if the dew of Hermon were falling on Mount Zion. For there the Lord bestows his blessing, even life forevermore.

134.zh: （上行之诗。）耶和华的仆人夜间站在耶和华殿中的，你们当称颂耶和华！
134.en: Praise the Lord , all you servants of the Lord who minister by night in the house of the Lord .

134.zh: 你们当向圣所举手，称颂耶和华！
134.en: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary and praise the Lord .

134.zh: 愿造天地的耶和华，从锡安赐福给你们！
134.en: May the Lord , the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.

135.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华的名！耶和华的仆人站在耶和华殿中；站在我们神殿院中的，你们要赞美他！
135.en: Praise the Lord . Praise the name of the Lord ; praise him, you servants of the Lord ,

135.zh: a
135.en: you who minister in the house of the Lord , in the courts of the house of our God.

135.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！耶和华本为善；要歌颂他的名，因为这是美好的。
135.en: Praise the Lord , for the Lord is good; sing praise to his name, for that is pleasant.

135.zh: 耶和华拣选雅各归自己，拣选以色列特作自己的子民。
135.en: For the Lord has chosen Jacob to be his own, Israel to be his treasured possession.

135.zh: 原来我知道耶和华为大，也知道我们的主超乎万神之上。
135.en: I know that the Lord is great, that our Lord is greater than all gods.

135.zh: 耶和华在天上，在地下，在海中，在一切的深处，都随自己的意旨而行。
135.en: The Lord does whatever pleases him, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all their depths.

135.zh: 他使云雾从地极上腾，造电随雨而闪，从府库中带出风来。
135.en: He makes clouds rise from the ends of the earth; he sends lightning with the rain and brings out the wind from his storehouses.

135.zh: 他将埃及头生的，连人带牲畜都击杀了。
135.en: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, the firstborn of men and animals.

135.zh: 埃及啊，他施行神迹奇事，在你当中，在法老和他一切臣仆身上。
135.en: He sent his signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.

135.zh: 他击杀许多的民，又杀戮大能的王，
135.en: He struck down many nations and killed mighty kings-

135.zh: 就是亚摩利王西宏和巴珊王噩，并迦南一切的国王，
135.en: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan and all the kings of Canaan-

135.zh: 将他们的地赏赐他的百姓以色列为业。
135.en: and he gave their land as an inheritance, an inheritance to his people Israel.

135.zh: 耶和华啊，你的名存到永远！耶和华啊，你可记念的名存到万代！
135.en: Your name, O Lord , endures forever, your renown, O Lord , through all generations.

135.zh: 耶和华要为他的百姓伸冤，为他的仆人后悔。
135.en: For the Lord will vindicate his people and have compassion on his servants.

135.zh: 外邦的偶像是金的，银的，是人手所造的；
135.en: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

135.zh: 有口却不能言，有眼却不能看，
135.en: They have mouths, but cannot speak, eyes, but they cannot see;

135.zh: 有耳却不能听，口中也没有气息。
135.en: they have ears, but cannot hear, nor is there breath in their mouths.

135.zh: 造他的要和他一样，凡靠他的也要如此。
135.en: Those who make them will be like them, and so will all who trust in them.

135.zh: 以色列家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！亚伦家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！
135.en: O house of Israel, praise the Lord ; O house of Aaron, praise the Lord ;

135.zh: 利未家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！你们敬畏耶和华的，要称颂耶和华！
135.en: O house of Levi, praise the Lord ; you who fear him, praise the Lord .

135.zh: 住在耶路撒冷的，耶和华该从锡安受称颂。你们要赞美耶和华！
135.en: Praise be to the Lord from Zion, to him who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the Lord .

136.zh: 你们要称谢耶和华，因他本为善；他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Give thanks to the Lord , for he is good. His love endures forever.

136.zh: 你们要称谢万神之神，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Give thanks to the God of gods. His love endures forever.

136.zh: 你们要称谢万主之主，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Give thanks to the Lord of lords: His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那独行大奇事的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who alone does great wonders, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那用智慧造天的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: who by his understanding made the heavens, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那铺地在水以上的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: who spread out the earth upon the waters, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那造成大光的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: who made the great lights- His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他造日头管白昼，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: the sun to govern the day, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他造月亮星宿管黑夜，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: the moon and stars to govern the night; His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那击杀埃及人之长子的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who struck down the firstborn of Egypt His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他领以色列人从他们中间出来，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: and brought Israel out from among them His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他施展大能的手和伸出来的膀臂，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: with a mighty hand and outstretched arm; His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那分裂红海的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who divided the Red Sea asunder His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他领以色列从其中经过，因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: and brought Israel through the midst of it, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 却把法老和他的军兵推翻在红海里，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea; His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那引导自己的民行走旷野的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to him who led his people through the desert, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 称谢那击杀大君王的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: who struck down great kings, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他杀戮有名的君王，因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: and killed mighty kings- His love endures forever.

136.zh: 就是杀戮亚摩利王西宏，因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: Sihon king of the Amorites His love endures forever.

136.zh: 又杀巴珊王噩，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: and Og king of Bashan- His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他将他们的地赐他的百姓为业，因他的慈爱永远长存；
136.en: and gave their land as an inheritance, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 就是赐他的仆人以色列为业，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: an inheritance to his servant Israel; His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他顾念我们在卑微的地步，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: to the One who remembered us in our low estate His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他救拔我们脱离敌人，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: and freed us from our enemies, His love endures forever.

136.zh: 他赐粮食给凡有血气的，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: and who gives food to every creature. His love endures forever.

136.zh: 你们要称谢天上的神，因他的慈爱永远长存。
136.en: Give thanks to the God of heaven. His love endures forever.

137.zh: 我们曾在巴比伦的河边坐下，一追想锡安就哭了。
137.en: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.

137.zh: 我们把琴挂在那里的柳树上；
137.en: There on the poplars we hung our harps,

137.zh: 因为在那里，掳掠我们的要我们唱歌，抢夺我们的要我们作乐，说：给我们唱一首锡安歌罢！
137.en: for there our captors asked us for songs, our tormentors demanded songs of joy; they said, "Sing us one of the songs of Zion!"

137.zh: 我们怎能在外邦唱耶和华的歌呢？
137.en: How can we sing the songs of the Lord while in a foreign land?

137.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，我若忘记你，情愿我的右手忘记技巧！
137.en: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand forget its skill .

137.zh: 我若不记念你，若不看耶路撒冷过于我所最喜乐的，情愿我的舌头贴于上膛！
137.en: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not consider Jerusalem my highest joy.

137.zh: 耶路撒冷遭难的日子，以东人说：拆毁！拆毁！直拆到根基！耶和华啊，求你记念这仇！
137.en: Remember, O Lord , what the Edomites did on the day Jerusalem fell. "Tear it down," they cried, "tear it down to its foundations!"

137.zh: 将要被灭的巴比伦城啊（城：原文是女子），报复你像你待我们的，那人便为有福！
137.en: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, happy is he who repays you for what you have done to us-

137.zh: 拿你的婴孩摔在磐石上的，那人便为有福！
137.en: he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.

138.zh: （大卫的诗。）我要一心称谢你，在诸神面前歌颂你。
138.en: I will praise you, O Lord , with all my heart; before the "gods" I will sing your praise.

138.zh: 我要向你的圣殿下拜，为你的慈爱和诚实称赞你的名；因你使你的话显为大，过于你所应许的（或译：超乎你的名声）。
138.en: I will bow down toward your holy temple and will praise your name for your love and your faithfulness, for you have exalted above all things your name and your word.

138.zh: 我呼求的日子，你就应允我，鼓励我，使我心里有能力。
138.en: When I called, you answered me; you made me bold and stouthearted.

138.zh: 耶和华啊，地上的君王都要称谢你，因他们听见了你口中的言语。
138.en: May all the kings of the earth praise you, O Lord , when they hear the words of your mouth.

138.zh: 他们要歌颂耶和华的作为，因耶和华大有荣耀。
138.en: May they sing of the ways of the Lord , for the glory of the Lord is great.

138.zh: 耶和华虽高，仍看顾低微的人；他却从远处看出骄傲的人。
138.en: Though the Lord is on high, he looks upon the lowly, but the proud he knows from afar.

138.zh: 我虽行在患难中，你必将我救活；我的仇敌发怒，你必伸手抵挡他们；你的右手也必救我。
138.en: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you preserve my life; you stretch out your hand against the anger of my foes, with your right hand you save me.

138.zh: 耶和华必成全关乎我的事；耶和华啊，你的慈爱永远长存！求你不要离弃你手所造的。
138.en: The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; your love, O Lord , endures forever- do not abandon the works of your hands.

139.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，你已经鉴察我，认识我。
139.en: O Lord , you have searched me and you know me.

139.zh: 我坐下，我起来，你都晓得；你从远处知道我的意念。
139.en: You know when I sit and when I rise; you perceive my thoughts from afar.

139.zh: 我行路，我躺卧，你都细察；你也深知我一切所行的。
139.en: You discern my going out and my lying down; you are familiar with all my ways.

139.zh: 耶和华啊，我舌头上的话，你没有一句不知道的。
139.en: Before a word is on my tongue you know it completely, O Lord .

139.zh: 你在我前后环绕我，按手在我身上。
139.en: You hem me in-behind and before; you have laid your hand upon me.

139.zh: 这样的知识奇妙，是我不能测的，至高，是我不能及的。
139.en: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.

139.zh: 我往哪里去躲避你的灵？我往哪里逃、躲避你的面？
139.en: Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence?

139.zh: 我若升到天上，你在那里；我若在阴间下榻，你也在那里。
139.en: If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

139.zh: 我若展开清晨的翅膀，飞到海极居住，
139.en: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle on the far side of the sea,

139.zh: 就是在那里，你的手必引导我；你的右手也必扶持我。
139.en: even there your hand will guide me, your right hand will hold me fast.

139.zh: 我若说：黑暗必定遮蔽我，我周围的亮光必成为黑夜；
139.en: If I say, "Surely the darkness will hide me and the light become night around me,"

139.zh: 黑暗也不能遮蔽我，使你不见，黑夜却如白昼发亮。黑暗和光明，在你看都是一样。
139.en: even the darkness will not be dark to you; the night will shine like the day, for darkness is as light to you.

139.zh: 我的肺腑是你所造的；我在母腹中，你已覆庇我。
139.en: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb.

139.zh: 我要称谢你，因我受造，奇妙可畏；你的作为奇妙，这是我心深知道的。
139.en: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

139.zh: 我在暗中受造，在地的深处被联络；那时，我的形体并不向你隐藏。
139.en: My frame was not hidden from you when I was made in the secret place. When I was woven together in the depths of the earth,

139.zh: 我未成形的体质，你的眼早已看见了；你所定的日子，我尚未度一日（或译：我被造的肢体尚未有其一），你都写在你的册上了。
139.en: your eyes saw my unformed body. All the days ordained for me were written in your book before one of them came to be.

139.zh: 神啊，你的意念向我何等宝贵！其数何等众多！
139.en: How precious to me are your thoughts, O God! How vast is the sum of them!

139.zh: 我若数点，比海沙更多；我睡醒的时候，仍和你同在。
139.en: Were I to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand. When I awake, I am still with you.

139.zh: 神啊，你必要杀戮恶人；所以，你们好流人血的，离开我去罢！
139.en: If only you would slay the wicked, O God! Away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

139.zh: 因为他们说恶言顶撞你；你的仇敌也妄称你的名。
139.en: They speak of you with evil intent; your adversaries misuse your name.

139.zh: 耶和华啊，恨恶你的，我岂不恨恶他们么？攻击你的，我岂不憎嫌他们么？
139.en: Do I not hate those who hate you, O Lord , and abhor those who rise up against you?

139.zh: 我切切地恨恶他们，以他们为仇敌。
139.en: I have nothing but hatred for them; I count them my enemies.

139.zh: 神啊，求你鉴察我，知道我的心思，试炼我，知道我的意念，
139.en: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my anxious thoughts.

139.zh: 看在我里面有甚么恶行没有，引导我走永生的道路。
139.en: See if there is any offensive way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

140.zh: （大卫的诗，交与伶长。）耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离凶恶的人，保护我脱离强暴的人！
140.en: Rescue me, O Lord , from evil men; protect me from men of violence,

140.zh: 他们心中图谋奸恶，常常聚集要争战。
140.en: who devise evil plans in their hearts and stir up war every day.

140.zh: 他们使舌头尖利如蛇，嘴里有虺蛇的毒气。（细拉）
140.en: They make their tongues as sharp as a serpent's; the poison of vipers is on their lips. Selah

140.zh: 耶和华啊，求你拯救我脱离恶人的手，保护我脱离强暴的人！他们图谋推我跌倒。
140.en: Keep me, O Lord , from the hands of the wicked; protect me from men of violence who plan to trip my feet.

140.zh: 骄傲人为我暗设网罗和绳索；他们在路旁铺下网，设下圈套。（细拉）
140.en: Proud men have hidden a snare for me; they have spread out the cords of their net and have set traps for me along my path. Selah

140.zh: 我曾对耶和华说：你是我的神。耶和华啊，求你留心听我恳求的声音！
140.en: O Lord , I say to you, "You are my God." Hear, O Lord , my cry for mercy.

140.zh: 主─耶和华、我救恩的力量啊，在争战的日子，你遮蔽了我的头。
140.en: O Sovereign Lord , my strong deliverer, who shields my head in the day of battle-

140.zh: 耶和华啊，求你不要遂恶人的心愿；不要成就他们的计谋，恐怕他们自高。（细拉）
140.en: do not grant the wicked their desires, O Lord ; do not let their plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah

140.zh: 至于那些昂首围困我的人，愿他们嘴唇的奸恶陷害（原文是遮蔽自己）！
140.en: Let the heads of those who surround me be covered with the trouble their lips have caused.

140.zh: 愿火炭落在他们身上！愿他们被丢在火中，抛在深坑里，不能再起来。
140.en: Let burning coals fall upon them; may they be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, never to rise.

140.zh: 说恶言的人在地上必坚立不住；祸患必猎取强暴的人，将他打倒。
140.en: Let slanderers not be established in the land; may disaster hunt down men of violence.

140.zh: 我知道耶和华必为困苦人伸冤，必为穷乏人辨屈。
140.en: I know that the Lord secures justice for the poor and upholds the cause of the needy.

140.zh: 义人必要称赞你的名；正直人必住在你面前。
140.en: Surely the righteous will praise your name and the upright will live before you.

141.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，我曾求告你，求你快快临到我这里！我求告你的时候，愿你留心听我的声音！
141.en: O Lord , I call to you; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to you.

141.zh: 愿我的祷告如香陈列在你面前！愿我举手祈求，如献晚祭！
141.en: May my prayer be set before you like incense; may the lifting up of my hands be like the evening sacrifice.

141.zh: 耶和华啊，求你禁止我的口，把守我的嘴！
141.en: Set a guard over my mouth, O Lord ; keep watch over the door of my lips.

141.zh: 求你不叫我的心偏向邪恶，以致我和作孽的人同行恶事；也不叫我吃他们的美食。
141.en: Let not my heart be drawn to what is evil, to take part in wicked deeds with men who are evildoers; let me not eat of their delicacies.

141.zh: 任凭义人击打我，这算为仁慈；任凭他责备我，这算为头上的膏油；我的头不要躲闪。正在他们行恶的时候，我仍要祈祷。
141.en: Let a righteous man strike me-it is a kindness; let him rebuke me-it is oil on my head. My head will not refuse it. Yet my prayer is ever against the deeds of evildoers;

141.zh: 他们的审判官被扔在岩下；众人要听我的话，因为这话甘甜。
141.en: their rulers will be thrown down from the cliffs, and the wicked will learn that my words were well spoken.

141.zh: 我们的骨头散在墓旁，好像人耕田、刨地的土块。
141.en: They will say, "As one plows and breaks up the earth, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of the grave. "

141.zh: 主─耶和华啊，我的眼目仰望你；我投靠你，求你不要将我撇得孤苦！
141.en: But my eyes are fixed on you, O Sovereign Lord ; in you I take refuge-do not give me over to death.

141.zh: 求你保护我脱离恶人为我设的网罗和作孽之人的圈套！
141.en: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, from the traps set by evildoers.

141.zh: 愿恶人落在自己的网里，我却得以逃脱。
141.en: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.

142.zh: （大卫在洞里作的训诲诗，乃是祈祷。）我发声哀告耶和华，发声恳求耶和华。
142.en: I cry aloud to the Lord ; I lift up my voice to the Lord for mercy.

142.zh: 我在他面前吐露我的苦情，陈说我的患难。
142.en: I pour out my complaint before him; before him I tell my trouble.

142.zh: 我的灵在我里面发昏的时候，你知道我的道路。在我行的路上，敌人为我暗设网罗。
142.en: When my spirit grows faint within me, it is you who know my way. In the path where I walk men have hidden a snare for me.

142.zh: 求你向我右边观看，因为没有人认识我；我无处避难，也没有人眷顾我。
142.en: Look to my right and see; no one is concerned for me. I have no refuge; no one cares for my life.

142.zh: 耶和华啊，我曾向你哀求。我说：你是我的避难所；在活人之地，你是我的福分。
142.en: I cry to you, O Lord ; I say, "You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living."

142.zh: 求你侧耳听我的呼求，因我落到极卑之地；求你救我脱离逼迫我的人，因为他们比我强盛。
142.en: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need; rescue me from those who pursue me, for they are too strong for me.

142.zh: 求你领我出离被囚之地，我好称赞你的名。义人必环绕我，因为你是用厚恩待我。
142.en: Set me free from my prison, that I may praise your name. Then the righteous will gather about me because of your goodness to me.

143.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华啊，求你听我的祷告，留心听我的恳求，凭你的信实和公义应允我。
143.en: O Lord , hear my prayer, listen to my cry for mercy; in your faithfulness and righteousness come to my relief.

143.zh: 求你不要审问仆人；因为在你面前，凡活著的人没有一个是义的。
143.en: Do not bring your servant into judgment, for no one living is righteous before you.

143.zh: 原来仇敌逼迫我，将我打倒在地，使我住在幽暗之处，像死了许久的人一样。
143.en: The enemy pursues me, he crushes me to the ground; he makes me dwell in darkness like those long dead.

143.zh: 所以，我的灵在我里面发昏；我的心在我里面凄惨。
143.en: So my spirit grows faint within me; my heart within me is dismayed.

143.zh: 我追想古时之日，思想你的一切作为，默念你手的工作。
143.en: I remember the days of long ago; I meditate on all your works and consider what your hands have done.

143.zh: 我向你举手；我的心渴想你，如干旱之地盼雨一样。（细拉）
143.en: I spread out my hands to you; my soul thirsts for you like a parched land. Selah

143.zh: 耶和华啊，求你速速应允我！我心神耗尽！不要向我掩面，免得我像那些下坑的人一样。
143.en: Answer me quickly, O Lord ; my spirit fails. Do not hide your face from me or I will be like those who go down to the pit.

143.zh: 求你使我清晨得听你慈爱之言，因我倚靠你；求你使我知道当行的路，因我的心仰望你。
143.en: Let the morning bring me word of your unfailing love, for I have put my trust in you. Show me the way I should go, for to you I lift up my soul.

143.zh: 耶和华啊，求你救我脱离我的仇敌！我往你那里藏身。
143.en: Rescue me from my enemies, O Lord , for I hide myself in you.

143.zh: 求你指教我遵行你的旨意，因你是我的神。你的灵本为善；求你引我到平坦之地。
143.en: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God; may your good Spirit lead me on level ground.

143.zh: 耶和华啊，求你为你的名将我救活，凭你的公义，将我从患难中领出来，
143.en: For your name's sake, O Lord , preserve my life; in your righteousness, bring me out of trouble.

143.zh: 凭你的慈爱剪除我的仇敌，灭绝一切苦待我的人，因我是你的仆人。
143.en: In your unfailing love, silence my enemies; destroy all my foes, for I am your servant.

144.zh: （大卫的诗。）耶和华─我的磐石是应当称颂的！他教导我的手争战，教导我的指头打仗。
144.en: Praise be to the Lord my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.

144.zh: 他是我慈爱的主，我的山寨，我的高台，我的救主，我的盾牌，是我所投靠的；他使我的百姓服在我以下。
144.en: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.

144.zh: 耶和华啊，人算甚么，你竟认识他！世人算甚么，你竟顾念他！
144.en: O Lord , what is man that you care for him, the son of man that you think of him?

144.zh: 人好像一口气；他的年日如同影儿快快过去。
144.en: Man is like a breath; his days are like a fleeting shadow.

144.zh: 耶和华啊，求你使天下垂，亲自降临，摸山，山就冒烟。
144.en: Part your heavens, O Lord , and come down; touch the mountains, so that they smoke.

144.zh: 求你发出闪电，使他们四散，射出你的箭，使他们扰乱。
144.en: Send forth lightning and scatter [the enemies]; shoot your arrows and rout them.

144.zh: 求你从上伸手救拔我，救我出离大水，救我脱离外邦人的手。
144.en: Reach down your hand from on high; deliver me and rescue me from the mighty waters, from the hands of foreigners

144.zh: 他们的口说谎话；他们的右手起假誓。
144.en: whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

144.zh: 神啊，我要向你唱新歌，用十弦瑟向你歌颂。
144.en: I will sing a new song to you, O God; on the ten-stringed lyre I will make music to you,

144.zh: 你是那拯救君王的；你是那救仆人大卫脱离害命之刀的。
144.en: to the One who gives victory to kings, who delivers his servant David from the deadly sword.

144.zh: 求你救拔我，救我脱离外邦人的手。他们的口说谎话；他们的右手起假誓。
144.en: Deliver me and rescue me from the hands of foreigners whose mouths are full of lies, whose right hands are deceitful.

144.zh: 我们的儿子从幼年好像树栽子长大；我们的女儿如同殿角石，是按建宫的样式凿成的。
144.en: Then our sons in their youth will be like well-nurtured plants, and our daughters will be like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

144.zh: 我们的仓盈满，能出各样的粮食；我们的羊在田间孳生千万。
144.en: Our barns will be filled with every kind of provision. Our sheep will increase by thousands, by tens of thousands in our fields;

144.zh: 我们的牛驮著满驮，没有人闯进来抢夺，也没有人出去争战；我们的街市上也没有哭号的声音。
144.en: our oxen will draw heavy loads. There will be no breaching of walls, no going into captivity, no cry of distress in our streets.

144.zh: 遇见这光景的百姓便为有福！有耶和华为他们的神，这百姓便为有福！
144.en: Blessed are the people of whom this is true; blessed are the people whose God is the Lord .

145.zh: （大卫的赞美诗。）我的神我的王啊，我要尊崇你！我要永永远远称颂你的名！
145.en: I will exalt you, my God the King; I will praise your name for ever and ever.

145.zh: 我要天天称颂你，也要永永远远赞美你的名！
145.en: Every day I will praise you and extol your name for ever and ever.

145.zh: 耶和华本为大，该受大赞美；其大无法测度。
145.en: Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise; his greatness no one can fathom.

145.zh: 这代要对那代颂赞你的作为，也要传扬你的大能。
145.en: One generation will commend your works to another; they will tell of your mighty acts.

145.zh: 我要默念你威严的尊荣和你奇妙的作为。
145.en: They will speak of the glorious splendor of your majesty, and I will meditate on your wonderful works.

145.zh: 人要传说你可畏之事的能力；我也要传扬你的大德。
145.en: They will tell of the power of your awesome works, and I will proclaim your great deeds.

145.zh: 他们记念你的大恩就要传出来，并要歌唱你的公义。
145.en: They will celebrate your abundant goodness and joyfully sing of your righteousness.

145.zh: 耶和华有恩惠，有怜悯，不轻易发怒，大有慈爱。
145.en: The Lord is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and rich in love.

145.zh: 耶和华善待万民；他的慈悲覆庇他一切所造的。
145.en: The Lord is good to all; he has compassion on all he has made.

145.zh: 耶和华啊，你一切所造的都要称谢你；你的圣民也要称颂你，
145.en: All you have made will praise you, O Lord ; your saints will extol you.

145.zh: 传说你国的荣耀，谈论你的大能，
145.en: They will tell of the glory of your kingdom and speak of your might,

145.zh: 好叫世人知道你大能的作为，并你国度威严的荣耀。
145.en: so that all men may know of your mighty acts and the glorious splendor of your kingdom.

145.zh: 你的国是永远的国！你执掌的权柄存到万代！
145.en: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and your dominion endures through all generations. The Lord is faithful to all his promises and loving toward all he has made.

145.zh: 凡跌倒的，耶和华将他们扶持；凡被压下的，将他们扶起。
145.en: The Lord upholds all those who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.

145.zh: 万民都举目仰望你；你随时给他们食物。
145.en: The eyes of all look to you, and you give them their food at the proper time.

145.zh: 你张手，使有生气的都随愿饱足。
145.en: You open your hand and satisfy the desires of every living thing.

145.zh: 耶和华在他一切所行的，无不公义；在他一切所做的都有慈爱。
145.en: The Lord is righteous in all his ways and loving toward all he has made.

145.zh: 凡求告耶和华的，就是诚心求告他的，耶和华便与他们相近。
145.en: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

145.zh: 敬畏他的，他必成就他们的心愿，也必听他们的呼求，拯救他们。
145.en: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him; he hears their cry and saves them.

145.zh: 耶和华保护一切爱他的人，却要灭绝一切的恶人。
145.en: The Lord watches over all who love him, but all the wicked he will destroy.

145.zh: 我的口要说出赞美耶和华的话；惟愿凡有血气的都永永远远称颂他的圣名。
145.en: My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord . Let every creature praise his holy name for ever and ever.

146.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！我的心哪，你要赞美耶和华！
146.en: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord , O my soul.

146.zh: 我一生要赞美耶和华！我还活的时候要歌颂我的神！
146.en: I will praise the Lord all my life; I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.

146.zh: 你们不要倚靠君王，不要倚靠世人；他一点不能帮助。
146.en: Do not put your trust in princes, in mortal men, who cannot save.

146.zh: 他的气一断，就归回尘土；他所打算的，当日就消灭了。
146.en: When their spirit departs, they return to the ground; on that very day their plans come to nothing.

146.zh: 以雅各的神为帮助、仰望耶和华─他神的，这人便为有福！
146.en: Blessed is he whose help is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the Lord his God,

146.zh: 耶和华造天、地、海，和其中的万物；他守诚实，直到永远。
146.en: the Maker of heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them- the Lord , who remains faithful forever.

146.zh: 他为受屈的伸冤，赐食物与饥饿的。耶和华释放被囚的；
146.en: He upholds the cause of the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The Lord sets prisoners free,

146.zh: 耶和华开了瞎子的眼睛；耶和华扶起被压下的人。耶和华喜爱义人。
146.en: the Lord gives sight to the blind, the Lord lifts up those who are bowed down, the Lord loves the righteous.

146.zh: 耶和华保护寄居的，扶持孤儿和寡妇，却使恶人的道路弯曲。
146.en: The Lord watches over the alien and sustains the fatherless and the widow, but he frustrates the ways of the wicked.

146.zh: 耶和华要作王，直到永远！锡安哪，你的神要作王，直到万代！你们要赞美耶和华！
146.en: The Lord reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Praise the Lord .

147.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！因歌颂我们的神为善为美；赞美的话是合宜的。
147.en: Praise the Lord . How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and fitting to praise him!

147.zh: 耶和华建造耶路撒冷，聚集以色列中被赶散的人。
147.en: The Lord builds up Jerusalem; he gathers the exiles of Israel.

147.zh: 他医好伤心的人，裹好他们的伤处。
147.en: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

147.zh: 他数点星宿的数目，一一称他的名。
147.en: He determines the number of the stars and calls them each by name.

147.zh: 我们的主为大，最有能力；他的智慧无法测度。
147.en: Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit.

147.zh: 耶和华扶持谦卑人，将恶人倾覆于地。
147.en: The Lord sustains the humble but casts the wicked to the ground.

147.zh: 你们要以感谢向耶和华歌唱，用琴向我们的神歌颂。
147.en: Sing to the Lord with thanksgiving; make music to our God on the harp.

147.zh: 他用云遮天，为地降雨，使草生长在山上。
147.en: He covers the sky with clouds; he supplies the earth with rain and makes grass grow on the hills.

147.zh: 他赐食给走兽和啼叫的小乌鸦。
147.en: He provides food for the cattle and for the young ravens when they call.

147.zh: 他不喜悦马的力大，不喜爱人的腿快。
147.en: His pleasure is not in the strength of the horse, nor his delight in the legs of a man;

147.zh: 耶和华喜爱敬畏他和盼望他慈爱的人。
147.en: the Lord delights in those who fear him, who put their hope in his unfailing love.

147.zh: 耶路撒冷啊，你要颂赞耶和华！锡安哪，你要赞美你的神！
147.en: Extol the Lord , O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion,

147.zh: 因为他坚固了你的门闩，赐福给你中间的儿女。
147.en: for he strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses your people within you.

147.zh: 他使你境内平安，用上好的麦子使你满足。
147.en: He grants peace to your borders and satisfies you with the finest of wheat.

147.zh: 他发命在地；他的话颁行最快。
147.en: He sends his command to the earth; his word runs swiftly.

147.zh: 他降雪如羊毛，撒霜如炉灰。
147.en: He spreads the snow like wool and scatters the frost like ashes.

147.zh: 他掷下冰雹如碎渣；他发出寒冷，谁能当得起呢？
147.en: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can withstand his icy blast?

147.zh: 他一出令，这些就都消化；他使风刮起，水便流动。
147.en: He sends his word and melts them; he stirs up his breezes, and the waters flow.

147.zh: 他将他的道指示雅各，将他的律例典章指示以色列。
147.en: He has revealed his word to Jacob, his laws and decrees to Israel.

147.zh: 别国他都没有这样待过；至于他的典章，他们向来没有知道。你们要赞美耶和华！
147.en: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know his laws. Praise the Lord .

148.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！从天上赞美耶和华，在高处赞美他！
148.en: Praise the Lord . Praise the Lord from the heavens, praise him in the heights above.

148.zh: 他的众使者都要赞美他！他的诸军都要赞美他！
148.en: Praise him, all his angels, praise him, all his heavenly hosts.

148.zh: 日头月亮，你们要赞美他！放光的星宿，你们都要赞美他！
148.en: Praise him, sun and moon, praise him, all you shining stars.

148.zh: 天上的天和天上的水，你们都要赞美他！
148.en: Praise him, you highest heavens and you waters above the skies.

148.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！因他一吩咐便都造成。
148.en: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for he commanded and they were created.

148.zh: 他将这些立定，直到永永远远；他定了命，不能废去（或译：越过）。
148.en: He set them in place for ever and ever; he gave a decree that will never pass away.

148.zh: 所有在地上的，大鱼和一切深洋，
148.en: Praise the Lord from the earth, you great sea creatures and all ocean depths,

148.zh: 火与冰雹，雪和雾气，成就他命的狂风，
148.en: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy winds that do his bidding,

148.zh: 大山和小山，结果的树木和一切香柏树，
148.en: you mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

148.zh: 野兽和一切牲畜，昆虫和飞鸟，
148.en: wild animals and all cattle, small creatures and flying birds,

148.zh: 世上的君王和万民，首领和世上一切审判官，
148.en: kings of the earth and all nations, you princes and all rulers on earth,

148.zh: 少年人和处女，老年人和孩童，都当赞美耶和华！
148.en: young men and maidens, old men and children.

148.zh: 愿这些都赞美耶和华的名！因为独有他的名被尊崇；他的荣耀在天地之上。
148.en: Let them praise the name of the Lord , for his name alone is exalted; his splendor is above the earth and the heavens.

148.zh: 他将他百姓的角高举，因此他（或译：他使）一切圣民以色列人，就是与他相近的百姓，都赞美他！你们要赞美耶和华！
148.en: He has raised up for his people a horn, the praise of all his saints, of Israel, the people close to his heart. Praise the Lord .

149.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！向耶和华唱新歌，在圣民的会中赞美他！
149.en: Praise the Lord . Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

149.zh: 愿以色列因造他的主欢喜！愿锡安的民因他们的王快乐！
149.en: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the people of Zion be glad in their King.

149.zh: 愿他们跳舞赞美他的名，击鼓弹琴歌颂他！
149.en: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with tambourine and harp.

149.zh: 因为耶和华喜爱他的百姓；他要用救恩当作谦卑人的妆饰。
149.en: For the Lord takes delight in his people; he crowns the humble with salvation.

149.zh: 愿圣民因所得的荣耀高兴！愿他们在床上欢呼！
149.en: Let the saints rejoice in this honor and sing for joy on their beds.

149.zh: 愿他们口中称赞神为高，手里有两刃的刀，
149.en: May the praise of God be in their mouths and a double-edged sword in their hands,

149.zh: 为要报复列邦，刑罚万民。
149.en: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,

149.zh: 要用炼子捆他们的君王，用铁镣锁他们的大臣；
149.en: to bind their kings with fetters, their nobles with shackles of iron,

149.zh: 要在他们身上施行所记录的审判。他的圣民都有这荣耀。你们要赞美耶和华！
149.en: to carry out the sentence written against them. This is the glory of all his saints. Praise the Lord .

150.zh: 你们要赞美耶和华！在神的圣所赞美他！在他显能力的穹苍赞美他！
150.en: Praise the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary; praise him in his mighty heavens.

150.zh: 要因他大能的作为赞美他，按著他极美的大德赞美他！
150.en: Praise him for his acts of power; praise him for his surpassing greatness.

150.zh: 要用角声赞美他，鼓瑟弹琴赞美他！
150.en: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet, praise him with the harp and lyre

150.zh: 击鼓跳舞赞美他！用丝弦的乐器和箫的声音赞美他！
150.en: praise him with tambourine and dancing, praise him with the strings and flute,

150.zh: 用大响的钹赞美他！用高声的钹赞美他！
150.en: praise him with the clash of cymbals, praise him with resounding cymbals.

150.zh: 凡有气息的都要赞美耶和华！你们要赞美耶和华！
150.en: Let everything that has breath praise the Lord .
